en:
Designed to meet Japan's 'kei car' standards, the Copen
is a two-seater convertible with an FF layout.

While it may only sport a <660cc> engine, you'd do well to
not underestimate it!

A perfect car for those who like a bit of power, the Copen
also boasts a rigid chassis and precise handling.

Its electrically operated metal roof is also quite the
crowd-pleaser!
zh:
Copen是一款采用前置前驱布局的双座敞篷车，设计上非常
契合日本的“轻型车”标准。

虽然只采用了<660cc>的引擎，但您最好不要小瞧它！

对于那些对动力稍有追求的人来说，Copen也是一款完美的汽车，
拥有坚固的底盘和精准的操控，

还有电控的金属顶篷，也十分符合大众的审美！

en:
The first generation Dodge Viper made a splash in the
sports car world when it made its debut.

It was a stylish FR sports car with a potent V-10 engine.

Some were so awed by its prowess that they began calling it
the Corvette killer.

Did you know that Lamborghini was involved in developing
the Viper's engine and suspension?

That's because back then, Dodge and Lamborghini
were both owned by Chrysler.

Released in 1996, the Viper GTS had even more torque and
power than the original.
zh:
第一代Dodge Viper首次亮相即在美国的跑车行业引起了轰动。

这款强劲的前置后驱跑车配备了性能爆炸的V10引擎……

这款新秀很快就被人拿来与Corvette相提并论。

顺便问句，您知道Lamborghini参与了Viper的引擎和悬挂的开发吗？

那是因为Dodge和Lamborghini在当时都是Chrysler的子公司。

1996年，此车的GTS型号发布，扭矩和功率均有所改进。

en:
This second generation Viper was released in 2002.

Its 8.4L V10 engine offers <400cc> more displacement
than the first generation model...

And packs more than <600ps> of power!

What's more, it weighs <50kg> less than
its predecessor!

Put through its paces during extensive testing
at the Nürburgring...

This model has been successful in many European races!
zh:
这款第二代Viper于2002年发布。

其8.4升V10引擎比第一代车型的排量还要大<400cc>……

而且动力超过了<600ps>！

更重要的是，其重量比前一代车型还轻<50kg>！

此车在纽博格林赛道进行了广泛的测试，充分展现了自
身的实力……

随后，此车在许多欧洲举办的比赛中都取得了成功！

en:
BMW obtained the rights and resurrected the popular
British car known as the Mini in 2001.

The folks at BMW were careful to keep the car's signature
compact boxy design intact.

This particular model is the high-performance Cooper S.

It boasts a peppy supercharged 1.6-liter inline-4 engine.

Thanks to its rigid chassis and solid structure, this car
has the feel of a go-kart when you push it to it limits.
zh:
BMW的第一代Mini早在2001年就进入了市场……

并立即因经久不衰的标志性设计而表现得卓尔不群。

这款特殊的车型是Cooper S，主打高性能……

此车拥有一台轻巧的1.6L直列四缸机械增压发动机。

除了悬挂相当硬外，它的驾驶感受几乎和卡丁车一样，
颇有乐趣！

en:
If you're looking for a mid-engined V8 Ferrari, you can't go
wrong with the F430.

This successor to the 360 Modena boasts an additional <90ps>
of power...

And its V8 engine is the first of its kind!

Other exciting innovations include the addition of carbon
brakes and a computer-controlled LSD called the E-Diff.

To this day, few cars can match the F430's performance on
the circuit!
zh:
如果您正在寻找一辆中置引擎的V8 Ferrari，选F430准没错。

这款360 Modena的继任者将动力提升了<90ps>……

而且装载的一款全新的V8引擎！

此外，F430还有更多令人激动的创新点，包括加装的碳纤
维刹车系统和一个被称为E-Diff的电控限滑差速器。

时至今日，仍然鲜少有赛道表现能与F430相提并论的车型
出现！

en:
The Spirit R was the last of the third generation RX-7s to
be built, and it may just be the best of the lot.

Three different models of the Spirit R were produced.
The Type A, which you see here...

Has two seats, and a manual transmission.

The Spirit R also has an enhanced suspension and braking
system that make for a fantastic driving experience!
zh:
Spirit R是第三代RX-7的最后一款车型，可能也是最优秀的一款。

Spirit R共生产了三种不同的型号。Type A，也就是现在您看
到的这一款……

采用了双座布局和手动变速箱。

Spirit R还对悬挂和刹车系统进行了强化，带来奇妙的驾驶
体验！

en:
This beauty is a modern remake of the legendary Ford GT40.

Some say that it's one of Ford's greatest masterpieces!

You can really tell that its design was inspired by
the beautiful racing cars of the sixties.

As it happens, this model was made to celebrate Ford's
100th anniversary.

A truly priceless vehicle!
zh:
这台尤物是传奇的Ford GT40的现代重制版。

有人说，这辆车是Ford最伟大的杰作之一！

确实，从外观上就可以看出其设计灵感来自六十年代那
台造型优美的赛车。

更巧的是，这款车是为了庆祝Ford公司成立100周年而制造
的。

因此是一辆真正无价的车！

en:
If you're a fan of racing, then you should be familiar with
the Audi R8, which dominated Le Mans in the early 2000s?

Well, that's where this particular version gets its name!

This first-generation R8 is an absolute must-buy
for supercar lovers.

It's a mid-engine car with a 4.2-liter V-8
that pumps out <420ps>.

In addition to employing Audi's quattro
all-wheel drive technology...

...it was noted for its uniquely lightweight aluminum
body structure called the Audi Space Frame.
zh:
您肯定熟悉Audi R8——那是一辆21世纪初不断在勒芒比赛
中夺冠的冠军车。

嗯，它就是这个车型的名字由来！

这款第一代R8绝对是超跑爱好者的必购之物。

它配备了4.2L V8中置引擎，能够产生<420ps>的动力。

除了采用Audi的quattro全轮驱动技术外……

其独特的轻质铝制车身——Audi空间车架也颇引人注目。[

en:
This tuned Honda S2000 was produced by Powerhouse Amuse,
some of the best Honda tuners in the business!

They turbo-charged the S2000's 2L F20C straight-four engine
and enlarged it to 2.3L—producing <626ps> of power!

The body kit was developed in collaboration with the
developers of Gran Turismo.

Its longer nose and added diffuser make this model as
aerodynamic as any fully-fledged racing car.

You won't know how smooth a ride can be until you take
one of these for a spin!
zh:
这辆经过改装的Honda S2000是由Powerhouse Amuse公司打造的，
他们是业界最好的Honda改装工坊之一！

他们为S2000的2L F20C直列四缸引擎加装了涡轮，并将排量扩
大到2.3L，可产生<626ps>的动力！

车身套件是与跑车浪漫旅的开发者合作开发的。

长车头和额外增加的扩散器使这一车型在空气动力学表
现方面与成熟的赛车不相上下。

等您试驾过这些车之后，才会明白什么叫酣畅淋漓！-

en:
RE Amemiya is a legendary Japanese tuner of Mazda cars.

Specializing in enhancing rotary engines, it has produced
a number of high-powered RX-7 over the years.

The RE Amemiya FD3S RX-7, also known as the Amemiya µ
Boost up 7, is one of the company's most iconic models.

Its power and flawless balance make it an absolute
monster on the race track.

You'll be amazed to see how well it takes corners!
zh:
RE Amemiya是一家富有传奇色彩的日本转子引擎改装公司。

他们专门从事Mazda汽车的改装，其陆陆续续推出的RX-7改装
套件在全世界范围内广受赞誉。

RE Amemiya FD3S RX-7，也被称为Amemiya µ Boost up 7，
是他们最具代表性的改装车型之一。

其出色的平衡性带来梦幻般的操控性，使其能够驾驭几
乎所有类型的赛道。

您一定会为它的过弯能力而倾倒！<

en:
The V-Spec II Nür was the last version of the
Skyline GT-R (R34) that Nissan produced.

It featured an improved L6 twin-turbo RB26DETT engine
that delivered better responsiveness and torque.

This ultra-rare model had an extremely limited
production run.

This means that it's already a collector's item,
so be sure to put one in your Garage.
zh:
V-Spec II Nür是Nissan所生产的Skyline GT-R的最后一款车型。

此车采用了改进版本的L6双涡轮增压RB26DETT引擎，提高了动
力响应和扭矩。

这款超稀有的车型产量极其有限……

因此对于任何汽车爱好者而言，此车都很有收藏价值！

en:
This fifth-generation Nissan Fairlady Z was codenamed Z33.
We know it better as the 350Z.

The Z was temporarily discontinued in 2000 with the 300ZX,
codenamed Z32.

It was revived in 2002 with the 350Z.

This specific model is from 2007, and it features massive
improvements to its naturally-aspirated V-6 powerplant.

In fact, this little beauty is capable of more than <300ps>
with added torque to make it quick off the line.
zh:
这款第五代日产Fairlady Z在日本被称为Z33，
而在日本以外地区则被称为350Z。

在90年代末和21世纪初之间，
Fairlady或“Z-car”系列逐渐退出了市场……

而现在，Z系列将因为新350Z的出现得以复苏！

这一车款是2007年推出的，
特点是对自然进气的V6引擎进行了大规模改进。

事实上，由于扭矩的增加，
这辆娇小尤物的动力已经超过了<300ps>！

en:
The highlight of this fourth-generation BMW M3
was its naturally-aspirated V-8 engine.

It was the first engine of its kind in an M3. With an <8400rpm>
redline, it packed a potent high-end punch.

If you want to know what a race car for the street feels like,
then be sure to take a drive in this thing.
zh:
这款第四代BMW M3的亮点是一台自然进气的V8引擎。

这是M3上首次使用此类引擎。其转速红线高达<8400rpm>，冲击
力着实强劲！

如果您喜欢引擎转速飙升、发出轰鸣的快感，您肯定会
爱上它在赛道上表现出来的强劲动力。

en:
This improved Honda NSX Type R, also known as the 02R,
was released in 2002.

Its lightweight body and sport-tuned suspension made it
a monster on the track.

Part of the reason was an excellent aerodynamic shape
that allowed the car to generate gobs of downforce.

You'll be hard-pressed to find a car that feels as good to
drive as this one.
zh:
这款改进后的NSX Type R也被称为02R，于2002年发布。

其轻巧的车身和坚硬的悬挂大大提升了其在赛道上的表现。

此车还拥有出色的空气动力学设计，可产生强大的下压力。

您很难找到像这款车一样易于驾驶的车了！

en:
This is the Swift Sport, an iconic Japanese FF hot hatch...

With lots of admirers in the rally scene, thanks to its
performances at the Junior World Rally Championship.

Wondering what's under the bonnet? Why, it's a 1.6L
naturally aspirated engine!

Featuring variable valve timing technology,
forged pistons...

And a close-ratio 5-speed manual transmission, this sporty
number is the definition of circuit-ready!
zh:
这就是速翼特Sport，一款标志性的日本前置前驱高性能掀背车……

它在世界拉力锦标赛青年组上的表现为自己赢得了拉力
赛场上的众多崇拜者。

知道引擎盖下有什么吗？一台1.6升自然进气发动机！

此车采用可变气门正时技术、锻造活塞……

以及密齿轮比的5速手动变速箱，典型的赛事配置表明
此车随时做好了驶上赛道的准备！

sourceName: Ford GT LM Spec II Test Car
en:
This Gran Turismo original Gr.3 racing car is based on
the Ford GT.

Conceived as a 'Ford GT fit for Le Mans'...

It features a specially designed suspension system, as well
as a race-ready six-speed manual transmission.

All its body panels were constructed from carbon fibre in
order to reduce their weight as much as possible.

In fact, it weighs only <1150kg>!`
zh:
这款跑车浪漫旅原创的Gr.3赛车以Ford GT为基础改装而成，

被认为是“有参加勒芒耐力赛资格的Ford GT”……

此车有一套特别设计的悬挂系统以及赛事专用的六速手
动变速箱。

其所有车身板件都是由碳纤维制造的，以尽可能地减轻
车身重量。

事实上，此车的重量只有<1150kg>！`

en:
Nissan's S15 Silvia has become one of the most popular
Japanese rear-wheel-drive sports cars, thanks to drifting.

This particular version is the Spec-R Aero that came with the
SR20 turbocharged inline-4 engine.

The car has classic sports-car proportions
and weighs only <1200kg>.

If you enjoy sliding your car around corners, then you'll be
delighted with the balance that this thing delivers.%
zh:
S15 Silvia肯定算得上是最著名的日本后轮驱动跑车之一了。

这款车型是Spec-R Aero，采用了SR20直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。

得益于合理的车身尺寸与比例，它的重量只有<1200kg>。

任何喜欢漂移的人都会被其巨大的涡轮动力所征服！

en:
This sixth-generation 2009 370Z was known in-house as the Z34.

It came with a redesigned naturally-aspirated 3.7-liter V-6.

This engine produced <336ps>, which represented a significant
bump from the 3.5-liter unit of its predecessor.

It came mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox
with a new rev-matching technology.

Called SynchroRev, it automatically matched engine speed
to wheel speed during downshifts.

This allowed the driver to perform perfect downshifts without
having to employ a technique called heel-and-toe.
zh:
这款第六代2008 Fairlady Z也被称为Z34。

其全新设计的3.7升V6自然进气引擎……

可提供<336ps>的最大输出功率，远远超过其前作Z33……

还有六速手动变速箱采用的技术也是前所未有的。

这项技术能够在每次车手换档时自动调整引擎的旋转……

不需要车手的跟趾动作，就能实现顺滑的降档补油！

en:
The 2008 Nissan Xanavi Nismo GT-R has certainly made its
mark on Super GT history.

This is the car that brought Nissan victory in the 2008
championship!

It comes with a 4.5L V8 engine that's based on the VK45DE...

And unlike the four-wheel drive GT-R, this model features
a front-engine, rear-wheel drive layout.
zh:
2008 Nissan Xanavi Nismo GT-R无疑在Super GT的历史上留下了
自己的印记。

这台车为Nissan带来了2008年Super GT锦标赛的胜利！

此车配备了基于VK45DE引擎改造而成的4.5L V8引擎……

而且与四轮驱动的GT-R不同，这款车型采用的是前置发引
擎、后轮驱动的布局。

en:
The V8 Vantage is fondly referred to as the 'baby Aston'...

Probably because its price and specifications are
quite modest...for an Aston Martin, that is!

But don't let its nickname fool you—the Vantage
can hold its own among the best of them!

This Vantage S is a high-performance model capable of <10ps>
more than the regular model...

And features an enhanced suspension system and quicker
steering thanks to a lower steering ratio.
zh:
V8 Vantage被车迷们亲切地称为“小Aston”……

可能是因为其价格和规格都比较适中的缘故……但这个
“适中”只是相对Aston Martin而言！

您可别被这个昵称给迷惑了——即使与品牌的最强车型
相比，Vantage也不遑多让！

这款Vantage S是系列中的高性能车型，比普通车型动力强<10ps>……

并且具有增强的悬挂系统。由于转向比更低，因此转向
速度也更快。

en:
This is Alfa Romeo's supercar, the 8C Competizione.

It sports a mighty V8 engine that was actually built
at a Ferrari factory.

Not only does it feel powerful—it sounds powerful, too!

An FR car with a transaxle gearbox mounted in the rear...

You'll find it handles like a dream thanks to its excellent
weight distribution.

Also of note: its beautiful proportions were inspired by the
classic racing Alfa Romeos of the thirties and forties.;
zh:
8C Competizione是Alfa Romeo推出的超级跑车。

这台车上搭载的强劲V8引擎实际上是在Ferrari工厂制造的。

不仅动力十足，声音也非常威猛！

这是一辆跨轴变速箱安装在后部的前置后驱车……

您会发现，由于其出色的重量分布，这辆车操控起来如
梦幻般流畅。

另外值得一提的是：其曼妙的车身比例深受30和40年代
的Alfa Romeo经典赛车的启发。;

en:
The appearance of this FF hot hatch bears a strong resemblance
to the Alfa Romeo 8C.

The power of its turbocharged 1.4-liter inline-4 engine makes
its presence known when you stomp the throttle pedal.

It's a fantastic car with an excellent suspension system.

The car stays glued to the pavement on high-speed corners!|
zh:
这辆前置前驱的高性能掀背车在设计上与Alfa Romeo 8C十分相似。

当您踩下油门时，可以切实感受到1.4L涡轮增压直列四缸
引擎传来的力量！

此车结构坚固，悬挂系统非常稳定。

是高速过弯的完美选择！

en:
This formidable machine may be one of the most exquisite
road cars Aston Martin has ever produced.

Called the One-77, it remains one of the company's
most exclusive models.

It possesses a full carbon-fiber monocoque chassis.

It also has a pushrod suspension system,
usually reserved for race cars.

Under the hood is a naturally-aspirated V-12 engine
that pumps out <760ps>!

As its name suggests, production of the car was limited to
77 units, making it a highly sought collector's item.
zh:
这辆漂亮的车可能是Aston Martin有史以来生产的最精致的公路
车之一！

One-77因其大胆和美丽的比例……

全碳纤维单壳底盘……

以及推杆悬挂等典型的赛车配置而备受车迷的喜爱。

最后还有不能不提的……可产生<760ps>动力的自然进气V12引擎！

One-77仅限量生产77辆，是真正的收藏逸品。[

en:
Carving through a corner with absolute precision
is a joy that captures the very essence of racing.

If there's one brand dedicated to chasing that joy,
it's Caterham, most notably with its iconic 'Seven' series.

This Superlight R500 from 1999 is the ultimate model,
balancing aerodynamics and power in a single package.

The lightest of the Sevens, the R500 weighs in at
a feathery <500kg>.

In 2008, it was refitted with a 2L Ford Duratec engine with
<266ps> of power and ample torque at low-to-mid speeds.

Named for its 500-horsepower-per-tonne power-to-weight ratio,
the R500 can sprint from 0 to <100km/h> in 2.88 seconds.

Rejecting modern driver aids and comforts, it serves as
a constant reminder of what a true sports car should
zh:
以绝对精准的行车线通过弯道，是赛车运动的核心乐趣之一。

如果要找出一个精确捕捉到了这一乐趣的汽车品牌，
Caterham绝对是很好的选择，特别是它经典的“Seven”系列。

这款1999年的Superlight R500是该系列的终极车型，
一站式提供了均衡的空气动力学设计和动力输出。

作为Seven系列中最轻盈的车型，
R500重量仅有<500kg>，可以说是轻如鸿毛。

在2008年，它换上了一台2升的Ford Duratec引擎，
能够输出<266ps>的动力，在中低转速下提供充足的扭矩。

该车型的名称R500，来自于其500马力每吨的推重比，
从0到<100km/h>加速仅需2.88秒。

这款拒绝现代辅助驾驶和舒适zdo车型，
一直是纯血跑车D标杆般的存在。

en:
This ZR1 is the most potent version of the sixth-generation
Corvette.

It came with a hand-built and supercharged
V-8 engine that...

...pumped out an impressive <647ps> and <80kgm> of torque.

This is one flexible engine, with gobs of power coming
throughout the rpm spectrum.

It made waves when it first appeared by beating the
Nissan GT-R's time on the Nürburgring Nordschleife.

And what's really cool about this American sports car
is that it handles as good as it goes straight.
zh:
这辆ZR1是第六代科尔维特中最令人惊艳的一款。

此车拥有一台精心手工打造的机械增压V8引擎。

拥有<647ps>最高功率输出，以及<80kgm>扭矩，

在转速范围内产生的动力令人心动！

它的首次亮相就伴随着在纽博格林北侧赛道上击败日产GT-R
的大新闻，掀起了阵阵波澜……

ZR1证明了自己不只有动力，操控性也如梦如幻！

en:
This Enzo Ferrari is a very special model made
to celebrate the company's 55th anniversary.

Released in 2002 as a successor to the F40 and F50...

The Enzo is a mid-engine car with a 6L naturally aspirated
V12 engine capable of <660ps>.

Designed by Ken Okuyama, who worked for
Pininfarina at the time...

Its nose resembles that of a Formula One car.

And if you're wondering about its name,
Enzo Ferrari was the founder of the company!
zh:
这款Enzo Ferrari是为庆祝Ferrari公司成立55周年而生产的一款
非常特别的车型。

此车是作为F40和F50的继任者在在2002年发布的……

Enzo采用中置引擎布局，配备6L自然进气V12引擎，能够产
出<660ps>的动力，

由当时为Pininfarina工作的奥山清行设计……

其车头与一级方程式赛车的车头很相似。

如果您是问车型命名的缘由，那当然是因为恩佐·法拉利
是公司的创始人！

en:
This third generation FIAT 500 is the quintessential
Italian compact car.

Not only did it inherit its design from the hugely popular
second generation model...

But like its predecessor, it too proved to be
a massive worldwide success!

With a 1.2L <70ps> engine that feels great on the road...

From handling to acceleration, it's simply a joy to drive!
zh:
第三代菲亚特500是一辆典型的意大利紧凑型汽车。

此车不仅继承了大受欢迎的第二代车型的设计思路……

而且也和前代一样在全世界范围内获得了巨大的成功！

此车配备一台动力为<70ps>的1.2升引擎，驾驶感受十分出色……

从操控到加速，驾驶这辆车简直是一种享受！!

en:
The Italian company Abarth is a prestigious name in the
world of racing...

And has achieved legendary status as a tuner for FIAT.

A symbol of Abarth's revival in 2007...

This car combines a <135ps> turbo engine with the small,
lightweight body of a FIAT 500...

And runs on standard 17-inch tyres. Just don't be fooled
by its size—this is a fully-fledged sports car!
zh:
意大利公司Abarth在赛车界享有盛名……

并作为FIAT的改装商取得了传奇的地位。

此车标志着Abarth于2007年开始复兴……

这款车将<135ps>涡轮增压引擎与FIAT 500的小型轻质车身结合起来……

并使用了标准的17英寸轮胎。不过别被其尺寸迷惑了——
这是一辆不折不扣的跑车！!

en:
Lamborghini's successor to the Diablo, the Murciélago
naturally comes equipped with a V12 engine.

This LP 640 is a high-performance model, unveiled in 2006,
and features four-wheel drive and a 631.1 BHP engine.

By the way, did you know that the basic structure of the V12
engine in this model is identical to that of the Countach?

The Murciélago was the very last model in which this engine
was ever used...

Making it quite the historical addition to any collection!
zh:
作为Lamborghini Diablo的继任者，V12引擎自然不会在
Murciélago上缺席。

这款LP 640是在2006年亮相的高性能车型，采用四轮驱动和<640ps>
的引擎。

顺便说一句，您知道吗？这台车的V12引擎的基本结构与
Countach一模一样。

Murciélago是最后一辆使用该引擎的车型……

也因此成为了一件具有历史意义的收藏品！

en:
The sports coupé is an iconic Maserati offering...

And this GranTurismo S was specifically built
to be a high-performance variant.

Not only has its engine displacement been increased
to produce more power and torque...

But it also features a transaxle layout, achieved
by altering the placement of the transmission.

Endowed with both style and substance, this is a car that
definitely means business.
zh:
这款运动型双门跑车极具Maserati的标志性风格……

而这台GranTurismo S是专门以高性能车型为目标的型号。

不仅增加了引擎排量以产生更大的功率和扭矩……

而且还特意改变变速箱的位置，采用了跨轴传动布局。

这是一台风格和内涵兼具，拥有绝对实力的车。

en:
The partnership between Mercedes and McLaren was one of the
most successful in the history of Formula 1.

This SLR McLaren was another product of that historic
partnership.

Its design was inspired by Mercedes-Benz's legendary racing
car, the 300 SLR...

And features a carbon fibre monocoque body
and a V8 supercharged engine.

This is one mighty car that is easily capable of producing
more than <600ps>, as well as <80kgm> of torque!
zh:
梅赛德斯和迈凯伦之间的合作是Formula 1历史上最成功的合
作之一。

这辆迈凯伦SLR是这一历史性合作关系的又一项产物。

其设计灵感来自梅赛德斯-奔驰的传奇赛车300 SLR……

并采用了碳纤维单体车身和V8机械增压引擎。

这是一辆极其强大的车，能够轻松产生超过<600ps>的动力，
以及<80kgm>的扭矩！

en:
The Super GT is Japan's most prestigious GT car racing
series, and it wouldn't be the same without the NSX.

This particular model is the EPSON NSX, which was raced
by Nakajima Racing in the 2008 season.

Production of first generation NSXs ceased in 2002...

But versions produced for the Super GT continued
to be developed independently.

This model was the only one of the NSXs of its time to be
equipped with Dunlop tyres...

Meaning it couldn't benefit from data-sharing with other NSX
teams—but that didn’t stop it from dominating the track!
zh:
GT是日本最负盛名的GT车型赛事，而如果没有NSX的参
与，这项锦标赛就不会如此成功。

这款特殊的车型是EPSON NSX，曾由中岛车队驾驶在2008赛季出赛。

第一代NSX的生产虽然早在2002年就停止了……

但为超级跑车生产的赛车版本仍在继续独立开发。

这款车型是当时的NSX中唯一使用邓禄普轮胎的车型……

这意味着此车无法从与其他NSX车队的数据共享中获益，
但这并没有妨碍其在赛道上占据主导优势。

en:
Pagani is known for having the most expensive and exclusive
cars, but the Zonda R is in a class of its own.

Specially designed to be driven on a track, a fact made
evident by its outstanding performance...

Its fully carbon body astonishingly weighs only <1250kg>.

Sporting a V12 engine based on the one used in the
Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR, a Le Mans darling...

It recorded an impressive 6:47.50 lap time on
the Nürburgring Nordschleife in 2010.

Impressed? It was a new world record at the time!
zh:
Pagani素来以推出最昂贵和最独特的汽车而闻名，而在其推
出的车款中，Zonda R又自成一系。

此车是专为在赛道上驾驶而设计的，其出色的性能充分
证明了这一点……

全碳纤维制造的车身仅重<1250kg>，令人赞叹不已。

另外，此车还采用了来自于勒芒耐力赛常胜车型
Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR的V12引擎……

2010年，这辆车在纽博格林北侧赛道上做出了令人印象深
刻的6:47.50的单圈时间。

厉害吧？这在当时可是一个新的世界纪录！

en:
When it comes to collectable Porsches, the Carrera GT
is definitely high on everyone's list.

It came equipped with a naturally-aspirated V-10 powerplant
mounted amidships...

...mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox.

It looked the part, too, with an attractive body style that
gave Ferraris a run for their money.

If you're a Porsche fan, then this car belongs in your garage.
zh:
Carrera GT可能是Porsche有史以来最具代表性的跑车。

这款中置引擎车型配备了5.7L自然进气V10引擎……

和一个六速手动变速箱。

清亮的排气声和V10引擎澎湃的动力带来梦寐以求的操控感。

相信您很难再找到一辆比它更大胆、更充满戏剧性的车
款了！

en:
This racing car was developed for the Renault Eurocup Mégane
Trophy, a one-make racing series run by Renault Sport.

Now it may share its name with the Renault Mégane, but
this is no family car—it was built for the circuit!

Sporting a steel-frame body and 3.5L V6 engine mounted
midship...

Its light weight and stellar driving capabilities make it
an absolute beast at taking corners.
zh:
这辆赛车是专为雷诺欧洲杯Mégane奖杯赛而开发的——这项
比赛是由Renault Sport公司举办的单一车种竞速系列赛。

虽然此车与Renault Mégane同名，但并不是什么家庭用车——它可
是为赛道而生的！

该车型采用钢架车身和中置3.5L V6引擎……

轻盈的车身和出色的驾驶能力使其成为过弯的绝对猛兽。

en:
The Prius was the world's first mass-produced hybrid car.
This is the third generation model, released in 2009.

The hybrid system in the third-gen model, introduced in 2009,
was 90% revamped, highlighted by a 1.8-liter inline-4.

The chassis was also significantly improved, making it a
smooth performer on the highway.

Oh, its fuel economy was enhanced as well, which meant that it
remained one of the most fuel-efficient cars in the world.
zh:
Prius是全球首款量产的混合动力汽车。这是它的第三代车
型，于2009年发布。

此车配备了经过90%改造的混合动力系统和1.8L直列四缸发
动机，

甚至底盘也得到了升级，以改善路感！

对了，此车的优秀燃油效率也不可忽视。即使以今天的
标准来看，它的指标也是十分优秀的。/

en:
Among the more noteworthy things about the BMW Z8 was that
it served as James Bond's main ride for a few movies.

While many said it was a sin that Agent 007 had a German car,
you can't argue with its beautiful 507-inspired design.

Under its hood was a 5.0-liter V-8 engine that produced
an impressive <400ps> and <51kgm>.

It was a true driver's car, thanks to its 6-speed
manual gearbox.
zh:
由于出演了007电影中著名的“邦德车”，BMW Z8一跃成为
银幕上的明星。

这款外形靓丽的跑车的设计灵感来自于久负盛名的BMW 507。

在其引擎盖下搭载了一台5L V8引擎，能够产生<400ps>动力和
<51kgm>扭矩。

另外，所有Z8车型都统一使用六速手动变速箱。

en:
What you're looking at is the spiritual successor
to the legendary 300 SL.

The car's long nose and very fancy gullwing doors were
inspired by those of its predecessor.

The SLS AMG came powered by a 6.3-liter V-8
that produced a whopping <571ps>.

While AMG is generally known for creating high-performance
versions of production Mercedes-Benz models...

...this baby was designed completely from scratch.
zh:
您所看到的是传奇车型300 SL的精神继承者！

其长车头与灵感来自前代车型的鸥翼式车门相得益彰。

前中置引擎的SLS AMG拥有一台6.3L V8引擎，能够产生<571ps>的动力。

虽然AMG通常以制造Mercedes-Benz商业车型的高性能版本而闻名……

但这款SLS却是由AMG全新设计的车型。

en:
If you're looking for a mid-engine Ferrari with a naturally-
aspirated V-8, then look no further than the 458 Italia.

Its high-powered engine is capable of revving to <9000rpm>.

And if you mash the throttle pedal and let it scream,
you'll unleash <570ps> of power!

And the 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox allows you to shift
like a Formula 1 race driver.
zh:
如果你正在寻找一辆具有中置引擎布局和自然进气V8引
擎的法拉利，那么458 Italia就是您的最佳选择！

其高功率引擎能够将转速推到<9000rpm>……

在那一刻，您将同时听到和感受到其强劲的<570ps>动力！

此车的7速双离合变速箱则让换挡变得轻而易举。

en:
Lexus has been competing in the GT500 class of the
Super GT series since 2006.

Its first car was the SC 430, which did battle in the
GT500 class.

The car took over the hugely successful Toyota A80 Supra
as Toyota's main entry in the series.

This model, the PETRONAS TOM'S SC 430, captured the
team title for TOM'S in 2008.
zh:
Lexus自2006年以来持续参加日本Super GT的GT500级别比赛。

SC430是他们的第一辆GT500车。

此车在很多方面都可以被视作大获成功的Toyota 80 Supra的
继承者。

这款车型，即2008 PETRONAS TOM'S SC430，正是当年为TOM'S车队
夺得车队冠军的赛车。

en:
The GT by Citroën, unveiled in 2008, was a collaboration
between Citroën and Gran Turismo.

The car you see here is the road-going version of
the concept.

While the original study was powered by electricity, this one
came equipped with a mid-mounted gasoline V-8.

The body was penned by Takumi Yamamoto, a designer
at Citroën.

The lines of the car suggest the intricacies
of Japanese samurai armor.
zh:
Citroën GT来自于Citroën和跑车浪漫旅的合作项目，于2008年
首次亮相。

这辆车是概念车的公路版本。

原概念车是一台电动车，这款公路车则采用了中置V8引
擎，仍以汽油为燃料。

它是由Citroën的设计师山本卓一设计的。

山本的独特设计从日本的盔甲中汲取了大量的灵感。/

en:
The 908 HDi FAP stands out as the star of Peugeot's racing
history at Le Mans.

Designed specifically to compete in the 24 hour race,
its test bed was literally the LMS track itself.

But it wasn't until 2009 that it finally bested the mighty
Audi R10 to win the championship.

This here is the 2010 model.

While it didn't win Le Mans, it did grab the top four spots
in the qualifying races, an incredible feat in itself!
zh:
908 HDi FAP是Peugeot在勒芒24小时耐力赛史上的明星车型。

这辆车是专门为参加24小时赛而设计的，甚至连车辆的
测试都是在勒芒赛道上进行的。

但直到2009年，此车才最终战胜了强大的Audi R10，赢得了勒
芒比赛的冠军。

这里的这一辆是2010年的参赛车型。

虽然没能在当年赢得头衔，但此车在排位赛时将前四名
都收入囊中，这本身就是一个不可思议的壮举！

en:
This here is a McLaren masterpiece!

The MP4-12C was McLaren's first road car since the legendary
F1, and has all the goods you'd expect of the maker.

Its single-piece carbon monocoque was the first of its kind
in a commercially available car...

And its active suspension system is also a stroke
of McLaren genius.

But let's not forget its ultra-powerful 3.8L V8 twin-turbo
midship engine, which is capable of <600ps>!

We had to wait a long time for the successor to the F1,
but there's no doubt it was worth it!
zh:
这一台就是McLaren的杰作啦！

MP4-12C是McLaren自推出传奇的Mclaren F1以来的第一辆公路车，
不负众望地凝聚了制造商的所有优点。

其一体式碳纤维单体结构是首次下放到公开发售的商业
车型……

主动悬挂系统则是McLaren的研发天才们的巧思。

同时也别忘了这辆车超强的3.8L V8双涡轮增压中置引擎，
它能达到<600ps>的动力！

我们为F1的继任者等待了很长时间，但毫无疑问，这场
等待是值得的！

en:
Even after several generations, the original Audi TT
still manages to look and feel fresh.

It shared its chassis with the Audi A3, although the
wheelbase was shortened by <90mm>.

Its compact nature made it incredibly agile.

Here is the 3.2 quattro, which was added to the lineup
in 2003.

Its smooth 3.2-liter V-6 engine sent <250ps> to
all four wheels.
zh:
即使经历了数代的更迭，原版Audi TT的地位并未受到影响。

TT的底盘来自于Audi A3，但轴距缩短了<90mm>……

从而获得了出类拔萃的操控性能！

这里展示的是2003年加入产品线的3.2 quattro，

其强大的3.2L V6引擎能够提供<250ps>的动力。

en:
This version of the SLS AMG was developed to comply
with FIA GT3 regulations.

While it retains the engine of the commercial model, its
sequential six-speed transmission is built for racing.

It's also much more aerodynamic than its predecessor!

In 2011, the year of its debut, it ran in a whopping 101
races, and managed to win 25 of them.
zh:
这个版本的SLS AMG是为了符合FIA GT3规则而开发的。

此车保留了商业车型的引擎，序列式六速变速箱则是专
为赛车而设计的。

此外，此车的空气动力学表现也要优于前代车型！

在2011年，也就是该车型首次亮相的那一年，它一共参加
了多达101场比赛，并成功地赢得了其中25场的冠军。

en:
If you're searching for a powerful FF sports car,
I would recommend the Scirocco R.

It comes with upgraded suspension and brakes, and turbocharged
2.0-liter inline-4 that produced <250ps>.

While its specs are similar to the Golf R, it is about <120kg>
lighter, thanks to the absence of the 4WD system.

You can really feel the weight difference when
taking sharp corners.
zh:
如果您想寻找一辆动力出众的前置前驱跑车，我推荐Scirocco R！

此车配备了升级的悬挂和刹车系统，以及一台2L直列四
缸涡轮增压引擎，可以产生<250ps>动力。

虽然规格上与Golf R相似，但由于去掉了四驱系统，所以
重量要比后者轻<120kg>。

在过急弯时，您就可以切实感受到这种差异了。{

en:
Flashy scissor doors and big V-12 engines have been signatures
of Lamborghini for a while now.

Every flagship model produced by the company since
the Countach had them.

As did the 2011 Aventador.

The engine in this beauty pumped out a massive <700ps>.

The car also featured a carbon-fiber monocoque and a pushrod
suspension system.

Needless to say, it was designed for the race track although
it was an easy car to drive on the open road.
zh:
长期以来，V12引擎和华丽的剪刀门一直是Lamborghini的标志性
体验。

自Countach以来，这两者都会同时出现在该公司生产的每一款
旗舰车型上……

2011年的Aventador也不例外！

这款超级跑车的V12引擎可以输出<700ps>的澎湃动力。

此车还配备了碳纤维单体车身和推杆悬挂系统。

这辆车绝对是为赛道而生的，也是它的极致魅力之一。*

en:
The BMW Z4 GT3 is a FIA GT3 racing car.

This 2011 model comes with a 4.4L V8 engine capable of
generating <515ps>.

It also has a sequential six-speed manual transmission
with paddle shifters.

Not only has the car scored two wins in the FIA GT3
European Championship...

It's also been a star performer at the Nürburgring and
Spa 24-hour endurance races...

Where, on both occasions, it managed to claim
an impressive second place!
zh:
宝马Z4 GT3是一款国际汽联GT3规格的赛车。

这款2011年的车型配备了4.4升V8引擎，能够产生<515ps>的动力，

以及一套带拨片换挡装置的序列式六速手动变速箱。

这辆车不仅在国际汽联GT3欧洲锦标赛中斩获两胜……

同时也是纽博格林和斯帕24小时耐力赛的明星选手……

在当年的赛事中，它都成功地取得了第二名的好成绩，
给人留下深刻的印象！

en:
This tuned Mazda MX-5 was based on the
first-generation model.

Nearly every aspect of the car was improved, from its engine
to its upgraded suspension system.

It was also lightened and made more durable.

The changes to its chassis resulted in a more neutral handling
balance, which makes it a blast to drive on the race track.
zh:
这款改装车型基于第一代Mazda MX-5研发而来，

并接受了全方位的优化改造——引擎微调、悬挂升级……

而且还变得更轻、更结实！

与众不同的是，在这样的改造后，它还能够保留中性的
转向特质，因此极为适合在赛道上狂飙突进！

en:
Austrian manufacturer KTM is generally known for
producing high-performance motorcycles.

But it changed the script with the X-Bow.

This mid-engine car comes equipped with turbocharged
2.0-liter engine built by Audi.

Despite being an automobile, the X-Bow still has the feel
of a motorcycle, with no doors or windows.

What's more, its carbon-fiber monocoque structure makes it
incredibly lightweight at <790kg>.
zh:
奥地利车厂KTM通常以生产摩托车而为人熟知。

事实上，X-Bow是他们生产的第一辆汽车！

这是一款中置引擎车型，搭载Audi公司制造的2L涡轮增压
引擎。

外观上看，X-Bow更像一辆摩托车，而且也没有车门和车窗，

碳纤维单体结构的应用使得车重出奇的轻，仅为<790kg>，让
人叹为观止。{

en:
The M3 GT is a racing model that stands out among the M3
line-up.

Tailored for the FIA GT2 category, which allows cars
to be significantly modified...

It sports a tuned V8 engine, capable of generating <500ps>—
A step up from its fourth generation base model.

What’s more, it’s also much lighter than its predecessor,
thanks to the copious use of carbon panels in its body.

The car was crowned overall champion at the Nürburgring
24 Hours in 2010...
zh:
M3 GT是一款在M3车系中脱颖而出的赛车车型，

针对国际汽联GT2类别量身定做——该赛事类别允许对汽车进行
重大改装……

此车装备有经过特殊调校的V8引擎，能够产生<500ps>的动力——
比其第四代基础车型更上一层楼。

更重要的是，由于车身大量使用了碳纤维板件，车重较
其前代车型大幅下降。

在2010年纽博格林24小时耐力赛上，这台车不负众望，加
冕了总冠军……

en:
You're looking at the Audi's prototype race car called
the R18 TDI.

Built in 2011, the R18 TDI was primarily used in endurance
races such as the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

It was raced by Team Joest, which worked closely with Audi
in many of its race efforts.

Providing the power was a turbocharged 3.7-liter V6
diesel engine that produced <540ps>!

In the Le Mans race in 2011, it famously battled with
Peugeot, where it proved victorious.
zh:
这款车是Audi的原型赛车R18 TDI的2011款车型。

R18 TDI主要被用于参加各项耐力赛，如勒芒24小时耐力赛……

在勒芒比赛中驾驶此车的车队是与Audi紧密合作的乔斯特
车队。

R18 TDI的核心是一台3.7L V6柴油涡轮增压引擎，可以产生<540ps>
的动力！

在2011年的勒芒比赛中，此车在与Peugeot的激烈角逐中最终胜
出，继而名声大噪。$

en:
The Toyota Aqua was a smaller version of the popular Prius,
equipped with the same hybrid technology.

Not only was it super fuel efficient, Toyota made the car
fun to drive!

Note that the battery is located under the rear seats.

This allows for a lower center of gravity, which in turn,
results in better handling balance.
zh:
Toyota Aqua通过与Prius共享的混合动力技术获益不少：

不仅超级省油，而且驾驶体验尚佳！

请注意，此车的电池位于后座下面……

这项创新设计能够降低车辆重心，从而改善其操控性。

en:
Tesla is a pioneer in the manufacturing of electric
vehicles, and the Model S is its most iconic car.

You won't believe how fabulous it feels to drive!

Thanks to its low centre of gravity, typical of electric
vehicles, it handles like a dream.

And wait till you see how well it takes corners—
It’s just like a fully-fledged sports car!
zh:
Tesla是制造电动车的先驱，而Model S是其最具代表性的车型。

您不会相信它的驾驶感觉有多么美妙！

由于这辆车具有典型电动汽车的低重心优势，因此在操
控方面能提供无与伦比的体验。

还是等您亲身感受一下它的过弯能力吧，和成熟的跑车
完全不相上下！

en:
The GT-R NISMO GT3 was designed for GT3-class racing
by Nissan's motorsports arm, NISMO.

The car you see here was prepared by a privateer, who
entered it in the Nürburgring 24 Hours in 2013.

And, here's an interesting tidbit, it was driven by
Kazunori Yamauchi, producer of Gran Turismo!

Which is why it comes loaded with simulation data from
Gran Turismo.

You might say it's more than just a car. We consider it
an integral part of Gran Turismo history!
zh:
GT-R NISMO GT3是一辆由Nissan和NISMO共同设计的GT3类别赛车。

此车由一家私人车队开发，并在2013年参加了纽博格林24
小时耐力赛。

跑车浪漫旅系列游戏的制作人山内一典曾驾驶过此车，

上面甚至还装载了来自跑车浪漫旅的模拟数据。

可以说这不仅仅是一辆车——而是跑车浪漫旅历史
上不可或缺的一部分。

en:
The R.S. Trophy is a high-performance model that is
based on the third generation Mégane.

Featuring a specially tuned 2L straight-four engine...

It offers plenty of torque in the mid-RPM range, and an
exciting sense of power once you hit the higher revs.

The R.S.'s main USP, however, is its suspension, which is
designed to improve the grounding of the front tyres...

Meaning the car responds well when entering corners,
without sacrificing any capacity for exiting them.

In short, it lets you keep the pedal to the metal
for longer!
zh:
R.S. Trophy是一款基于第三代梅甘娜研发的高性能车型，

配备了经过特别调校的2升直列四缸引擎……

此车在中段转速范围内可提供充沛的扭矩，而进入高转
速区后，令人兴奋的动力感则会源源不断。

然而，R.S.系列的最大优点在于其悬挂，在设计时着重改
善了前轮胎的抓地性……

因此该车不仅在进入弯道时反应良好，而且不必牺牲任
何出弯的能力。

简而言之，可以让您有更多的时间踩住油门！

en:
Sure it’s small, but there is absolutely no doubt that
the Mercedes-Benz AMG A45 is the real deal!

It came with a 2.0-liter inline-4 under its hood that delivered
a surprisingly potent punch.

Combine that with its 4WD drivetrain, which provides excellent
stability, this thing is a blast to drive on a race track.
zh:
毫无疑问，Mercedes-Benz AMG A45娇小玲珑。但卓越性能不减！

此车装载了一台拥有世界顶级性能的2L直列四缸引擎……

四驱传动系统和出色的稳定性让它成为了稳定过弯和直
道冲刺的完美选择！

en:
The third-generation Dodge Viper was definitely
in a class of its own.

The secret to its enhanced performance was a stronger
chassis with 50 percent more torsional rigidity.

This made it more stable through corners, so it handled better
than its predecessor, which is quite scary if you ask me.
zh:
第三代Dodge Viper的外观设计和驾驶体验自成一派！

它的性能提高秘诀在于更牢固的底盘，将抗扭刚性提升
了足足50%……

这意味着其能为驾驶者提供充足的动力以及精确的操控。

en:
The C7 is the seventh generation Corvette.

Those looking for a true FR sports car driving experience
need look no further!

Its 6.2L V8 LT1 engine...

packs a big punch, capable of <461ps> and <63kgm>
of torque.

And the rigidity of its new aluminium frame has greatly
improved the car's handling.

Having made its debut on Corvette's 60th anniversary...

The C7 was the first model since the C2 to be granted
The legendary Corvette Stingray name!
zh:
C7代表第七代Corvette。

如果您正在寻找真正的前置后驱跑车驾驶体验，有这辆
车就够了！

此车的6.2L V8 LT1引擎……

蕴含着巨大的动力，能够产生<461ps>动力和<63kgm>的扭矩。

新的铝制车架的刚性大大改善了车辆的操控。

在Corvette品牌60周年纪念日首次亮相后……

C7被命名为Corvette Stingray，是自C2以来第一个再度获得
这一传奇名号的车型。

en:
This fifth generation Polo GTI is a petite hot hatch
that's a size smaller than the Golf...

Which stands to reason, as the original Polo debuted
in 1975 as the Golf’s 'little brother'.

This generation Polo GTI came with two different engines
depending on whether it is an early model or late model,

But this is the late model that debuted in 2014,
which came with a turbocharged 1.8L inline-4 cylinder engine.

It's capable of producing <192ps> and <25.5kgm> of torque
from just <1250rpm>!

Small but speedy, this model also features an upgraded
chassis and improved handling.
zh:
这台第五代Polo GTI是一款身材娇小的高性能掀背车，它的
尺寸比Golf还要小……

有鉴于原版Polo在1975年就是作为Golf的“小弟”首次亮相，
这也是理所当然的。

这一代Polo GTI的早期车型和晚期车型使用了不同的引擎，

您眼前的这款是2014年亮相的晚期车型，它有一台涡轮增
压的1.8L直列四缸引擎，

能在仅仅<1250rpm>的转速下，产生<192ps>的动力和<25.5kgm>的扭矩！

小而轻快就是它的代名词。此外，这款第五代产品的底
盘和操控也经过了改进！

en:
The 2005 Veyron was many car enthusiasts' introduction to
the Bugatti brand.

It was the first commercially available car produced by the
company since its revival in 1998!

The elegant proportions of its design are complemented by
the car's 8L midship W16 engine.

This engine can generate more than <1000ps> of power,
allowing the car to reach speeds of over <400km/h>!

Only 400 of these cars were ever made, with production
ceasing in 2015.
zh:
2005布加迪Veryron或许是许多汽车爱好者接触到布加迪品牌的契机。

这是该公司自1998年重生以来生产出的第一款商业化车型！

颀长且优雅的车身比例与8升的W16中置引擎配合无间。

这款引擎可以产生超过<1000ps>的动力，将汽车的时速推到<400km/h>！

在2015年停产之前，布加迪Veryron总共只生产了400辆。|

en:
The 2013 Mercedes-Benz AMG VGT was the first car created for
the Vision Gran Turismo project.

Its design was inspired by the legendary Mercedes-Benz
300 SL, which was released in 1952.

The car's designers also drew inspiration from the dynamic
movement of big cats on the prowl.

It featured a lightweight carbon-fiber body, aluminum
space frame and a twin-turbocharged 5.5-liter V-8...

...which produced <585ps>, enough to outrun a GT3 race car!
zh:
2013梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG VGT是跑车浪漫旅愿景项目创作的
第一台车。

其设计灵感取自1952年发布的传奇车型梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SL。

该车的设计师还从大型猫科动物潜行捕猎时的动态中获
得了灵感。

除了轻量级的碳纤维车身和铝制空间车架外，此车还配
备一台5.5升V8双涡轮增压引擎……

可以产生<585ps>的动力——甚至超越了GT3类别的赛车！

en:
The spirit of the GTI was glorified with the GTI Roadster
Vision Gran Turismo!

This sporty, open-top 2-seater is a stunner!

You'll notice that its body makes use of various design
motifs from previous GTI models.

But perhaps the most striking aspect of its design
is the incredibly low-cut windscreen.

Appearances aside, it comes powered by a potent <510ps>
twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6.

Power is transferred to all four wheels, making this thing
an amazing handling machine.
zh:
GTI的精神在GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo车型上得到了
完美延续！

这款动感十足的敞篷双座车是一件真正的尤物！

您或许已经注意到其车身设计上对前几代GTI的诸多借鉴。

不过，最引人注目的设计可能还是那低平到令人难以置
信的挡风玻璃！

撇开外观不谈，此车配备了一台高功率的<510ps>的3升V6双涡
轮增压引擎，

与四驱系统形成良好的组合，可在赛道上提供巨大动力！>

en:
The Genesis Coupe 3.8 Track is an FR sports car,
equipped with a <350ps> 3.8-liter V-6.

Sharing its basic platform with the Genesis, Hyundai's
luxury sedan...

...the Track model of the Coupe 3.8 has been tuned for
increased performance.

Its specially designed suspension system and upgraded brakes
make it a beast on twisty roads.
zh:
Genesis Coupe 3.8 Track是一款前置后驱的跑车，配备了<350ps>动力的
3.8升 V6引擎。

此车与Hyundai的豪华轿车品牌Genesis采用相同的平台……

这款Track车型接受过调校以提升驾驶性能……

并配有专门设计的悬挂系统和升级的刹车系统。

en:
This go-kart-style vehicle is a Gran Turismo original!

Equipped with a sequential six-speed manual transmission
and front brakes...

It feels a lot like a formula car to drive!

In fact, it can even reach speeds of up to <200km/h>,
depending on its gear ratio.

So don't let its appearance fool you—this is one zippy ride!
zh:
这辆卡丁车模样的赛车是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型！

搭载序列式六速手动变速箱和前轮刹车……

事实上，此车的驾驶感觉更像一辆方程式赛车！

在进行齿轮比设置后，其时速甚至可以达到<200km/h>。

因此，不要被这辆车的外表迷惑了——这是一辆活力四
射、灵活迅捷的车！

en:
This hypothetical fan car was developed by Gran Turismo
in partnership with Red Bull Racing.

But don’t let name 'Standard' fool you—it's actually
the higher-performing sibling of the X2014 Junior.

Under its bonnet is a 2L straight-four turbo engine
that can generate <810ps> of power.

Employing a Venturi car design, the Standard boasts
increased downforce...

Which essentially means that air pressure on the car
adapts to changes in its speed.

It’s fascinating! In fact, you might learn a thing or two
about aerodynamics just driving this beauty!
zh:
这款架空的爱好者车型是由跑车浪漫旅与红牛车队
联合开发的。

但不要被名称中的“Standard”字样所迷惑了，它可是红牛
X2014 Junior的兄弟车，而且是高性能版本。

其引擎盖下安装着一台2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎，可以
产生<810ps>的动力。

这辆Standard还安装了文丘里管扩散器，以提供更大的下压力……

这意味着车身所受的空气下压力会因为速度而发生变化，

是相当惊人的设计！事实上，试着驾驶一下这台美丽的
车，您或许能对空气动力学有所体会！

en:
This hypothetical fan car was developed by Gran Turismo
in partnership with Red Bull Racing.

Considered an entry-level model, as opposed to the
higher-performing X2014 Standard...

Its highly aerodynamic body makes it a great choice for
anyone looking to learn how to drive a formula car.

It comes equipped with a <250ps> 2L straight-four engine.
zh:
这款架空的爱好者车型是由跑车浪漫旅与红牛车队
联合开发的。

相对于性能更高的X2014 Standard而言，这是一台入门车……

其车身在空气动力学方面进行了高度优化，是任何想学
习驾驶方程式赛车的人的最佳选择。

安装在这台车上的是一台<250ps>的2L直列四缸引擎。

en:
While Pagani is a relative newcomer to the
exclusive supercar world...

...its creations have certainly made a splash in the
short time they've been around.

The Huayra, successor to the Zonda, is one such car.

Featuring a carbon-fiber and titanium monocoque frame...

...it had a Mercedes-Benz AMG twin-turbo 6.0-liter V-12...

...which pumped out <700ps> and <102kgm> of torque.
That's definite super-car territory.

Indeed, company founder, Horacio Pagani, is quite proud
of his magnificent work of rolling art!<
zh:
虽然对于超级跑车世界来说，Pagani是一位相对较新的成员……

但不可否认，它们的作品在极短的时间内就引起了巨大
的轰动！

Huayra，Zonda的继任者，就是一个完美的例子。

此车使用了碳纤维和钛合金混合单体车架……

以及一台Mercedes-AMG 6L双涡轮增压V12引擎

为车辆提供世界一流的性能—<700ps>的动力和<102kgm>的扭矩！

我敢打赌，就连霍拉西奥·帕加尼都会这样的伟大艺术
作品感到自豪的！

en:
The Toyota FT-1 was a concept car that was unveiled at
the 2014 North American International Auto Show.

Its design was used as the inspiration for the
production model of the GR Supra.

Toyota's North American design studio, Calty, led the
design process of this flashy sports car.

Look closely and you may notice that it was partly inspired
by previous Toyota FR sports cars!
zh:
丰田FT-1是一款概念赛车，在2014年北美国际车展上首次亮相。

此车的设计最终成为了GR Supra量产车型的灵感来源。

丰田的北美设计工作室Calty主导了这款车的开发。

您可以明显看到车身部分与前几代丰田前置后驱跑车之间的渊源！

sourceName: Aston Martin DP-100 Vision Gran Turismo
en:
The Aston Martin DP-100 Vision Gran Turismo is a product of
the Aston Martin design team, led by Marek Reichman.

A mesmerising blend of the brand’s past and future, it is,
as the 'DP' in its name suggest, a 'design prototype'.

Sporting, a midship twin-turbo V12 engine, the DP-100
is capable of delivering up to <811ps>.

The fact that it's one of the few midship cars Aston Martin
has ever produced only adds to its appeal!
zh:
Aston Martin DP-100 Vision Gran Turismo是由
马雷克·莱克曼领导的Aston Martin设计团队的作品，

精妙地融合了品牌的过去和未来。正如其名称中的“DP”
所示，这只是一台“设计原型”……

DP-100采用了中置的双涡轮增压V12引擎，能够提供高达<811ps>的
动力。

作为Aston Martin有史以来的少数几辆中置引擎车型之一，令它
的收藏魅力大增！

en:
In 2013, the BMW 4 Series was created to serve as the coupe
version of the company's popular 3 Series sedan.

Therefore, the M4 represented the top-of-the-line performance
version, taking the place of the M3 coupe.

Released in 2014, the M4 had rear-wheel drive...

...and came powered by a turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6.

This powerful front-mounted engine cranked out <431ps>
and <56.1kgm> of torque!
zh:
在2013年，BMW 4系作为3系双门车型的迭代品牌而诞生。

M4则是4系车型中的高性能版本，同时也是M3的继任者。

此车于2014年发布，是一款后轮驱动的跑车……

该车配备了3L涡轮增压直列六缸引擎，

这台强力机器可以产生高达<431ps>的动力和<56.1kgm>的扭矩！

en:
The RX-8 is a rotary FR sports car with four doors and
four seats.

Its unusual combination of features makes it quite a find!

This particular model is the Spirit R, the last of
the RX-8s.

It's equipped with a <235ps> naturally aspirated engine and
six-speed manual transmission.

It feels velvety smooth to drive, and it handles flawlessly!
zh:
RX-8是一款四门四座的转子引擎前置后驱跑车。

这一不同寻常的搭配使其成为了一件世上罕见的珍品！

我们的这台车是Spirit R，RX-8系列的最后一个车型。

此车配备了一台动力为<235ps>的自然进气引擎和六速手动变
速箱。

其驾驶感受如天鹅绒般顺滑，操控感也无懈可击！

sourceName: Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo Racing Series
en:
The track version of the Mercedes-Benz AMG
Vision Gran Turismo is one monster of a car.

The base model's tuned engine is equipped with
a powerful racing transmission!

Weighing <85kg> less than its predecessor, it goes and handles
better than you could ever imagine.
zh:
这辆车是Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo的赛道版。

基础车型的引擎经过调校后，配备了强大的赛车变速箱！

其重量比前代车型轻<85kg>，优秀的操控性超出您的想象。

en:
Inspired by the BMWs that made waves in the touring car
championships of the ‘70s...

The BMW Vision Gran Turismo is sure to remind you
of the classic touring cars of yesteryear.

Naturally, BMW's very own design team was responsible
for bringing this vision to life.

Under the bonnet, you’ll find a 3L straight-six
turbo engine.

And as you might expect, this FR model has
a perfect 50:50 axle load distribution.

Believe it or not, this road racer weighs a mere
<1180kg>!
zh:
BMW Vision Gran Turismo的设计灵感来自于那些在70年代的
房车锦标赛中大包大揽的BMW……

看到它，您会不由得想起昔日的经典房车。

在意料之内，这一愿景很快就在BMW自己的设计团队的手
下化为了现实。

在它的引擎盖下，装载着一个3L直列六缸涡轮增压引擎。

您可以想见，这款前置后驱车型同样拥有完美的50:50轴负
荷分配。

还有，这款公路赛车的重量仅有<1180kg>！是不是很难以置信？

en:
Radical is a small English sports car manufacturer...

Whose SR3 SL may look like a race car, but is legally
permitted to drive on public roads!

Featuring a Ford Focus 2L straight-four turbo engine, this
car is capable of <240ps> despite only weighing <775kg>.

Also, its chassis is extremely simple, with no
electronic components whatsoever.

True racing enthusiasts will get a kick out of this one!
zh:
Radical是一家小型英国跑车制造商……

他们的SR3 SL在外形上可能更像一辆赛车，但却是能合法
在公共道路上行驶的！

此车装载了一台Ford Focus 2L直列四缸涡轮增压发动机，能够
提供<240ps>的动力，整车重量却只有<775kg>。

而且，此车的底盘做到了极致精简，没有安装任何电子
元件。

真正的赛车爱好者一定会从驾驶这辆车中得到无比的乐趣！

sourceName: Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION Vision Gran Turismo
en:
This model served as the inspiration for
the Mitsubishi Concept XR-PHEV....

...which was unveiled at the Tokyo Motor Show
in 2013.

Known as the Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION VGT, it is powered
by an innovative plug-in hybrid system.

It also had an 8-speed dual-clutch transmission that
managed the impressive power of the drivetrain.

What’s more, it handled exceptionally well, thanks to
Mitsubishi's S-AWC 4-wheel-drive technology.
zh:
Mitsubishi Concept XR-PHEV于2013年的东京车展上亮相……

这款车型正是其灵感来源。

这款车的真实名称是Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION VGT，
采用了创新的插入式混合动力系统……

并配备了一款八速双离合器变速箱，能输出相当劲爆的
动力……

在Mitsubishi的S-AWC四轮驱动技术的加持下，
它的操控性也相当出众。

en:
This car was inspired by the seventh-generation
Volkswagen Golf, often referred to as the Golf VII.

Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 that delivers
up to <220ps> of power and <35.7kgm> of torque.

Its rigid chassis allows for stable and razor sharp
handling through even the trickiest of corners.

You're sure to have a thrilling and satisfying ride!
zh:
这款车是以通称Golf VII的第七代Volkswagen Golf为原型，

配备有2L直列四缸涡轮增压发动机，可提供高达<220ps>的动
力和<35.7kgm>的扭矩，

结实、坚固的底盘为道路上的精准操控提供支持，

为您带来高速而令人满意的驾驶体验！

en:
After the Jaguar E-Type came the Jaguar F-Type, a sporty
rear-wheel-drive sports car for the modern age.

This particular model is the high-performance version
released in 2012.

It comes equipped with a supercharged 5.0-liter V-8
that produces <50ps> more than the base model...

...bringing the grand total to an impressive <550ps>!
zh:
继Jaguar E-type之后，跑车型后轮驱动车型Jaguar F-type也
粉墨登场。

这里的这一台是2012年发布的高性能版本，

配备了一台5L机械增压V8引擎，能够提供比标准车型多
<50ps>的动力……

达到令人咋舌的<550ps>！/

en:
Are you familiar with the Ford Mustang Mach 1 and GT40?

As the name suggests, the Mach 40 pays tribute to both of
these classic American race cars.

Produced by Eckert's Rod and Custom based in Oregon...

...this company specializes in custom restorations,
even creating original models from other cars.

This car has a fully customized body style of a
1969 Ford Mustang.

And it comes powered by the Ford GT's 5.4-liter V-8 engine,
mounted amidships.

This mesmerizing blend of two classics took home
the 2012 SEMA Gran Turismo Award!
zh:
不知道您是否听过Ford Mustang Mach 1和GT40？

Mach 40正如其名，是对这两款美国经典车型的致敬。

此车由位于俄勒冈州的Eckert's Rod and Custom生产……

这是一家专门从事定制修复工作的改装公司……

其车身是对1969 Ford Mustang的完全定制，

内里是Ford出品一台GT 5.4L V8引擎，采用中置布局……

这款令人着迷的混合改装车获得了2012年美国汽车用品改
装协会大展（SEMA）的Grand Turismo Awards奖！

en:
The TS030 Hybrid was Toyota's first ever hybrid race car,
designed for endurance events.

Developed to compete in the 2012 24 Hours of Le Mans
and World Endurance Championship...

...Toyota spent years refining its THS-R hybrid system.

The final product was realized through a collaboration between
Higashi-Fuji Technical Center and Toyota Motorsport.

Although its debut at Le Mans fell short of
the company's expectations...

It went on to claim an impressive 2nd place in the WEC!
zh:
TS030 Hybrid是Toyota有史以来制造的第一款混合动力赛车原型车，

是专门为参加2012年勒芒24小时耐力赛和世界耐力锦标赛
而开发的……

Toyota花费了数年时间完善其THS-R混合动力系统。

最终产品在东富士技术中心和Toyota Motorsport的通力合作下
诞生。

虽然未能在勒芒耐力赛的首次亮相中取得期望的成绩……

但随后在世界耐力锦标赛上技惊四座，夺得了亚军！

en:
The coachbuilding company Zagato is a legendary name
in the sports car world.

It should come as no surprise that Gran Turismo
decided to collaborate with the famed Italian company.

The design of this car was inspired by the Iso Rivolta,
an iconic tourer from the 1960s.

It was created as a vehicle that could compete
in the world's top racing events.

Underneath its very Zagato-esque body was a Callaway
4.5-liter V-8.

This powerplant pumped out a crazy <567ps>!
zh:
车身制造公司Zagato对于车迷而言是一个传奇的招牌……

而这辆车就是Zagato和跑车浪漫旅合作的结果！

其设计灵感来自60年代的标志性豪华旅行车Iso Rivolta。

由于车辆的设计师希望此车能够参加世界顶级的赛车比赛，

所以为非常具有Zagato风格的车身搭配了一台Callaway 4.5L V8
发动机……

能够输出不可思议的<567ps>动力！

sourceName: SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo
en:
The VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo was all about Subaru's
pursuit of delivering a great driving experience.

Armed with a powerful hybrid power unit...

...this machine is powered by turbocharged 2.0-liter
flat-4 engine and three powerful electrical motors.

The power is distributed to all four wheels via Subaru's
all-wheel-drive system.

And the car's appearance is striking, is it not?

By the way, a fun fact about this design...

...it was inspired by the world's hardest food: "katsuobushi,"
a Japanese delicacy made of dried and fermented tuna!
zh:
VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo体现了Subaru对终极驾驶体验的
全部追求。

此车搭载有强大的混合动力单元：

包括一台2L的水平对置涡轮增压四缸引擎和三台动力出
众的电机……

并输送至Subaru传统的全时四轮驱动系统上。

这样的设计令人眼前一亮！

顺便分享一个关于这辆车的设计小趣闻：

其灵感来自于世界上最难入口的食物：“鲣节”，一种
由干燥并发酵过的金枪鱼制成的日本美食！

en: Buddy_ContentCar_BrandCentralOwner_normal_beat_91_1020171
zh: Buddy_ContentCar_BrandCentralOwner_normal_beat_91_1020171

en:
The V12 Vantage was built to comply with FIA GT3 regulations
for 2012.

It comes with a 5.9L V12 engine, and is a whopping <1250kg>
lighter than its predecessor!

This car has seen plenty of success on the race track,
both in England and around the world.
zh:
这台V12 Vantage是为了符合2012年的国际汽联GT3规则而制造的，

配有5.9升V12引擎，而且车重降低到了<1250kg>，比前代车型要轻
得多！

这款车随后在英国和世界各地的多条赛道上取得了莫大
的成功。

en:
The Toyota FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo is a car that redefines
the future of racing!

Its design is based on the FT-1, which was developed in the
pursuit of functional beauty.

You could say that this model takes that concept
to an entirely new level.

The large spoilers at the front and rear were installed after
closely studying their aerodynamic effect on the car.

It's clear no compromises were made on its styling,
either!
zh:
Toyota FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo是一款纯粹的赛车，
并将重新定义赛车的未来！

其设计原型FT-1是一款为追求功能之美而开发的汽车。

而这款Vision Gran Turismo车型又将这一理念提升到了全新的
高度！

前侧轮拱处和后部的扰流板是在对空气动力学进行了广
泛研究的基础上添加的，

而且我们可以看到，它在设计方面完全没有做出妥协！

en:
The 4C is Alfa Romeo's first ever mass-produced mid-engined
sports car.

It uses a carbon monocoque that helps brings its entire
weight down to a mere <900kg>!

You'll find the rigidity of its body also improves the
precision of its handling.

Its design references the Alfa Romeo Tipo 33/2 Stradale—
a car once called 'the most beautiful in the world'!
zh:
4C是Alfa Romeo有史以来第一次大规模量产的中置引擎跑车。

碳纤维单体结构帮助其将车身的整体重量降至仅有<900kg>！

同时其车身的刚性提高了操控时的精准性。

这款车的设计还大量参考了Alfa Romeo Tipo 33/2 Stradal——
曾被誉为“世界上最美丽”的汽车！

en:
Many of Alpine's creations were successful race cars,
most notably in the WRC or at Le Mans.

The design of the Alpine Vision Gran Turismo was inspired
by some of those cars, including the A210 and A442B.

As you can see, it features an unusual single-seater design...

...which makes it lightweight and incredibly agile!

It also has side air brakes and other cool features
that are meant to enhance your driving experience.
zh:
Alpine的许多车型都曾在世界拉力锦标赛或勒芒耐力赛中取
得传奇般的成就，拥有极高的地位。

这辆Alpine Vision Gran Turismo的设计灵感就来自于其中的一些
经典车型，如A210和A442B。

正如你所看到的，此车采用了非常规的单座设计……

以此实现了轻量化和异常灵敏的操控！

这辆车还配备有侧空气制动器和一系列便捷功能，能大
幅改善您的驾驶体验！

en:
Chaparral was a maverick company that shook the racing world
in the 1960s.

Time and time again, they pulled off unique feats of
engineering, producing some truly unique race cars.

The Chevrolet Chaparral 2X Vision Gran Turismo is a tribute
to the Chaparral of decades past.

It doesn't just have an unusual body—everything about this
car defies convention!

For starters, it's powered by an innovative laser-based
propulsion system.

And its unusual configuration, which places the driver in a
face-down position, was inspired by the MotoGP experience.

The spirit of Jim Hall, founder of Chaparral, is truly
embodied in this audacious masterpiece!
zh:
Chaparral是一家特立独行的公司，曾在20世纪60年代震撼整个
赛车界。

他们一次又一次地完成了绝无仅有的工程壮举，生产出一
批真正独特的赛车。

Chevrolet Chaparral 2X Vision Gran Turismo是对
Chaparral过去数十年历史的致敬之作。

不止是车身不同寻常——此车的一切都在打破惯例！

首先，此车由创新的激光推进系统提供动力，

而其将驾驶员置于面朝下位置的非常规布局则受到MotoGP的
启发。

Chaparral创始人Jim Hall的创新精神在这件大胆的杰作中得到了真
正的体现。

sourceName: SRT Tomahawk S Vision Gran Turismo
en:
Dodge's 3 Vision Gran Turismo cars represent the company's
vision for how racing will look in twenty years.

The SRT Tomahawk S VGT is considered the entry-level model.

Cutting-edge materials like carbon and graphene bring its
weight down to a mere <900kg>.

And despite the 'entry-level' tag, the engine is capable of
delivering more than <1000ps>!

I'd recommend trying to master this model before moving on
to the two more advanced ones!
zh:
Dodge的3辆Vision Gran Turismo汽车代表了该公司对20年后
赛车行业发展的设想。

SRT Tomahawk S VGT是3台车中的入门级车型。

得益于碳纤维和石墨烯等尖端制造材料的应用，其重量
降至仅<900kg>。

尽管挂着“入门级”的标签，但它的引擎能够提供超过
<1000ps>的动力！

建议您在上手另两款更高级的车型之前，先尝试掌握这款车！

sourceName: SRT Tomahawk GTS-R Vision Gran Turismo
en:
Dodge's 3 Vision Gran Turismo cars represent the company's
vision for how racing will look in twenty years.

The SRT Tomahawk GTS-R VGT was specially designed for the
racing circuit.

Its V10 engine and pneumatic system are able to produce a
whopping <1500ps>!

And did I mention the car only weighs <663kg>?

It's so fast the car even comes with a specially designed
G-suit to protect the driver!
zh:
Dodge的3辆Vision Gran Turismo汽车代表了该公司对20年后
赛车行业发展的设想。

SRT Tomahawk GTS-R VGT是专门为赛车场设计的车款。

其V10引擎和气动系统能够产生令人震撼的<1500ps>动力！

更值得一提的是这辆车的重量仅仅只有<663kg>！

鉴于这辆车的速度过快，它甚至配备了专门设计的重力加速度
防护服来保护车手！

sourceName: SRT Tomahawk X Vision Gran Turismo
en:
Dodge's 3 Vision Gran Turismo cars represent the company's
vision for how racing will look in twenty years.

And the SRT Tomahawk X VGT is the most advanced
of the three.

Its design was inspired by the concept of challenging
human boundaries.

That should explain why the engine was designed
to produce <2500ps>!

The creators imagined that the car would reach speeds
that would push the limits of human reflexes.

Movable aerodynamic panels, like those found on a fighter
jet, are affixed to its body to provide maximum downforce.

All this and more allow you to take corners in this car at
speeds of <500km/h>!;
zh:
Dodge的3辆Vision Gran Turismo汽车代表了该公司对20年后
赛车行业发展的设想。

这款SRT Tomahawk X VGT是3台车中最先进的一款！

其设计理念追求的是对人类极限的挑战。

这可能就是为什么此车的引擎最大输出功率能够达到<2500ps>
的原因！

在设计师的预想中，这台车的运行速度将挑战人类反应
速度的极限。

另外，车身上还装载了战斗机同款的可动空气动力学翼片，

这项技术奇迹将帮助您以高达<500km/h>的速度过弯。

en:
Ferrari is known for making the sweetest-sounding V-12s ever.

In fact, the company's very first production car in 1947
came equipped with a V-12.

This F12berlinetta continued the trend with its 12-cylinder
powerplant mounted up front.

It boasted more than <700ps> sending power to the rear wheels,
and its exterior design was stunning indeed.

The design was a collaboration between Ferrari's internal
design department and Pininfarina.

They're efforts led to the car winning the prestigious
Compasso d'Oro international design award in 2014.
zh:
法拉利以其激动人心的V12引擎而闻名于世。

事实上，该公司在1947年推出的首款零售车型的引擎盖下
就装载了一台V12引擎。

将V12引擎安装在车前部的F12berlinetta是款大热车型，

拥有超过<700ps>的动力和经典的前置后驱传动系统，十分引
人注目！

该设计来自法拉利内部设计部门和宾尼法利纳的合作。

显然，这是一次富有成效的合作——F12berlinetta在2014年赢得了著
名的金圆规奖！=

en:
The LaFerrari is Ferrari's first car since the Enzo to
feature a V12 engine.

It's also the first commercially available hybrid car
Ferrari has ever made.

The HY-KERS hybrid system it employs was adapted from
F1 machines...

And its 6.3L V12 engine is accompanied by two motors,
allowing it to produce up to <963ps>.
zh:
LaFerrari是Ferrari自Enzo之后推出的第一款新车，同样主打
V12引擎。

此车也是Ferrari有史以来制造的第一辆商业化的混合动力汽车。

其所采用的HY-KERS混合动力系统应用了F1赛车上的技术……

通过6.3L V12引擎配合两台电机，能够产生高达<963ps>的动力。

en:
This is the GT3 version of the Ferrari 458 Italia.

The base car's front and rear wings have been widened,
and the size of its aerodynamic parts increased.

The engine is largely the same as the base 458 Italia,
although some adjustments were made.

This particular model ran its first race in 2011.

And what a debut it was—it immediately proved a winner
in the FIA GT3 European Championship that year!
zh:
这辆车是Ferrari 458 Italia的GT3版本。

相较于基础车型，前后扰流板都得以加宽，空气动力学
部件的尺寸也相应扩大。

引擎在很大程度上与基本款的458 Italia保持一致，只是稍微
进行了微调。

这款GT3专属车型在2011年首次现身赛场，

完成了精彩的亮相——将当年的FIA GT3欧洲锦标赛冠军奖
杯带回了家！

en:
The Ford F-Series is one of the American brand's
best-selling offerings.

This model, the SVT Raptor, was added to the line-up
in 2010.

It was built for off-road use, with specially designed
dampers and an engine capable of more than <400ps>.

Its interior rivals that of a typical sports car.

By the way, the 'SVT' in its name stands for
'Special Vehicle Team'.

This is the team responsible for developing Ford's
highest-performance vehicles!<
zh:
Ford的F系列是美国车品牌中最畅销的产品之一。

这款SVT Raptor是在2010年加入F系列产品线阵容的。

这是一台专为越野而生的卡车，拥有专门设计的避震器
和超过<400ps>动力的引擎。

其豪华的内饰也足可以与典型的跑车相媲美。

顺便解释一下，其名称中的“SVT”代表了“特殊车辆团
队”（Special Vehicle Team）。

这是一个负责为Ford开发最高性能车辆的团队！

en:
This concept car was the result of a collaboration between
Infiniti's design team and Gran Turismo.

While it has a very unique look, it clearly exhibits key
elements of Infiniti's design language.

Powered by an impressive 4.5-liter V-8 combined with
an electric motor...

...its hybrid system was based on those found
in Formula 1 race cars.

A front mid-engine transaxle gives it a sporty 45:55 front/rear
weight distribution, making it virtually race ready.
zh:
这款概念车是INFINITI的设计团队与跑车浪漫旅携手合作
的成果。

其独特的造型外观清晰地表达出了INFINITI设计语言中的关键
元素！

此车拥有由4.5L V8引擎和一台电机组成的动力单元，

还搭载了通常用于F1赛车的混合动力技术。

前轮中置跨轴传动布局将前后配重比确定为45：55。

en:
If I had to describe the Mini Clubman Vision Gran Turismo
in simple terms, it would be "battle-ready."

The car sits much wider and lower to the ground than the
classic model, looking ready to attack the race track.

Indeed, that's what it was created to do. Maximum performance
is ensured with lots of aerodynamic features.

And it's lightweight. It tips the scales at <1050kg> and comes
powered by an impressive engine that produces <400ps>.

Also, its full-time 4WD drivetrain provides plenty
of stability.
zh:
如果要用一个词来形容MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo，我会用
“蓄势待发”来形容！

此车带有MINI的标志性设计，但比经典车型更宽，离地间
隙更低。

这是因为此车是为赛道设计的，具备扁平化底板等空气
动力学特性。

其<1050kg>的轻盈车身由一台可提供约<400ps>动力的强劲引擎驱动……

而全时四驱系统则负责提供充足的稳定性。

en:
The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo is a real beauty!

It's the perfect iteration of Mazda's "KODO: Soul of Motion"
design philosophy.

One of the inspirations for its styling was the legendary
787B race car that made history at Le Mans.

The designers attempted to capture the past and future of Mazda
in a single design, and I'd say they succeeded.

Its powertrain is capable of incredible power, efficiency,
and durability.

And who knows? Perhaps a victory at Le Mans is on the cards
for this mean machine too.
zh:
Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo实在是美得不可方物！

此车是Mazda“魂动：Soul of motion”设计理念的
完美示范。

其设计背后的灵感之一是在勒芒赛道上创造历史的
Mazda 787B。

可以说，这个车型成功地在一套设计中捕捉到Mazda的过去
和未来！

其动力系统能够提供令人难以置信的动力、功效和
耐久性。

谁知道呢，也许这个小美人将来也能在勒芒24小时耐力
赛中取得胜利！!

en:
The GTI Supersport Vision Gran Turismo offers a hint of what
the future may hold for the Golf GTI.

This hatchback-styled vehicle is, in fact, a powerful
2-seater sports car.

The classic Golf's chassis has been upgraded for racing,
with a lower center of gravity and much lighter weight.

It's also equipped with 4-wheel drive and an engine
that churns out more than <500ps>.

Not bad for a Golf, right?
zh:
GTI Supersport Vision Gran Turismo为
Golf GTI的未来埋下了伏笔。

这款掀背车在骨子里是一款强大的双座跑车！

经典的Golf底盘针对赛事进行了升级，重心更低，重量更轻，

而且还配备了四轮驱动系统和能够输出超过<500ps>动力的引擎。

对于一辆Golf来说，相当诱人吧？

en:
As evidenced by its class win at the 2008 24 Hours of
Le Mans...

The DBR9 GT1 is a true masterpiece of British racing
car design.

It also performed impressively on numerous other occasions
until the GT1 category was discontinued in 2011.

After all these years, the 5.9L V12 engine under the bonnet
is more than capable of delivering the power you need!
zh:
DBR9 GT1在2008年勒芒24小时耐力赛中赢得了该级别的冠军……

足以证明其英国赛车设计真正杰作的身份。

在2011年GT1组别停止举办前，它在各类场合里都有令人印
象深刻的表现。

经过这么多年，引擎盖下的这台5.9L V12引擎仍然能够轻松
提供您所需要的动力！

en:
Take the beauty of the LF-LC, a concept car by Lexus, combine
it with the striking silhouette of a race car...

...and you get the Lexus LF-LC GT VGT!

This gorgeous vehicle was designed to race in touring-car
such as the Super GT or Nürburgring 24 Hours.

It's race-ready for the virtual race track.
zh:
将Lexus概念车LF-LC的美感与赛车的冲击性轮廓相融合……

就得到了Lexus LF-LC GT VGT！

这辆华丽的赛车是为了在诸如Super GT或纽博格林24小时耐
力赛等比赛中大显身手而生的。

此车已经为比赛做好了一切准备，渴望着驰骋赛场！

en:
The Mercedes-AMG GT is Mercedes-Benz's flagship sports car.

This 2-seat FR machine combines the elegance of the company's
luxury image with the sportiness of its racing heritage.

This high-performance GT S version came equipped with an
engine that produced <50ps> more than the base model.
zh:
Mercedes-AMG GT是Mercedes-Benz的旗舰跑车。

该系列中的双座前置后驱车型因其卓越的驾驶性能和优
雅的比例而广受车迷喜爱。

这辆车是高性能的GT S版本。配备的引擎比标准车型高
<50ps>马力。

en:
The Peugeot Vision Gran Turismo is all about performance.

This remarkable car was developed by Peugeot's design team
and the engineers responsible for the Peugeot Sport.

Its turbocharged 3.2-liter V-6 engine, mounted amidships,
pumped out a hearty <887ps>.

Particular attention was paid to endurance race cars during
the development of this efficiently-designed model.

You can see this in its aerodynamic parts, which are kept
to an absolute minimum without affecting performance.
zh:
Peugeot Vision Gran Turismo是纯粹为驾驶而生的。

这款非凡的车辆是由Peugeot的设计团队和Peugeot Sport背后的
工程师们共同开发的。

此车采用了中置引擎布局，配备了3.2L V6涡轮增压引擎，
能够提供<887ps>的动力。

为了实现性能的飞跃，在车型的开发过程中，设计师们特别参
考了耐力赛车型。

您可以从空气动力学部件中看出这一点，这些部件在不
影响性能的前提下，都采取极简化的处理。

en:
The Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo is a compact
mid-engined sports car.

Everything about it has been designed with the driver in
mind, an approach for which Honda is well-known.

The design team put this model through real-life tests when
developing its aerodynamic features.

Under its bonnet is a <410ps> 2L
straight-four turbo engine...

Accompanied by a 8-speed dual-clutch transmission.

Amazingly, the whole thing only weighs <899kg>!
zh:
Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo是一款中置引擎的紧凑型跑车。

在这辆车上，所有的设计都以驾驶者为中心，这也是Honda
赖以成名的设计理念。

设计团队在进行该车的空气动力学特性研发时，直接进
行了实车测试。

其引擎盖下装载了一台<410ps>的2L直列四缸涡轮增压引擎……

搭配8速双离合器变速箱。

最令人称道的是，整部车的重量仅有<899kg>！

en:
The Lexus RC F is well-known for its GT3 racing variant.

Did you know that the 'F' in the model name stands for the
Fuji Speedway, the home course for Lexus Gazoo Racing?

The naturally aspirated 5.0 L V8 engine allows for smooth
transition to higher RPMs and a pleasant exhaust note.

And the enhanced oil cooler also allows you to get the most
out of your time on the circuit.
zh:
Lexus RC F因其参加GT3组别的赛车而广为人知。

你知道吗，车型名称中的“F”代表富士赛道，后者正
是Lexus Gazoo车队的主场。

自然进气的5.0 升 V8引擎可以平顺过渡到更高的转速，发
出的排气声更是令人心旷神怡，

更有经过强化的油冷却器助您在赛道上取得佳绩。

en:
Although it's considered an eco-friendly car, the Fit Hybrid
is actually quite sporty.

This third-generation model came with a 1.5-liter engine and
a 7-speed DCT.

Although it wasn't particularly fast, it wasn't slow either.

The chassis had a lower center of gravity, enabling the car
to possess stable handling characteristics.
zh:
身为一款环保车型，Fit Hybrid真的很有跑车感。

这款第三代Fit Hybrid配备有一台1.5L引擎和一个7速双离合变
速箱，

拥有广受赞誉的加速反应速度，

特殊的底盘重心较低，使操控更加稳定。

sourceName: Alpine Vision Gran Turismo Race Mode
en:
This is the racing version of the Alpine Vision
Gran Turismo.

The configuration of the canards, headlights, and other
elements embody the race car aesthetic.

Indeed, this recent instalment in the long line of Alpine
racers is a worthy successor to that classic tradition.
zh:
这辆车是Alpine Vision Gran Turismo的赛车版。

侧翼、头灯和其他元素的配置无不体现了赛车之美。

作为Alpine丰富的赛车阵容中的最新作品，这款车是当之无
愧的经典传承者。

en:
This machine was introduced to celebrate Lamborghini's 50th
anniversary.

Called the Veneno, it was unveiled at the 2013
Geneva Motor Show.

This coupe model was a one-off, made especially for
display at the show.

However, the company built three more to meet the
demands of passionate Lamborghini aficionados.

Later, nine roadsters were produced for sale.

Each Veneno is a one-of-a-kind example that has a solid place
in Lamborghini history.

How much does it cost? Well, if you have to ask,
you probably can't afford it.
zh:
Veneno是为庆祝Lamborghini成立50周年而设计的作品……

在2013年的日内瓦车展上揭开了面纱。

这款双门跑车原本是专为展会组装的孤品。

然而，为了满足热情高涨的Lamborghini收藏家的要求，Lamborghini
追加制造了三台车，

后来又额外生产了九辆敞篷车。

每辆Veneno都是独一无二的珍宝，也是Lamborghini历史的一部分。

您问价格？如果您非要刨根问底的话，反正一般人肯定
是买不起的……

en:
The Hyundai N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo was created to celebrate
the South Korean manufacturer's 50th anniversary.

The "N" in its name is reserved for cars that possess
the highest performance in the company's lineup.

It is the power unit in particular that sets this car apart.

This model is powered by hub motors, utilizing fuel-cell
technology developed by Hyundai.

Weighing in at just north of one ton, the N 25 Gran Turismo
is lightweight and quite nice to look at.[
zh:
Hyundai N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo是为纪念
这家韩国制造商成立50周年而设计的。

“N”是Hyundai专门为高性能车型保留的编号。

这辆车的动力装置尤为与众不同：

由多台轮毂电机提供动力，并应用了Hyundai公司
自行开发和大规模生产的燃料电池技术。

它的设计既兼顾了轻量化，整车重量刚好为一吨出头，
又展现出无与伦比的动态感。

en:
The Dodge Charger SRT is among the world's most
powerful sedans.

With more than <700ps> on tap, it can reach speeds
of approximately <330km/h>.

In case you didn't know, the "SRT" in its name stands for
Street and Racing Technology.

It's made up of a group of engineers within Dodge who specialize
in developing high-performance vehicles.

This means that if you see a car with an SRT badge on it, you
might want to think twice before challenging it to a race.
zh:
道奇Charger SRT是世界上最快的四门轿车之一。

其马力超过了<700ps>，最高时速可达到近<330km/h>。

您可能不知道，“SRT”代表了“街道和赛车技术”
。

这个研发团队专门从事高性能汽车的开发。

不消说，任何名字中带有SRT的车都不容小觑。

en:
If you're in the market for a rear-wheel drive sports car,
you can't go wrong with this Mazda MX-5.

This fourth generation model is known as the ND.

More than <100kg> lighter than its predecessor, this
popular model is seen as a return to classic form.

The S-segment ND is lightweight—just barely exceeding a ton—
and a joy to drive.
zh:
如果您正在寻找一辆后轮驱动的跑车，那么选这款Mazda MX-5
准没错。

这款第四代车型被称为ND。

这台全球热门车型比上一代要轻<100kg>，被视为回归经典的
纯粹之作。

MX-5 ND属于轻量级的S级车，整重只稍微超过一吨，但驾驶乐
趣无穷。\

en:
Like its predecessors, the third generation BMW M3
is a quintessential example of a FR sports car.

Its naturally aspirated straight-six engine is highly tuned,
producing more than <100ps> per litre of displacement.

A truly exceptional piece of machinery, it's hailed as the
fastest, most powerful straight-six engine in the world.

With a compact, stylish body and a very fine engine indeed,
this car has only grown more magnificent with age.
zh:
与其前辈一样，第三代BMW M3是前置后驱跑车的典型代表。

其自然进气的直列六缸引擎经过高度调校，每升排量的
动力输出超过了<100ps>。

这是一台真正出类拔萃的机器，被誉为世界上最快、最
强大的直列六缸引擎。

通过紧凑、时尚的车身和极其优秀的发动机，BMW造就出
了一台历久弥新的好车。

en:
The WRX STI is the pinnacle of the highly popular
Impreza WRX line.

Introduced in 2014, it is equipped with a turbocharged
variant of Subaru's legendary EJ20 boxer engine.

It's mated to an improved 6-speed manual gearbox
with short throws.

Like previous models, this one features all-wheel drive.

The WRX STI was designed to go fast on a variety
of different driving surfaces.[
zh:
WRX STI是经久不衰的翼豹WRX系列的最新作。

这款车型于2014年推出，采用斯巴鲁传奇的EJ20跑车引擎的涡轮
增压版本，

还配备了改进后的六速手动变速箱。

和前几代的车型一样，全时四轮驱动也是标配。

强大的引擎与富有韧性的车架搭配，构成了一个美妙的
组合。

en:
The sixth-generation Mustang represented a big step
in the model's evolutionary process.

For the first time, it utilized a 4-wheel independent
suspension system.

This dramatically improved the handling of the car, allowing
it to corner like a true well-balanced sports car.

Base models were equipped with a peppy turbocharged
inline-4 engine.

However, the GT had Ford's legendary V-8, which produced
<441ps> and <40kgm> of torque.
zh:
第六代Mustang的演变也许是此车传奇历史上最引人注目的一页：

四轮独立悬挂的首次引入

显著改善了稳定性和操控性。

基础车型搭载的是简配后的直列四缸涡轮增压引擎，

GT版则采用了Ford传奇的V8引擎，可以产生<441ps>的动力和<40kgm>
的扭矩。

en:
The Nissan GT-R LM Nismo made its debut at the 24 Hours of
Le Mans in 2015...

Where it competed in the Le Mans Prototype 1 Hybrid class.

To the surprise of many, it utilised a front-engine
front-wheel drive layout.

It was an unusual design for an LMP1 vehicle, and a number
of problems had to be resolved before it was ready.

While the Nismo failed to meet expectations in the race, it
nevertheless left a lasting impression on all who saw it.
zh:
Nissan GT-R LM Nismo在2015年的勒芒24小时耐力赛上首次亮相，

参加了勒芒原型车1级（LMP1）混合动力组的比赛。

令许多人感到惊讶的是，该车居然采用了前置引擎前轮
驱动的布局。

对于LMP1车辆来说，这是一个非常规的设计，需要解决为
数不少的问题，才能达到良好的竞技状态。

虽然它最终未能在比赛中取得预期的成绩，但还是给所
有看到它的人留下了深刻印象。

sourceName: DAIHATSU COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo
en:
The Daihatsu Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo was built to
comply with Japan's "kei car" specifications.

The engine is set at <660cc>, it can produce <150ps>,
almost 2.5 times as much as the standard Copen.

The "RJ" in the name stands for Racing Jacket.

You really feel like you are wearing the car
when sitting in the driver's seat.
zh:
Daihatsu Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo是一款
按照日本的“轻型车”规格打造的跑车车型。

虽然引擎排量被限制在<660cc>，但仍能产生<150ps>的动力——
这个数据几乎是标准版Copen的2.5倍。

名称中的“RJ”代表赛车夹克。

这辆车的与众不同不仅在于激进的调校，时尚外观设计
也是加分项。

en:
Bugatti has always been a company that drew inspiration
from its racing history.

The case is no different with this model that embodied
the very soul of the marque.

It was partly based on the company's classic race car,
the Type 57 Tank....

...which took the overall title at the 24 Hours of Le Mans
race twice in the 1930s.

The mid-mounted W-16 engine was tuned to produce up to <1673ps>.%
zh:
这款引人注目的车型是Bugatti美学的体现。

Bugatti惯于从公司的赛车历史中汲取灵感。

此车的设计就部分参考了经典赛车：Type 57 Tank，

一辆在20世纪30年代两次赢得勒芒赛事的传奇赛车。

中置安装的W16引擎经过精心调校，可产生高达<1673ps>的动力。

en:
This ultra-lightweight pure sports car concept was born from
the collaboration between Honda and Gran Turismo.

The design theme drew inspiration from Honda's first
Formula 1 race cars in the 1960s.

Its power unit incorporates technologies developed
for superbikes.

The engine is normally used in the Honda RC213V-S,
which is a MotoGP class motorcycle.

The car demonstrates the company's ability to compete in
all manner of races, be it on two wheels or four.
zh:
这款超轻量级的纯正跑车的概念设计来自于
Honda和跑车浪漫旅的合作项目。

其设计主题源自Honda 60年代的第一批F1赛车。

动力单元部分采用的是为超级摩托车特别开发的技术。

确切地说，它的车身上安装了一台MotoGP摩托车的专用引擎
——Honda RC213V-S。

它也是Honda纵横两轮及四轮赛事的实战能力的充分体现。

en:
Chris Holstrom Concepts is a hot rod shop in the Pacific
Northwest that specialises in custom designs.

This car was built using a Chevy Nova as a base...

And features a supercharged V8 normally seen in
the Corvette ZR1.

It's a mighty engine that can produce up to <700ps>.

This car won the Gran Turismo Award at the SEMA show, the
largest showcase of custom automobiles in the world.
zh:
Chris Holstrom Concepts是太平洋西北地区的一家改装车店，
专门从事定制改装设计。

这辆车以Chevy Nova为基础打造，

安装有一台Corvette ZR1车型常用的机械增压V8引擎。

这是一台强大的引擎，可以产生高达<700ps>的动力。

这辆车还在全球最大的定制汽车展——SEMA展会上赢得过
Gran Turismo奖。

en:
The S-FR was a concept vehicle unveiled at the 2015
Tokyo Motor Show.

While this lightweight RWD sports car was designed for everyday
use, it certainly turned heads at the show.

With a compact body on par with the AE86, its weight is
evenly distributed over the front and rear axles.

The design was inspired by the famous Toyota Sports 800.
zh:
S-FR是在2015年东京车展上发布的一款概念车。

这是一款针对日常驾驶设计的轻量级后轮驱动跑车，生
来就拥有一种引人注目的特质！

与AE86相当的紧凑车身将重量均匀地分配在前后轴上。

它的设计灵感来自于鼎鼎大名的早期跑车Toyota Sports 800。

en:
The Toyota 86 GRMN is the epitome of a concept car.

It employs lightweight pistons, a custom crankshaft...

And a finely-tuned exhaust system.

Furthermore, the roof and bonnet are of carbon fibre, and
the brakes have been reinforced with special materials.

Oh, and in case you're not aware, the 'MN' in the name
stands for 'Meister of Nürburgring'.

It is the direct product of knowledge and experience gained
from the Nürburgring 24 Hours race.

Dubbed the 'perfect' 86, it is the pride of Toyota.
zh:
Toyota 86 GRMN是一款典型的概念车。

采用轻量化活塞、定制曲轴……

以及一套精细调校过的排气系统。

此外，车顶和引擎盖用上了碳纤维材质，刹车系统也用
特殊材料进行了加固。

哦，也许您还没听说，车型名字中的“MN”是“纽博格
林大师”（Meister of Nürburgring）的缩写。

因为这款车是Toyota在纽博格林24小时耐力赛中获得的知识
和经验的直接产物。

它是Toyota的骄傲，也是大家口中的“完美”86。

en:
The Demio is Mazda's entry-level model.

This fourth-generation version was introduced in 2014.

Power is supplied by a turbocharged 1.5-liter diesel engine
that produces <25kgm> of torque.

Because of its predictable handling character, this car is
ideal for novices learning how to race.<
zh:
Demio是Mazda的入门级车型。

这一款2014年推出的车型已经是第四代产品了。

它的动力系统是一台1.5L涡轮增压柴油引擎，可以产生<25kgm>
的扭矩。

凭借绝对可靠的操控性，它成为了赛道新人的不二之选。

en:
The Huracán is one of a long line of Lamborghini V-10 models.

It served as the base model for the company's GT3 race cars.

This LP610-4 has a mid-engine 4-wheel-drive layout.

It's handling is on another level, thanks to the grip and
traction provided by 4WD and the sport-tuned suspension system.

Its ten-cylinder engine can produces more than <600ps>
and delivers it with a sweet, melodic roar.
zh:
众所周知，Lamborghini的V10之作

Huracán是GT3组别赛车的基础车型。

这款LP610-4采用了中置引擎和四轮驱动布局，

在过弯时拥有绝无仅有的响应速度，
稳定性却丝毫不受影响。

十气缸的发动机可以产生超过<600ps>的动力，
并演奏出令人心驰神往的轰鸣声。
8

en:
This version of the Ferrari 458 Italia is a Gran Turismo
Gr.4 original.

It has fewer aerodynamic modifications, but retains the
tremendous downforce generated by the original 458.
zh:
这辆基于Ferrari 458 Italia改造而来的车型是一款
原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车。

此车在空气动力学方面进行了少量改动，并
保留了458原有的巨大下压力。

en:
This third-generation Vantage served as the base for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4 race car.

And, as you would expect from a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive
premium sports car, its handling character was divine.

Under the hood was a sweet-sounding V-8 that was as responsive
as it was powerful, making it a delight to drive on the track.
zh:
这款原创的跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车以第三代Vantage为改
装原型。

与其他前置后驱赛车相比，车辆配置更均衡、也更易于
操控。

V8引擎的响应速度出乎意料的好，车身前后配重比例也
相当理想。

en:
The third generation TT sports model—designated TTS—
is a rock-solid four-wheel drive sports car.

In addition to being <50kg> lighter than its base model...

It features a quattro 4WD system that is both stable
and incredibly responsive...

As well as a specialised sports suspension.<
zh:
编号为TTS的第三代TT跑车车型是一款稳如磐石的四轮驱
动跑车。

除了比基础车型减重<50kg>之外……

它还搭载了一套稳定性与响应度双佳的quattro四轮驱动系统……

以及特制的跑车型悬挂。

en:
Based on the Genesis Coupe, this is a Gran Turismo Gr.4
racing car original.

Its long wheelbase and traditional FR layout have won it
praise for achieving balanced and responsive handling.

Extensive tuning, including weight reduction and paddle
shifters, have put it on par with Gr.3 standards.
zh:
此车以捷尼赛思Coupe为基础改装，是一款原创的跑车浪漫旅
组别4级别赛车。

长轴距和传统的前置后驱布局带来均衡且灵敏的响应，
赢得了口碑。

在进行更重度的改装，包括减重和加装换挡拨片后，此
车基本达到了组别3标准。

en:
The Genesis Coupe served as the foundation for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.3 race car.

And what a well-balanced machine it is, because the car already
possessed many race car attributes.

The most notable thing about the original was its handling,
which was both stable and predictable.

Its long wheelbase allowed for a spacious interior, while its
profile provided excellent downforce at high speed.
zh:
这款原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.3级别赛车以Genesis Coupe
为基础车型。

此车保留了Genesis关键的长轴距优势。

作为一款全面的赛车，其稳定性和操控性都极其出色。

庞大的车身除了能提供宽敞的内部空间外，也保障了车
辆行驶中的下压力。>

en:
The sixth generation Mustang was the base model used for
this original Gran Turismo Gr.4 racing car.

The peerless stability of the Mustang is retained in
this variant as well.

Naturally, the livery incorporates Ford's traditional
racing stripe.
zh:
第六代Mustang是这款原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车的
基础车型。

Mustang那无以伦比的稳定性在这个改装版本中也得到了保留。

理所当然的，车身涂装中也加入了Ford的传统赛车条纹。

en:
The sixth-generation Mustang served as the foundation
for this Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.3 race car.

One of the Mustang's great attributes was its speed.

That said, its improved handling made it a well-rounded
race car.
zh:
这款原创的跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车采用第六代Mustang
作为其基础车型。

令人难以置信的最高时速是其最突出的优势，

而长轴距则提供了卓越的稳定性。

en:
This original Gran Turismo Gr.4 race car used the
Alfa Romeo 4C as its foundation.

The lightweight construction and impressive mobility of
the 4C made it a great candidate for our Gr.4 races.
zh:
这款原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车以Alfa Romeo 4C为基础
打造的。

4C的轻量化车身结构和令人印象深刻的机动性在这个改
装版本中得到了进一步提升。

en:
The third generation Renault Sport Mégane was the base model
used in the development of this Gran Turismo Gr.4 original.

With traction second to none, this car takes sharp
corners with ease.

The Mégane's celebrated handling remains a key feature of
this racing variant.
zh:
第三代Renault Sport Mégane是开发这款原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.4
级别赛车时采用的基础车型。

凭借首屈一指的牵引力，这辆车可以轻松驾驭每一个急弯。

这台改装赛车身上同样保留了Mégane久负盛名的操控性。

en:
This Gr.4 Gran Turismo original racing car was built using
the Nissan GT-R as its base.

The characteristic fog lights of this endurance racer are
a prominent feature of the front bumper.

With the comfortable handling expected from a 4WD vehicle,
this reliable car is well-suited for longer races.
zh:
这款原创的跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车是以日产GT-R为基础
制造的。

这辆耐力赛车型的雾灯相当有特色，成为了前保险杠的
亮点。

这辆车不仅具备四轮驱动车型应有的舒适操控感，在长
途赛事中也相当可靠。

en:
To specially designate its lineup of plug-in hybrids and EVs...

...BMW used the letter "i" in the vehicle name,
such as in the compact i3.

The i3 was the company's first mass-produced electric car.

With <170ps> of power and <25kgm> of torque, the i3's drivetrain
provided excellent acceleration.

BMW worked hard to keep the car's weight down, using carbon-fiber
reinforced polymer to keep it at a lean <1260kg>.
zh:
您可能对BMW的子品牌BMW i有所耳闻？

这是BMW用来展示他们的插电式电动车和混合动力车车系
的品牌。

i3是BMW的第一辆量产电动汽车。

能够产生 <170ps> 的功率和 <25kgm>扭矩，
这辆 RR 车辆的发动机毫不逊色。

车身结合铝和碳硬壳其整备质量仅为<1260kg>。

en:
The name Renault Sport may not be familiar here in the States,
but in Europe, it's one of the most well-known sporty brands.

It's the name of the motorsports division of the company, which
has participated in everything from Formula 1 to Le Mans.

The fourth-generation Clio is a great example of
the types of cars it produces.

Providing the power for this compact is a turbocharged
1.6-liter inline-4 that produced <220ps>.

The "Trophy" version was created as a special model
specifically for race-track use.

To see how fast the car was, the folks at Renault Sport
took it to the Nürburgring.

And guess what? The thing ended up setting a new lap record
for compact hatchbacks!
zh:
Renault Sport在全球范围内都享有极高的知名度。

这都要归功于F1和勒芒24小时耐力赛等重大赛事的胜利，
为Renault的赛车部门积攒下了赫赫声名。

第四代Clio正是他们的杰作之一。

经过Renault Sport的专门调校，这台1.6L涡轮增压直列四缸引擎可
以产生高达<220ps>的动力。

此外，“Trophy”特别车型还针对赛道进行了专项性能调校。

Renault的高性能掀背车是纽博格林赛道圈速纪录上的常客。

事实上，Clio甫一亮相，就创下了紧凑型掀背车类别中的
新纪录——表现出了巨大的潜力。

en:
The DS3 received its name from a line of luxury cars from Citroën
that were marketed from 1955 to 1975.

But the DS3, produced in 2009 to 2016, had very little
in common with those original models.

This car placed performance first, eventually becoming
one of the Continent's most popular hot hatches.

The DS3 Racing version was used as the foundation for the
French company's entry in the World Rally Championship.

A number of engine options were available, but the turbocharged
1.6-liter inline-4 was the most powerful at <200ps>.

Development of the car was overseen by Citroën Racing.&
zh:
DS是Citroën设立的豪华品牌，Citroën将其最优质的车型都归于该
品牌名下。

借助这个品牌，这家法国汽车制造商得以以清晰、充分
地展现品牌卓乎不群的设计感。

DS成立于2009年，DS3是其推出的第一款车。

DS3的赛车版本更是成为了世界拉力锦标赛参赛车的基础
车型。

这款前置前驱高性能掀背车的开发工作由Citroën Racing负责。
他当然没有懈怠，这款引擎可以产生超过<200ps>的动力。

en:
The third-gen Atenza's handling is in line with Mazda’s
‘Jinba Ittai’ credo: unity between car and driver.

This model is equipped with a 2.2L turbocharged
straight-four diesel engine.

With plenty of torque, the engine has a mighty roar, and
is partnered by a six-speed manual transmission.

By the way, have you heard of Mazda’s Skyactiv Technology?

This line of fundamental engineering is found throughout
the vehicle, from body to engine to chassis.

Indeed, one might say that the entire third-gen Atenza
is the product of this advanced engineering approach.
zh:
第三代Atenza的操控体验非常符合Mazda的“人马一体”理念：
即车辆和驾驶者之间的和谐统一。

这款车型配备了一台2.2升涡轮增压直列四缸柴油引擎

和六速手动变速箱，充足的扭矩让这台引擎的轰鸣声响
彻云霄。

话说，您听说过Mazda的Skyactiv技术吗？

Mazda的这套汽车工程技术贯穿了整辆车的每个部件，从车
身到引擎，再到底盘，无处不在。

可以毫不夸张的说，
第三代Atenza就是集先进的Skyactiv技术于大成的作品。

en:
This Gran Turismo Gr.4 original racing car is based on
the BMW M4.
