zh: Buddy_ContentCar_BrandCentralOwner_normal__911_carrera_rs_96_1020385

en:
Sold only in Japan, the Toyota Crown has represented
the quintessential Japanese luxury sports sedan.

This particular model, which was introduced in 2012, was the
14th-generation version.

With the first Crown appearing in 1955, it's one of the longest
running models in Japan to date.

The name "Athlete" was chosen to represent its
distinctively sporty nature.

It's a shame that the car has never been marketed worldwide.
zh:
“Toyota Crown”这个名字在全日本汽车爱好者的心目中代表着
尊贵。

这台车在2012年首次发布，已经是久负盛名的Crown系列中的
第14代产品了。

回首1955年推出的第一代Crown，这个系列已经传承延续了超
过半个世纪。

Toyota为14代车型定下的型号名称“Athlete”充分表达了它的运
动基因……

以及它那公路王者的霸气外形。

sourceName: Mercedes-AMG F1 W08 EQ Power+ (Color Variation) 2017
en:
AMG's W08 EQ Power+ was an unstoppable force in the 2017
Formula 1 season.

This particular version features an all-new colour scheme
that is sure to delight.

The AMG F1 team marked an unforgettable 2017 with their
fourth straight Constructors' Championship win.

And the inimitable Lewis Hamilton doubled the magic
with his fourth Drivers' Championship victory./
zh:
AMG的W08 EQ Power+在F1的2017赛季中势不可挡。

这个版本采用了全新的配色，显得卓尔不群。

2017年是难忘的一年，AMG F1车队正是凭借此车连续第四年
拿下车队总冠军，

而无法超越的刘易斯·汉密尔顿也用他的第四个车手总冠军实现了双
喜临门。

en:
The Dallara SF19 Super Formula was built for Japan's
top-level formula racing series.

The engines used in the Super Formula championship are known
as Nippon Race Engines.

They are turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4s that produce
more than <550ps>.

They're supplied by both Toyota and Honda. This particular
car has the Toyota engine.
zh:
这辆Dallara SF19 Super Formula专为日本最顶级的
方程式赛车赛事所打造。

用于超级方程式锦标赛的引擎统称日本比赛引擎，

都是动力超过<550ps>马力的2L直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。

这些引擎全部由Toyota和Honda提供，这辆车上安装的是一台
Toyota引擎。

en:
The Dallara SF19 Super Formula was built for Japan's
top-level formula racing events.

The engines used in the Super Formula championship are known
as Nippon Race Engines.

These are 2L straight-four turbos with more than <550ps>
of power.

They're supplied by both Toyota and Honda, but this
particular car features a Honda engine.
zh:
这辆Dallara SF19 Super Formula专为日本最顶级的
方程式赛车赛事所打造。

用于超级方程式锦标赛的引擎统称日本比赛引擎，

都是动力超过<550ps>马力的2L直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。

这些引擎全部由Toyota和Honda提供，这辆车上安装的是一台
Honda引擎。|

en:
This safety car is a Gran Turismo exclusive based on the
Toyota Crown Athlete G.

It features a distinctive yellow body and blue revolving
rooftop light.

The Crown brand has strong associations with safety in
Japan, as the car of choice for the nation's police.
zh:
这辆Gran Turismo专属的安全车基于Toyota Crown Athlete G开发。

它采用了鲜明、显眼的黄色车身和蓝色的旋转顶灯。

Crown是日本警方的官方采购车型，在民众眼中，也意味着
安全的保障。

en:
This is the 2nd-gen model of the Subaru Impreza WRX series.

Like its predecessor, it was a World Rally Championship star.

Specifically, it was the last Impreza to win a world title
at the WRC—a legacy that's talked about to this day.

The production model received extensive upgrades,
including a major facelift.

The 2004 model was faster and stronger by leaps and bounds.

Engine-wise, not only was max. torque give a <2kgm> upgrade,
but the mid-range response was significantly improved.

Paired with rigid and ground-hugging chassis, this car is
incredibly fun to drive on any course.
zh:
这是Subaru Impreza WRX车族中的第二代型号。

和其前代车型一样，它也是世界拉力锦标赛上的明星。

尤其值得一提的是，它是最后一款在世界拉力锦标赛上赢得
世界冠军的Impreza。这个荣誉直到今天依然被人们津津乐道。

其量产车型经过了大量的升级，包括外观方面的大量修改。

这辆2004款车型在速度和性能方面有了突飞猛进的发展。

在引擎方面，它的最大扭矩不仅提升了<2kgm>，
中转速下的响应速度也得到了大幅优化。

再搭配上坚固且贴合地面的底盘，让它能在任何赛道上
都能提供无与伦比的驾驶体验。

en:
There are two ways of sorting Lancer Evolution generations:
by number or by base model.

According to the base model system, the Lancer Evo VII,
VIII, and IX all belong to the third generation.

Of these, the Lancer Evolution IX MR was the last model.

It was also the last Lancer Evolution to be equipped with
Mitsubishi's 4G63 4-cylinder turbo engine.

With a strong turbocharger and continuous variable valve
timing, it offered better engine response than ever before.

And its sporty look helped distinguish it as the
definitive IX version.

The "MR" in its name stands for "Mitsubishi Racing," an exclusive
label reserved for Mitsubishi’s top-tier sports cars.
T
zh:
Lancer Evolution的代际排序通常有两种算法：
按照编号排，或是按照基础车型划分。

以后者划分的话，Lancer Evo VII、VIII和IX
均属于第三代。

这样算来，Lancer Evolution IX MR就是第三代的
最后一款。

同时也是最后一款搭载Mitsubishi
4G63 4缸涡轮引擎的Lancer Evolution。

凭借强大的涡轮增压器和连续可变气门正时技术，
它提供了远超常规的引擎响应。

运动外观更是Evo IX的集大成者。

名称中的“MR”则代表“Mitsubishi Racing”
——Mitsubishi顶尖跑车的专属标签。

en:
The R8 LMS is a GT3-class race car.

And the Evo, as you might expect, is an updated model.

It features significant cooling and aerodynamic improvements
over the original 2019 version.

The hood vents are bigger and new air intakes have
been added next to the headlights.

The front/rear weight balance was also tweaked,
improving handling as a result.
zh:
这辆R8 LMS是一辆GT3组别赛车。

顾名思义，名字中的Evo指代它是一款升级版车型。

相比2019车款，它的冷却器性能更好，空气动力学表现也
更出众。

引擎盖上的通风口变得愈发宽大，而且在头灯旁追加了新的进气口。

其前后配重平衡也进行了重新调整，进而优化了操控性能。`

en:
This fully-customized car built by STI, Subaru's motorsports
division, was based on the standard BRZ.

It features specially engineered dampers, high-grip tires,
and original STI-built body parts.

You'll certainly notice how much better this upgraded
version corners.
zh:
这辆由斯巴鲁的汽车运动部门STI全方位定制打造的赛车以一
辆标准版BRZ作为改装原型，

使用了特殊设计的避震，高抓地力的轮胎和STI原厂制造
的车身部件。

行驶当中，您一定会感觉到这辆升级版本的过弯性能提
升有多大。

en:
The X2019 Competition is a virtual racer created
specifically for Gran Turismo.

It represents the pinnacle of race car design.

Development began with the X2014 Standard serving as
the base model.

Downforce was reduced slightly, and the original engine
swapped out for a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter V-12.

It was designed to test the skills of the best drivers in
the world, not to mention provide thrilling racing action.
zh:
这辆X2019 Competition是一款专为跑车浪漫旅打造
的顶级赛车，

代表了赛车设计的巅峰水平。

它以X2014 Standard为基础原型进行开发，

稍稍降低了下压力，并将原版引擎换成了一台自然进气
的3升V12引擎。

它的设计旨在以近距离的位置争夺考验车手的技术，并
且鼓励车手进行紧张刺激的竞技性表演。

en:
The X2019 Competition is a virtual racer created
specifically for Gran Turismo.

It represents the pinnacle of race car design.

Development began with the X2014 Standard serving as
the base model.

Downforce was reduced slightly, and the original engine
swapped out for a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter V-12.

It was designed to test the skills of the best drivers in
the world, not to mention provide thrilling racing action.
zh:
这辆X2019 Competition是一款专为跑车浪漫旅打造
的顶级赛车，

代表了赛车设计的巅峰水平。

它以X2014 Standard为基础原型进行开发，

稍稍降低了下压力，并将原版引擎换成了一台自然进气
的3升V12引擎。

它的设计旨在以近距离的位置争夺考验车手的技术，并
且鼓励车手进行紧张刺激的竞技性表演。

en:
The Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo offers a glimpse
into the future of single-seat super sports cars.

Designed by Lamborghini's internal design department,
Lamborghini Centro Stile...

...the car features y-shapes and hexagons all over
its sleek body.

The drivetrain is a hybrid system, with electric motors
and a V-12.

The so-called "digital cockpit" has various augmented
reality features, providing a new experience for drivers.
zh:
这辆Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo是一辆充满未来感的
单座超级跑车。

它出自Lamborghini的内部设计部门Lamborghini Centro Stile
的手笔……

它的主要造型元素由为数不少的y形和六边形轮廓组成，
遍布线条利落的纤细车身上下。

它的混合动力单元由一台V12引擎和电机构成。

还有那个搭载各种增强现实功能，被称为“数字驾驶舱”
的座舱，绝对是一项不可不睹的奇观。

en:
The Vision Gran Turismo Coupé is the ultimate expression of
Jaguar's impeccable pedigree and technological wizardry.

The experience centers on its fully electric powertrain.

Every lesson learned from Jaguar's Formula E and I-PACE
eTROPHY history has been worked into the car.

The beautiful interior and exterior draws inspiration
from the marque's rich motorsports history.

The past, the present and future;
they're all are here in this one exquisite vehicle.
zh:
这辆Vision Gran Turismo Coupé是捷豹那完美血统和技术魔力的
终极展现。

其驾驶体验主要围绕一套纯电动力系统打造。

所有从捷豹的电动方程式锦标赛和I-PACE eTROPHY杯纯电动车锦标赛赛事经验中积累的
宝贵知识都得到了充分利用。

充满美感的内饰和外观设计从整个赛车运动的历史中汲
取了灵感，

让赛车的过去和未来的精华，都凝结在了这一辆精美的
赛车上。

sourceName: Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo LH Edition
en:
This special edition of the Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran
Turismo is named for racing legend Lewis Hamilton.

Key differences from the base model include the rich
bordeaux bodywork and the large fixed rear wing,

The power of the engine has also been increased to <600ps>./
zh:
这台Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo的特殊版本
以传奇F1车手Lewis Hamilton命名。

它和原版车型的主要区别在于波尔多红色的车身涂装和大尺
寸的固定式尾翼。

另外，它的引擎功率也提高到了<600ps>。

en:
How much do you know about Porsche's legendary 917
racing car?

It's the car that brought the company their first ever
overall victory at Le Mans, back in 1970.

This '917 LIVING LEGEND' is designed with that illustrious
predecessor in mind.

Incredibly, it was developed by just a handful of staff in
Porsche's research department!

One of the key design features retained from the 917 is the
iconic fan, located above the midship V8 engine.
zh:
不知您对Porsche的传奇赛车917了解多少？

它为这家公司在1970年赢得了首个勒芒比赛的总冠军。

这辆“917 LIVING LEGEND”在设计伊始就从它那战绩彪炳的前辈身
上吸取了不少灵感。

更令人难以置信的是，这辆车仅由人数不多的Porsche研究部
门研发完成！

其最关键的设计特性当属沿袭自917的标志性风扇，置于
中置V8引擎的正上方。*

en:
This is a true 4WD sports car, developed by Toyota with the
aim of competing in the World Rally Championship.

Its power is top of the 1.6L turbo class at <272ps>, and the
4WD systems are tuned specifically for sports driving.

The body is surprisingly sturdy, and handling and stability
are both extremely impressive.

The specially designed three-door body gives a distinctly
competition-focused feel.
zh:
这是一辆Toyota专为参加世界拉力锦标赛而设计的四轮驱动
跑车。

它的1.6L涡轮增压引擎拥有同级别中的最强动力，马力高
达<272ps>，而且四轮驱动系统也针对跑车驾驶进行了特别调校。

它的车身出奇的坚固，而且拥有让人赞不绝口的出色操
控性和稳定性，

特殊设计的三门车身也说明了这台车独特的竞赛属性。

en:
Launched in 2020, the Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo SV is the
racing version of the VGT Coupé.

With its wealth of experience in the pure EV-racing scene,
Jaguar's aim was to create a 24-hour race contender.

The power unit was the work of the race team, and its four
motors produce a whopping <1903ps>.

The top speed? Just north of <400km/h>.

Liquid-nitrogen cooling systems ensure hyper-accurate
battery temperature management.

All of which adds up to a car whose fearsome speed can be
brought to bear on every inch of the track.
zh:
这辆Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo SV是VGT Coupé的赛车版本，
于2020年正式推出。

Jaguar运用自己在纯电动赛车领域的丰富经验，倾力打造了
一辆24小时耐力赛的冲冠赛车。

动力单元直接来自车队，四部电机总共可以输出令人咋
舌的<1903ps>动力。

想知道它的极限速度吗？只是将将超过<400km/h>……而已！

通过液氮冷却系统，实现了对电池温度的超精确管理。

所有这些特性集中到同一辆车上，令它在赛道上彻底发
挥出令人生畏的速度优势。

en:
This 'Roadster' is Jaguar's third Vision Gran Turismo car.

A fully electric vehicle, it follows the lead of
Jaguar's two previous VGT cars.

Its three electric motors are capable of outputting
over <1000ps>.

Indeed, it provides the pure driving experience racers
have come to expect from Jaguar.

The body design was inspired by Jaguar's iconic D-Type
racing car.

The D-Type competed in the 1950s, winning the 24 Hours
of Le Mans an impressive three times!

In terms of styling, it was best known for the huge
fin at the rear of the car.

Well, the VGT Roadster brings that rear fin back to life
for the modern day!

Now an active fin, it deftly responds to the speed
at which the car is travelling.
zh:
这款“Roadster”便是Jaguar的第三款Vision Gran Turismo跑车。

它沿袭了Jaguar前两辆VGT车的理念，是一辆纯电动汽车。

它由三个电动马达驱动，能够输出超过<1000ps>的动力。

它满足了车手们对Jaguar跑车纯粹驾驶体验的期待。

车身设计的灵感来自Jaguar标志性的D-Type赛车。

D-Type是曾在20世纪50年代出场的经典赛车，
曾三次夺下勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军！

从外观上讲，它最为人熟知的特色便是那位于车尾的巨大尾鳍……

这款VGT敞篷跑车令它的尾鳍设计在当下再次焕发出了生命力！

在新车上，尾鳍变成了活动式的，
并且会根据车速自动作出相应调整。

en:
This Gran Turismo original safety car is based on the
Mégane R.S. Trophy.

Renault Sport's distinctive yellow colouring has been
retained, with thin warning lamps added to the roof.
zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅原创的安全车基于Mégane R.S. Trophy打造。

Renault Sport车队那标志性的黄色涂装得到了保留，车顶上还加
入了细长的警示灯。@

en:
This safety car is a Gran Turismo exclusive based on the
Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat.

It features a light bar on the roof, and spotlight-equipped
wing mirrors.

It's also equipped with other specialist equipment, such
as bullbars.

The Charger is actually used as a patrol car by some US
police departments.>
zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的安全车基于
Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat开发。

它的车顶上安装了一组灯条，后视镜上安装了聚光灯，

车身上还添加了一些特种装备，如专用防撞保险杠等。

顺带一提，Charger本身就是许多美国城市警察局的警用巡逻车。:

en:
This GT4 race car was specially developed by TOYOTA GAZOO
Racing for the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

Aside from the safety systems required by the regulations,
very little here is different from the factory model.

Finishing a respectable 3rd in its class...

This car serves as a testament
to the performance potential of the GR Supra.
zh:
这辆GT4赛车由TOYOTA GAZOO Racing团队专门为
纽博格林24小时耐力赛所打造。

除了添置赛事规则强制要求的安全系统外，这辆赛车和
原厂车几乎毫无差别。

最终，它在同组别比赛中取得了第三名的好成绩……

这足以从侧面印证出GR Supra的基础性能有多么强大。

en:
A year after the release of the original GR Supra RZ,
the 2020 model appeared...

Boasting a serious power-up, from <340ps> to a
much meatier <387ps>.

New turbines and a redesigned exhaust manifold were fitted,
giving it much more grunt at high revs too.
zh:
在初代GR Supra RZ亮相的一年后，2020年车款也紧接着推出……

新款的动力得到了大幅强化，从<340ps>直接提升到了更强劲
的<387ps>。

它的引擎中安装了一套新的涡轮，再加上重新设计的排
气管，给了它更多在高转速区间的底气。

en:
The Aston Martin Vantage is what British super sports cars
are all about.

This particular version is the fourth-generation model,
introduced in 2017.

The basic formula changed with this model, getting a twin-turbo
V-8 instead of a naturally-aspirated engine.

Power was rated at more than <500ps>,
allowing the car to easily reach <300km/h>.
zh:
Vantage是一辆后轮驱动的双座跑车。

这个版本是2017发布的第四代车型。

它与第三代的差异在于将自然进气引擎更换为一台V8
双涡轮增压引擎。

新引擎可以输出超过<500ps>的动力，并且能够轻松地跑到
<300km/h>的极速。

en:
A joint effort between Nissan and NISMO, the GT-R NISMO GT3 was
engineered to comply with FIA GT3 regulations as a race machine.

This particular example is the 2018 model.

You’ll notice that the power unit was repositioned lower and closer
to the center of the chassis to enhance handling dynamics.

The driver’s seat was also lowered, further sharpening steering
response and overall vehicle control.
zh:
GT-R NISMO GT3是Nissan和NISMO联手打造
的FIA GT3规则赛车。

这里这辆是2018年的版本。

可以注意到动力单元被安装在较低、靠中间的位置，
以改善操控性。

驾驶员的座位也被放低，使得转向响应更加灵敏。

en:
The ZR1 represented the top-of-the-line version of the C7
Corvette and the ultimate FR American sports car.

It came equipped with a supercharged 6.2-liter V-8 engine...

...that cranked out more than <750ps> and <98.8kgm> of torque.

It also had custom front and rear bumpers, and a
large rear spoiler.

The chassis was impressive as well because this Corvette
could corner with the best super cars in the world.
zh:
这款ZR1是C7科尔维特产品线中最高档的一款，也是所有科尔维特
前置后驱车中的最高成就。

它拥有一台体积庞大的机器增压6.2升V8引擎，

可以输出高达<750ps>的强劲动力，而扭矩也达到了<98.8kgm>。

它还安装了定制的前后保险杠和一部大型后扰流板。

其底盘应用了雪佛兰迄今为止最先进的科技成果，在空气动
力学方面也达到了完美的平衡。<

en:
Cars tuned by Amuse are known for their easy-to-drive nature
and being very, very quick.

And this model exemplified both those qualities.

This car was based on a special version of the Nissan 350Z
called the NISMO 380RS.

The output of the 3.8-liter naturally-aspirated engine was
increased from <350ps> to <386ps>.

"Superleggera" means “super light” in Italian, and indeed, the
weight of the car was reduced by an amazing <140kg>!
zh:
由Amuse改装调校的车都是出了名的易于驾驶且速度奇快。

这款车就将这些优点展现的淋漓尽致。

它是在Nissan 350Z的一个特殊版本，NISMO 380RS上进行的改装，

搭载有一台3.8L自然进气引擎，并将马力从<350ps>提升到了<386ps>。

“Superleggera”这个单词在意大利语里的意思是“超轻”，而这
款车的也确实做到了这一点，整整消去了<140kg>的重量！

en:
Making its debut with the second-gen Audi TT, the TTS is the
sportiest model in the TT lineup.

The "S" stands for "Sport," a letter placed on the company's
highest performing cars.

The TTS was the first "S" model in the TT’s long
and storied history.

The turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder delivers <70ps> more
power than the base model.

And the suspension and steering settings
are totally unique.

As for the drive system, well, it’s what Audi is known for:
quattro all-wheel drive!
zh:
TTS作为第二代Audi TT首次亮相，
是该系列中最运动的一款车型。

S车型向来是Audi旗下最佳性能车款的代名词，
其中的“S”代表“跑车”。

TTS是TT悠久而丰硕的历史中的第一款S车型。

其2L 4缸涡轮引擎的出力比基础车型高出<70ps>。

悬挂和转向设置也是完全独立设计的。

至于驱动系统——当然是Audi的看家产品：
quattro全轮驱动！

en:
The 430 Scuderia is one of the best cars out there
for tearing up the track.

Building on the formidable foundation of the F430 series...

...this variant was both more powerful and lighter,
benefiting from an engine upgrade and a stripped-down interior.

Adding to its prowess was an advanced electronic suspension system,
designed to allow drivers to push the car to its limits.

Its performance was so exceptional that it recorded lap times
rivaling those of the V-12-powered Enzo Ferrari!
zh:
430 Scuderia堪称征服赛道的顶级利器。

这款车型以臻于至善的法拉利F430系列为基础……

通过引擎升级和精简内饰设计，实现了更高的动力输出
和更轻的车身重量。

此外，430 Scuderia还配备了电子控制悬挂系统，使驾
驶者能够在赛道上充分发挥车辆的极限性能。

其惊人的速度令人瞠目结舌——它在赛道上创下的单圈
记录甚至能与搭载V12引擎的顶级超跑Enzo Ferrari比肩！!

en:
The Gallardo series occupies a very important place
in Lamborghini’s history.

Up to the late-1980s, Lamborghini’s lineup included
a mid-engine V8 entry model.

To differentiate these from the legendary V12s,
fans affectionately called them ‘baby Lambos.’

When the Gallardo finally came on the scene,
it broke the baby Lambo mould.

A mid-engine V10 with all-wheel drive...

The Gallardo was distinguished by its chassis performance
under the high-power strain 500 hp-speed.

It was also the first car in Lamborghini’s history to sell
over 10,000 units.
zh:
Gallardo系列在Lamborghini的发展史上具有里程碑式的
意义。

直至20世纪80年代末，Lamborghini的产品阵容中一直
会有一款中置V8引擎的次旗舰车型存在。

为了与该品牌标志性的V12车型区分，车迷们亲昵地
称这些V8车型为“小Lambo”。

然而，Gallardo的问世彻底颠覆了人们对“小Lambo”的
固有印象。

这款搭载中置V10引擎并配备全轮驱动系统的超跑……

以其拔尖的底盘调校而著称，即便在500马力的强大动
力输出下，仍能提供卓越的操控性。

Gallardo还是Lamborghini品牌历史上首款突破10000辆
销量的车型。

sourceName: Lancer GSR Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
en:
Mitsubishi cars adorned with the "MR" badge (Mitsubishi Racing)
 placed a high priority on high performance.

The first Lancer Evolution to include an MR car to its model
lineup was the Evo VIII MR.

The Lancer Evolution VIII MR boasted world-class performance,
bred from the company's winning rally race car.

With its sporty-tuned suspension, improved aerodynamics,
more responsive engine, and lightweight aluminum roof...

...the car was truly a world-class sports car,
albeit with four doors.

To this day, not many sports cars can outperform
the Lancer Evolution VIII MR on the race track.
zh:
带有“MR”（Mitsubishi Racing）标志的Mitsubishi车型
以其高性能而著称。

第一款获得这一殊荣的Lancer Evolution
便是Evo VIII MR……

其标准车型本就是四驱运动型轿车中的世界级之作。

MR版本通过强化悬挂系统、改进空气动力学设计、
提高引擎响应速度和采用铝合金车顶……

打造出一款经过精细调校的轻量化高性能车型。

即使放到今天，在速度和驾驶乐趣方面能与之媲美的
车型也不多见。

en:
The LFA was the first supercar from Lexus.

Can you believe it took a decade to develop?

It was the result of extensive testing at Nürburgring races,
so you can imagine how well this car performs.

One big feature of this front-engine/
rear-wheel-drive car...

...is that its transmission is positioned
on the rear axle.

This makes it a well-balanced "FR" machine with a rear
transaxle configuration.

Powered by a high-revving naturally-aspirated V-10,
the LFA sounds as sweet as it drives.

It's truly one of Japan’s greatest sports cars!

And while its production run ended more than a decade ago,
its allure never seems to diminish.
zh:
LFA是Lexus打造的第一款超级跑车。

你能想象吗？这款车的开发花费了整整十年时间。

在纽博格林的大量测试最终开花结果，
证明这辆车确实拥有飞一般的速度。

这款引擎前置、后轮驱动跑车的一项主要特点……

就是它的传动系统搭载在后轮轴上……

让它成为了一款采用后驱动桥配置、
前后配重比平衡的前置后驱车。

LFA由一台高转速自然进气V10引擎提供动力，
拥有澎湃震撼的声浪。

毫无疑问，它是日本最伟大的跑车之一！

尽管已经于十年前停产，但它的魅力却不减反增。_

en:
This V40 was Volvo’s most popular product in the 2010s.

It was an elegant compact hatchback...

...which combined the simplicity of a sedan with
the utility of a station wagon.

Its exterior styling was strongly influenced by classic Volvos
of the 1960s, such as the P1800 and 1800ES.

And, thanks to the company's innovative safety features,
the V40 gained extreme popularity as a family hauler.

The T5 R-Design was the sportiest of the line, possessing
sports-car-like handling that catered to enthusiast drivers.
zh:
V40系列是Volvo在新世纪第一个十年打造的杰作。

它结合了轿车的简约和强韧与旅行车的功能性……

打造出一款极致优雅的紧凑型掀背车。

从设计角度分析，它从1960年代的传奇车型1800
以及1800ES身上汲取了大量灵感。

这款车配备了多种Volvo标志性的安全功能，在全世界
范围内拥有大量拥趸。

其T5 R-Design版本是产品系列中最具运动感的车型，
因其灵敏的操控性而备受推崇。

en:
RUF’s RGT series is based on successive generations
of Porsche 911 GT3s.

Coming from RUF, these attributes should come as no surprise.

Yet, it is their unparalleled smoothness and tangible precision
that truly set them apart.

The RGT 4.2, derived from the 991 Series 911 GT3...

...showcased a sublime fusion of engine and gearbox, epitomizing
RUF's undeniable expertise.
zh:
RUF的RGT系列车型以历代Porsche 911 GT3为基础打造
而成。

这些车型卓越的性能和速度自不必说……

更令人称道的是其独具特色的驾驶平顺感和精准的操控
感，这使RGT系列在超跑领域中脱颖而出。

此处的RGT 4.2以991系列的911 GT3为原型。

RUF为引擎和变速箱设计的协同效应堪称完美，充分展
现了RUF的非凡造诣。

en:
Mercedes-Benz has produced some memorable high-spec rear-wheel
drive sedans in its long history.

The C Class are the most compact of these.

But don't let their size deceive you, because they
deliver good power and world-class handling.

This particular iteration is the 2015 AMG C63 S, which is
the top-of-the-line model that packs more than <500ps>.

AMG, a subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz, focuses on tuning the
company's cars, making them world-class sports machines.

In particular, AMG is famous for hand-assembling all of its
engines.

The company follows the philosophy of "one man, one engine"—
every engine is the responsibility of a single engineer.
zh:
Mercedes-Benz制造过许多高规格、高性能的后轮驱动汽车。

“C Class”是其中最紧凑的型号。

但千万不要因为体型的缘故而小看了这些性能优异，操
控稳定、可靠的好车。

这台迭代车型是一款2015年的AMG C63 S，是产品线中的顶配
车型，马力高达<500ps>。

AMG是Mercedes-Benz的子公司，专注于开发跑车和高性能车辆，

因其坚持手工组装引擎而声名远扬。

公司严格履行“一人一引擎”的原则，让每一名工程师
都全权负责打造一部引擎。

en:
Unveiled in 2016, the Bugatti Chiron was developed
as the successor to the Veyron.

The line that runs over the centre of the body
is a nod to the famous Type 57 Atlantic.

Priding itself on a chassis strong enough to compete
against the top-tier racing cars at Le Mans...

This super sportscar is powered by an 8L
quad-turbocharged W16 engine.

It has a maximum output of a whopping <1500ps>!
zh:
布加迪Chiron于2016年公布，是作为布加迪Veryron的
后继车型而开发的。

贯穿车身的中轴线是对鼎鼎大名的
Type 57 Atlantic的致敬。

这辆超级跑车配有足以与勒芒顶尖赛车
相媲美的高强度底盘……

由一台8升四涡轮增压的W16引擎驱动。

它的最大输出功率可达到巨大的<1500ps>！

If you’re in the market for a mid-engine Porsche sports car,
this Cayman GT4 is strongly recommended.

It’s the sister-model of the Porsche Boxster.

Developed in 1996, the Boxster was a 2-seat,
open-top mid-engine sports car.

For all intents and purposes, the Cayman, introduced in 2005,
was the coupe version of the Boxster.

The combination of its mid-engine chassis and rigid body
resulted in exceptional handling...

...quickly making it one of the most desired sports cars
aong the world's driving enthusiasts.

This Cayman GT4 was released in 2015 as the second-gen
evolution of the original.

Like the Porsche 911 GT3, it was a special model
prepared by Porsche Motorsports.

Employing high-performance brakes, a sharened chassis,
and parts from the 911 GT3...

这辆车也被俗称是保时捷Boxster的姊妹型号。

1996年开发的Boxster是一款双座

而Cayman则姗姗来迟，在2005年亮相，

A "plug-in hybrid," or "parallel hybrid," is a system where the
gasoline engine and electric motor power the wheels.

This makes them different from "series hybrids," in which
the engine's sole purpose is to charge the batteries.

Therefore, plug-in hybrids tend to have larger
batteries because they help to supply drive power.

Hybrid supercars were still very rare when Porsche released
this model in 2013.

Despite bing a hybrid, the 918 Spyder possessed
plenty of DNA from Porsche's legendary race car, the 917.

The 918 Spyder was a testament to Porsche's relentless pursuit of

en:
The Challenger SRT Demon is Dodge’s most menacing
muscle car, no doubt about it.

Inspired by drag racing machines, its specially-tuned
V-8 was capable of pumping out more than 800 hp.

Combine that with its hearty torque figures, this car
accelerated with the best of them.

It reached the quarter-mile mark in just 9.65 seconds!

In fact, this car was so quick that it was banned from
drag racing in North America.

What’s more, Dodge sold performance kits for the Demon
the likes of which you won’t find anywhere else.

It was a modern American muscle car that was truly
in a league of its own.[
zh:
毋庸置疑，Challenger SRT Demon是
Dodge旗下性能最极致的肌肉车。

这款车的设计思路偏重于打造一款直线加速赛车，并采用
一部特殊调校的V8引擎，可以输出超过800 hp的动力。

无论是起步速度还是加速性能，都足以
跻身全球的最前列……

毕竟，它能在9.65秒内跑完400米的距离！

而更令人大跌眼镜的是，因为这辆车的速度实在太快，
以至于在北美被禁止参加直线加速赛。

此外，Dodge还不失时机地推出了Demon性能套件，
而且只此一家，别无分号。

这是一辆现代化的美式肌肉车，
拥有独树一帜的特点和性能。

en:
The sixth-generation Civic Type R is also called the FK8.

It is powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 that
produces <320ps> and more than <40kgm> of torque.

This limited-edition car was released in 2020.

It boasts a custom-tuned suspension and is
<20kg> lighter than the original car.

Other notable features was its Sunlight Yellow body, which
is an homage to the first-gen Civic Type R labeled the EK9.+
zh:
第六代Civic Type R也被称为FK8。

它采用了一台2L直列四缸涡轮增压引擎，可以提供<320ps>的
马力和超过<40kgm>的扭矩。

这款限量版车型在2020年发布，

拥有一套定制化调校的悬挂系统，并减重<20kg>。

阳光黄色的配色尤其引人注目，令人不禁回想起第一代
Civic Type R EK9刚诞生时的模样。

en:
If you're looking for a small hatchback that's fun to drive,
then this fourth-generation Swift Sport is the car for you!

This model probably marked the biggest evolution in the
history of the line.

It weighs only <970kg>, but the turbo engine
is capable of delivering <20kgm> of torque.

The newly developed body is exceptionally stiff,
and its under-body aerodynamics are advanced.

The simple, responsive handling and the excellent power
delivery make this a great car to throw around corners.
zh:
如果你想要寻找一台充满驾驶乐趣的小型掀背车，这款
第四代Swift Sport就非常适合您！

这个型号见证了整个产品系列历史上最大的革新。

这台重量仅为<970kg>的小车却装备了一台涡轮增压引擎，可
以输出超过<20kgm>的扭矩。

全新设计的车身拥有极其出色的刚性，车身底盘的空气
动力学性能也有了巨大的飞跃。

简单而灵敏的操控性带来愉悦的驾驶体验，加速性能更
是不容小觑！

en:
Ferrari's long history of producing cars with midship
V8 engines began in the 1970s with the 308 GTB.

This Ferrari F8 Tributo is a modern version of that classic.

As you would expect, its 3.9L V8 engine is mounted
midship.

This is an improved version of the engine used in its
predecessor, the 488 GTB, packing 710 BHP of power.

What's more, the response time is excellent for a turbo
engine, with no discernible lag at all.

This is down to the fact that the Tributo uses an electronic
turbo system first seen in Ferrari race cars.
zh:
以1970年推出的308 GTB为开端，Ferrari开启了使用中置V8引擎的
悠久历史。

这款Ferrari F8 Tributo就是那款经典车型的现代版本。

毫无意外，它的3.9L V8引擎也采用了中置布局。

作为前一代车型488 GTB所采用的引擎的升级版，它可以输
出<720ps>的动力。

以一款涡轮增压引擎而言，它的响应速度非常出色，几
乎感觉不到任何延迟。

这都要归功于为Tributo引入的电子涡轮增压系统，这是从Ferrari
赛车上下放的技术。

en:
Suzuki is one of the few manufacturers
that builds both 2- and 4-wheel vehicles.

This machine you see here broke new ground for the company.
It's called the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo.

It's a compact 2-seater convertible evoking
memories of the Swift Sport and Cappuccino.

Under the hood, located just aft of the front axle line is...

...the <1340cc> engine from the Suzuki Hayabusa,
one of the most popular motorbikes in the world.

In addition to sporting two motors up front,
the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo also has one at the rear.

This gives the hybrid-powered vehicle all-wheel-drive
and plenty of power on demand.
zh:
铃木是为数不多同时制造两轮摩托车和四轮汽车
的制造商之一。

我们这里的这辆尤物是他们的一个“突破”——
铃木Vision Gran Turismo。

从车身来看，这是一辆紧凑型的双座敞篷车，
令人想起速翼特Sport和Cappuccino。

但是最值得注意的是它的前中置引擎！

别惊讶，这可是一台<1340cc>的铃木隼引擎——
世界上最顶级的摩托车引擎。

除了前面的两个电机，后面也安装了一个……

它是四轮驱动车型中最令人印象深刻的混合动力车型。

en:
The RX-Vision concept car was first presented at the 2015
Tokyo Motor Show.

Mazda's stated aim when designing it was to create the
world's most beautiful rear-wheel drive sports car.

Its distinctive styling is bursting with life, and is based
on Mazda's 'KODO: Soul of Motion' design theory.

Powered by a naturally aspirated four-rotor engine...

It follows in the footsteps of the Mazda's legendary
787B racing car.|
zh:
这款RX-VISION概念赛车的首次露面是在2015年
的东京车展。

马自达表示，此车的设计目的就是打造出全世界最漂亮
的后驱跑车。

以马自达的“魂动”设计理念为原点，
它那独特的造型充满了生命力。

追随马自达传奇赛车787B的脚步，

它也搭载了一台自然进气的四转子引擎。

en:
The Giulia GTA and modified GTAm are the highest-performing
Alfa Romeo four-door sedans of all time.

This model has its origin in the Giulia Sprint GTA,
a legendary racer from 1965.

‘GTA’, by the way, is short for ‘Gran Turismo Alleggerita’.

Italian for ‘lightened’, ‘Alleggerita’ is an apt descriptor
for the GTA, which traded in brawn for speed.

In addition to sporting an upgraded engine,
capable of <540ps>, this new Giulia GTA...

Makes use of lightweight carbon panels across its roof,
bonnet, fenders and bumpers.

The GTAm is the modified version of the GTA.

The addition of a massive carbon-fibre wing, and the lack
of rear seating, push its lightness to the limit.
zh:
Giulia GTA和其官方改装车型GTAm是
Alfa Romeo史上性能最强的4门轿车。

其研发原型为Giulia Sprint GTA，生产于1965年的
传奇跑车。

顺便一提，“GTA”是“Gran Turismo Alleggerita”的缩写。

“Alleggerita”是意大利语的“轻量化”的意思，用来描述这辆
牺牲重量、换取速度的GTA再合适不过。

除了装载一台马力高达<540ps>的升级版引擎外，
这辆新的Giulia GTA……

将车顶、引擎盖、挡泥板和保险杠都换成了
轻质碳纤维板。

GTAm则是GTA的官方改装车型。

不仅加装了巨大的碳纤维尾翼，还彻底拆除了后座，
将轻量化推向了极致。

en:
This is the 2021 BRZ GT300 that made headlines
at the Super GT series in Japan.

As you may know, the Super GT is divided into
two classes: the GT500 and the GT300.

Having competed in the GT300 class
for nearly a quarter of a century...

...Subaru finally achieved a stunning series victory
in 2021 with this BRZ GT300.

As the first Subaru car to win the Super GT title,
it is truly one for the record books.

In terms of aerodynamics and weight distribution,
it is a marked improvement over its predecessor.

Thanks to the improved aerodynamics, made possible
by a brand-new BRZ body...

...air resistance can be kept to a minimum, which in turn
helps to generate downforce.
zh:
这辆2021 BRZ GT300在日本的Super GT系列赛中夺得桂冠。

你可能听说过，Super GT共分为两个级别：
GT500和GT300。

在GT300赛事中拼搏了近四分之一个世纪后，

Subaru终于在2021年凭借这辆BRZ GT300
拿下了振奋人心的系列赛冠军。

作为第一辆赢得Super GT冠军的Subaru，
它确实值得被载入史册。

在空气动力学和重量分配方面，
它比前代车型有了明显的改进。

全新的车身设计带来改进后的空气动力学效果，

将空气阻力降倒最低，进而产生更多的下压力。

en:
This is a Gran Turismo original Gr.4 race car is based on
the fourth-generation Suzuki Swift Sport.

As you probably know, Suzuki is famous for producing motorcycles
as well as cars.

So it should come as no surprise that the look of the Swift Sport
KATANA Edition Gr.4 was inspired by the Katana sports bike.

The car was inspired by the Swift Sport KATANA Edition prototype,
which was shown at the Tokyo Auto Salon in 2020.

Its key features are the logo it shares with the Katana
motorcycle, and its bold and imposing wide fender.
zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车基于
第四代铃木速翼特Sport开发。

我想不需要我多介绍您也知道，
铃木是闻名遐迩的摩托车和汽车制造商。

这款速翼特Sport组别4的外观设计灵感也确实来自于
同公司的传奇摩托车“Katana”。

它的改装原型是在2020年东京汽车沙龙上亮相的
速翼特Sport Katana版，

拥有与Katana摩托车一模一样的标志，
以及粗犷霸气的挡泥板。

en:
This GR 86 represents an evolved version of the Toyota 86
rear-wheel-drive sports car.

Continuing the tradition established by the original AE86, this
latest “hachi-roku” is compact and has an FR layout.

What’s new is the 2.4-liter flat-four engine.

With an extra <400cc> of displacement, it delivers more
power and torque than ever before.

And, let me remind you that the new 86’s body structure
has been significantly stiffened...

...so when you’re tackling a winding road, you’ll really feel
as if you’re one with the car!
zh:
这辆GR 86是经典的后轮驱动跑车Toyota 86的进化版。

它继承由AE86开创的传统：适中的车身尺寸，以及必不可
少的后轮驱动。

它的2.4升水平对置四缸引擎是一款全新开发的引擎，

比前代多了<400cc>的排量，以输出更加充沛的动力和扭矩。

另外值得一提的是，它的车身刚性也得到了大幅的强化。

当您握住这辆车的方向盘，您会感觉自己仿佛能够掌控
一切！

en:
This GR010 HYBRID was Toyota’s all-new entry for
the 2021 World Endurance Championship (WEC).

The 2021 season saw the introduction of
a ‘Hypercar’ category.

This top-tier class is the successor to the LMP1.

In any event, the GR010 HYBRID was built
specifically for the Hypercar Class.

This Car No. 7 claimed a victory in the fourth round
of the 2021 WEC event at Le Mans.

It was driven by Mike Conway, Kamui Kobayashi
and José María López.

To top things off, Car No. 8 followed right
on its heels, placing in second.

Therefore, in its first Le Mans attempt, the GR010 HYBRID
claimed an impressive one-two finish.

With this, Toyota was able to extend its winning streak to
four straight Le Mans victories since 201
zh:
这辆GR010 HYBRID是Toyota为
2021年世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）准备的全新参赛车辆。

2021赛季，锦标赛引进了“超级跑车”组别。

这个顶级类别可以视作是LMP1的继承者。

总而言之，GR010 HYBRID是特别为“超级跑车”
级别而设计的。

这辆幸运的7号赛车由迈克·康威、小林可梦伟
和何塞·马里亚·洛佩斯驾驶。

在勒芒的2021 WEC第四轮比赛中取得了冠军。

锦上添花的是，8号赛车也紧随其后冲线，名列第二亚军。

也就是说，GR010 HYBRID在勒芒的第一次亮相，
就令人惊叹地包揽了冠亚军。

算下来，Toyota自2018年以来已经在勒芒取得四连冠了。

en:
This Garage RCR Civic is a finely-tuned mod of the EG Civic,
a popular Japanese hot hatch from the 1990s.

Garage RCR is a body shop located in Phoenix, Arizona.

They specialise in fitting PANDEM widebody kits and
other Japanese tuning parts to cars.

This car is, without a doubt, a JDM custom hero.

Powered by a swapped-in 2.4L K-series engine with turbo,
it can push 400 horsepower, and drives like a dream.

In 2017, it was crowned with the Gran Turismo Award at SEMA,
the world’s largest custom-car show.
zh:
EG Civic是一款20世纪90年代流行的日本高性能掀背车，
这辆Garage RCR Civic就是对该车型精心改装后的产物。

Garage RCR是一家位于亚利桑那州凤凰城的车身工厂。

他们擅长安装PANDEM宽体套件以及
其他日产改装部件。

毫无疑问，这辆车是JDM改装车中的精品。

它搭载了一台带涡轮增压的2.4L K系列引擎，
最大功率可达400马力，驾驶起来更是如梦如幻。

2017年，它在全球最大的改装车展SEMA展会上
荣获Gran Turismo大奖。

en:
While the Suzuki Jimny may belong to the kei-car class,
it's still a rugged and capable 4x4 vehicle.

Small yet strong, it combines urban agility
with world-class off-road performance.

Don’t let its compact size fool you—this car
can hit serious speeds.

Equipped with physicality and functionality,
it excels on rocks, sand and even snow.

Introduced in 1970, it was the first kei-car to
boast a genuine 4-wheel-drive system.

And, for more than 50 years, it has built its success
on tradition and change.
zh:
尽管Suzuki Jimny属于日式轻型车类型，
但同样也是一款粗犷的4x4越野车。

它同时具备轻量和坚固的特点，综合了
都市通勤车的便利性和世界级的越野性能。

不要被它的紧凑型规格蒙蔽了，
它可以达到非常惊人的极速。

它兼顾韧性和功能性，即便在最崎岖的
地形上也能表现出色。

这款车于1970年首次亮相，是第一款真正采用
四轮驱动系统的日式轻型车……

而在50年多的发展历史里，它也在坚守传统
和不断求变中书写了无数的成功故事。

en:
The Suzuki Jimny is best known as Japan’s kei-car
off-roader par excellence.

The Jimny that broke the kei-car mold was the Sierra,
designed for the global market.

This Jimny Sierra is the third-gen model, known as the JB74.
Its rugged-yet-boxy stance is quite attractive, wouldn’t you say?

While the original Jimny had a mere <660cc> displacement,
the Sierra possessed a 1.5-liter engine capable of <102ps>.

Thanks to its part-time 4WD system and rigid suspension
in the front and rear, the Sierra offers sublime handling.

The JC grade refers to a Japanese trim that includes LED
headlamps and alloy wheels as standard fare."
zh:
Suzuki Jimny作为日本轻型车中的越野典范而闻名。

在产品线中，突破轻型车界限的是为全球市场
打造的“Sierra”车型。

这款第三代Jimny Sierra型号为“JB74”。
它那棱角分明的硬朗外形极具吸引力，你说是吗？

相比原版Jimny仅有<660cc>的排量，Sierra搭载了
一台可输出<102ps>的1.5升引擎。

凭借分时四轮驱动系统和前后刚性悬挂的配置，
Sierra展现出卓越的操控性。

“JC”等级是其日本市场版本，标准配置包括LED前大灯
和铝合金轮圈。

en:
The DeLorean first exploded into the public consciousness
when it featured in the movie Back to the Future.

DMC, the company that built it, was founded by John Z.
DeLorean, a former vice president of General Motors.

Their first and only production model was the DMC-12, and
DeLorean himself oversaw the entire creation process.

DMC lasted less than two years after production began, but
the brand was subsequently acquired by another company.

The DeLorean seen here is the 'Series 2', a remake proposed
by the new DMC.

Its key feature is an improved <200ps> engine.
zh:
这款DeLorean凭借电影《回到未来》而为大众熟识，在当时红
极一时。

打造这辆车的DMC公司由前General Motors的副总裁
John Z. DeLorean创立。

DMC-12是他们的第一款，也是唯一一款量产型号，由DeLorean亲自
参与并领导了整个开发过程。

DMC在投产后只存在了短短不到两年的时间。好在品牌之
后被另一家公司收购，才得以存续下来。

这里的这辆DeLorean是“Series 2”，是由新DMC公司提议开发的重
制版，

主打强化动力的<200ps>引擎。

sourceName: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
en:
Ford's achievements at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the 1960s
are some of the most impressive in the company's history.

Their newly developed GT40 allowed them to beat the Ferrari
team, and become champions for the first time.

This Gran Turismo original Gr.3 race car is a modern version
of that classic motor.

It is based on the Ford GT that was released in 2004.

Its supercharged midship V8 engine is capable of a
massive <600ps>.

What's more, both the suspension and transmission have been
designed specially with racing in mind.
zh:
Ford在1960年代的勒芒24小时耐力赛中取得的辉煌战绩是这
家公司历史上最激动人心的成就之一。

由他们自行研发的新车GT40击败了Ferrari车队，第一次拿下勒
芒赛事的冠军。

这辆跑车浪漫旅原创的Gr.3级别赛车就是那辆经典赛
车的现代版本。

它基于2004年推出的Ford GT开发。

车上搭载的中置机械增压V8引擎可以输出惊人的<600ps>马力，

包括悬挂系统和变速箱都针对比赛而进行了重新设计。

en:
Ferrari’s front-mounted V12 models pay tribute to a tradition
as enduring as the marque itself.

Building on the legacy of icons like the 250 series, the Daytona,
and the Maranello, the 812 Superfast made its debut in 2017.

While its design echoes classic Ferrari elegance, its
aerodynamic form is thoroughly modern.

The V12 engine has been enlarged to 6.5 liters, producing 800-horsepower,
hence the car’s numerical designation.

With a generous <2720mm> wheelbase typical of grand tourers, the
812 Superfast also offers practical trunk space behind the seats.

And thanks to its 4-wheel steering system, this car has remarkably
agile handling, making it shine on winding roads.@
zh:
Ferrari的前置V12引擎拥有悠久的历史，几乎和
这家传奇的意大利公司本身一样经典。

在250系列、Daytona和Maranello取得巨大成功后，
这款812 Superfast在2017年盛大亮相。

尽管外观采用经典风格，但它运用了
最现代的空气动力学设计。

其V12引擎扩容到了6.5升，再加上产出的800马力，
这便是812这个名字的由来。

除了GT车型常见的<2720mm>轴距之外，812 Superfast
还在座椅后方提供了充足的后备箱空间。

此外，由于采用了4轮转向系统，它也拥有水银泻地般
的操控，特别是在蜿蜒崎岖的道路上。

en:
Every gearhead knows that Maserati was founded
specifically to build race cars.

Released in 2020, the MC20 is a genuine mid-engine
sports car that carries on this noble tradition.

Its twin-turbo V-6 engine features an F1-derived
pre-chamber combustion system!

Not only does it offer a smooth ride on city streets,
but it can hold its own on any race track.!
zh:
车迷们都知道，玛莎拉蒂是
专为制造赛车而成立的。

发布于2020年的MC20作为一辆纯粹的中置引擎跑车，
继承了这一高贵的传承。

它的双涡轮增压V6引擎采用了源于F1的预燃室点火技术！

不仅在城市道路上能够提供顺畅的驾驶体验，在任何赛道上
也能游刃有余。

en:
The long nose and short deck proportions have long been
a benchmark of sports-car design.

If you were to ask enthusiasts to name a recent BMW that embodies
this ideal, many would point to the 2003 Z4, a true masterpiece.

The successor to the Z3, it came powered by only an inline-6,
making it feel somewhat more prestigious in comparison.

Its elegant body was penned by American designer Chris Bangle,
and it is distinguished by the Z-shaped curve on its sides.

Despite being a convertible, the Z4 stays true to BMW’s values,
with 50/50 weight distribution and triple the rigidity of the Z3.

A race version competed at the Nürburgring 24h,
making it one of those rare cars that looks as good as it goes.
zh:
“长车鼻短车身”比例一直是理想的跑车设计。

如果要在宝马近年来推出的杰作中找出一个最佳案例，
最众望所归的答案就是2003年推出的敞篷车型Z4。

作为Z3的后继车型，它仅推出直列6缸引擎版本，相比
之下，更加彰显尊崇和信仰。

它优雅的车身出自美国设计师克里斯·班戈之手，
车身侧面的Z字线条尤为别致吸睛。

尽管是一款敞篷车，但Z4拥有纯正的宝马血统，其车重
分配比例接近50/50，车身刚度可达Z3的三倍。

不仅如此，它的赛车规格版本参与过纽博格林24小时耐力赛。
毫无疑问，这是一辆外观与驾驶性能并重的稀有车型。

en:
Monoform bodies, known for their roomy interiors,
have long been the go-to for high-occupancy minivans.

The Avantime turned that idea on its head, becoming the first to
pair a spacious cabin with the sleekness of a low-occupancy coupe.

Derived from the 1997 third-gen Espace, the Avantime broke new
ground with its bold three-door layout and lightweight FRP body.

This resulted in an airy, elegant cabin unlike anything else.
With no B-pillar, the side windows stretch to the rear.

Open the expansive sunroof,
and it nearly feels like a full convertible!

Penned by Renault’s legendary designer Patrick Le Quément, this
unique coupe redefined what was possible with a monoform body.
zh:
可提供宽敞内部空间的单体车身设计通常被用于
满足大容量多人座厢式旅行车的需求。

而首次挑战这一概念，将宽敞空间运用到
小众三门轿跑车上的，正是Avantime。

基于1997年第三代Espace，Avantime采用了
令人眼前一亮的三门玻璃纤维车身设计。

呈现出既优雅又独特的座舱氛围。
无B柱设计让侧窗可以完全打开。

配合大尺寸天窗开启时，几乎让人感觉置身于敞篷车中！

由Renault首席设计师帕特里克·勒·奎芒倾心打造，这款
独特的三门轿跑车为单体车身设计开创了新境界。

en:
The Model 3 is Tesla’s entry model,
and a compact sedan EV.

Much like the Model S, it has a sporty design
that is almost coupe-like in appearance.

Powered by two motors at the front and rear,
this is one car that does not underperform.

Capable of going from 0-100 km/h in just 3.3 seconds,
this 4WD sedan can accelerate like a super sports car!

The interior of the car is, naturally, as thoroughly
Tesla as the exterior...

With many of the car’s controls laid out on a 15-inch
touchscreen.
zh:
Model 3是Tesla的入门车款，也是一辆紧凑型电动轿车。

和Model S类似，它采用了运动型外观设计，形似双门轿车。

Model 3的前后轮各由一部电机驱动，
在性能方面丝毫没有妥协。

这款四驱版本的加速性能可以媲美超级跑车，
能够在3.3秒内完成0-100 km/h的加速！

这款车将大量的控制模块集中布置在一块15英寸触摸屏上……

而内饰方面也和外观一样，拥有鲜明的特斯拉风格。>

en:
This 1971 Ford Maverick was built by Greening Auto Company
(GAC), a custom car builder in the U.S.

It made history when it took the GT Award...

...at the 2018 SEMA Show, the world’s largest event for
automotive aftermarket products.

The original Ford Maverick was an affordable and practical
compact coupe.

But for this custom job, the chassis was rebuilt
with genuine racing architecture.

The car's 7.0-liter Windsor V-8, widely considered
to be a Ford masterpiece...

...has been tuned to deliver an unbelievable
1,200 horsepower!

In 2019, this GAC Maverick registered a top speed
of <326km/h>.?
zh:
这辆1971福特翼虎是由美国定制汽车制造商
Greening Auto Company（“GAC”）制造的。

这是一台创造了历史的车……

它在2018年的世界顶级定制汽车年度盛会
——美国汽车用品改装车展览会上获得了跑车浪漫旅大奖。

福特翼虎原本只是一款经济实用的紧凑型双门轿车。

但这辆改装车就不一样了，它的底盘按照
真正的赛车结构重新打造……

并安装了一台经过调校的7升Windsor V8引擎，
后者是公认的福特引擎杰作。

我可不是信口雌黄，要知道它可以输出
高达1200马力的动力！

在2019年，这辆GAC Maverick跑出了
令人折服的<326km/h>最高速度记录。?

en:
Ask someone to name the greatest American sports car,
and chances are, the answer will be the Corvette.

The model before you is the fifth-generation iteration—known
as the C5—a modern marvel of sports-car engineering.

This particular version revives a storied name: "Z06," a nod to
the second-generation Corvette’s renowned race package.

At its heart lies the LS6 engine—a compact yet formidable
<390ps> V-8 derived from the legendary LS1.

Naturally, the chassis has been refined, complemented by
competition-grade suspension and brakes.

A close relative of the C5-R race car, this Corvette masterfully
blends heritage with high-performance capability./
zh:
要问最伟大的美国跑车是哪一台，大部分人
都会回答“Corvette”。

在你眼前的就是被称为“C5”的第五代Corvette，
一辆堪称杰作的现代跑车。

更值得一提的是，因为它的型号名称“Z06”来源于第二代
赛车套件，所以还被赋予了“传奇重生”的意义。

其最为人称道的特性无疑是它的LS6动力单元。这款引擎基于
名声赫赫的LS1打造，体积虽小，却有<390ps>的强大动力。

不消说，它的底盘也得到了强化升级，并配备了
竞赛级悬挂和刹车。

作为“C5-R”的姐妹车型，这款第五代Corvette兼顾了
传统和性能，实在不可多得。

en:
This is the M2 Competition, an upgraded variant of the
compact, powerful rear-wheel drive M2.

BMW's M models are considered very special by racing
fans all over the world.

This is because they're developed by BMW M, BMW's dedicated
motorsport subsidiary.

Their cars trace their ancestry back to legendary sports
cars of the 1970s, such as the BMW 3.0 CSL and BMW M1.

The M2 Competition features a straight-six twin turbo S55B
engine, developed by BMW M.

The car's cooling systems, brakes and body rigidity are
also a step up on the base M2.

Of all the M2 series retail models, this is the one that'll
provide the best experience on the track.
zh:
这是一台M2 Competition，是基于动力强劲的
紧凑型后驱车M2升级而来的改款车型。

BMW的M系列在全世界车迷的心目中有着十分特别的地位。

因为它们都是由BMW专门从事
赛车运动的子公司BMW M公司所开发的。

他们所制造的赛车的血统可以追溯到二十世纪七十年代的
传奇赛车身上，例如BMW 3.0 CSL和BMW M1。

M2 Competition采用由BMW M开发的直列六缸双涡轮增压S55B引擎。

此车的冷却系统、刹车和车身刚度
也是基于原版M2升级而来。

在所有M2系列零售车型中，这一款在赛道上的体验是最出色的。

en:
This MAZDA3 fastback is especially prized
for its beautiful design.

In Japan, it has long been referred to as the Axela.

But ever since the debut of this fourth-gen model in 2018,
it has been known around the world as the MAZDA3.

Distinguished by its phenomenal styling, which adopts Mazda’s
"KODO" design language...

...this hatchback, with its beautiful roof line,
is referred to as a fastback in some markets.

In 2020, it won the World Car Design of the Year title,
an award celebrating the best international car design.
zh:
斜背版MAZDA3因其靓丽的设计造型而深受消费者喜爱。

在日本，这辆车被称为“Axela”（昂克赛拉）。

不过随着第4代型号于2018年亮相，它在全世界
打响了“MAZDA3”这个名号。

它那现象级的外观设计充分体现了Mazda的“魂动”
设计语言，优雅而独树一帜……

这款掀背车拥有美妙的车顶线条，并以“斜背车”的身份
在部分市场展开宣传。

在2020年，这款车赢得了国际性的汽车设计奖项——
世界汽车年度最佳设计大奖。

en:
The Toyota Alphard is a minivan
that is synonymous with "luxury."

This third-generation Executive Lounge variant
is the top-of-the-line grade.

This popular vehicle has a plush and comfortable
interior that makes it the limousine of minivans.

In Japan, minivans are generally used as family cars,
specifically designed for the country's unique roads and traffic.

Among all the minivan models, the Toyota Alphard has long been
considered the most luxurious of the bunch.

Many consider the Alphard so much more than a minivan.
They see it more as a genuine luxury vehicle.
zh:
Toyota Alphard在日本是一款代表了“奢华”的厢式旅行车。

这辆第三代的Executive Lounge版本
是全系列中的最高档次。

这款车就像一架私人喷气飞机，其奢华舒适的后排座位
也使其成为了厢式旅行车中的“豪车”。

在日本，厢式旅行车通常会被当做家庭用车，
针对这个国家独特的道路和交通条件进行专门设计。

Toyota Alphard长久以来一直在这一品类树立着奢华的定位。

正因如此，它不仅仅是一款厢式旅行车，
更是一款货真价实的豪华汽车。

en:
This original Gran Turismo Gr.4 race car uses the
S15 Silvia Spec-R as its base.

Its most distinctive feature is its strikingly wide body.

Around <170mm> wider than the base car, it came equipped
with extra-wide race tires.

As the "Touring Car" name implies, this model was
designed for the race track.

But that's not to say you can't drift this car because
after all, Silvias love to be thrown sideways.

In fact, the handbrake has been left intact to allow the
driver to break the rear tires loose.

Whether you're looking for grip on the track or just want to
slide through corners, you can't go wrong with this machine.
zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车基于
S15 Silvia Spec-R开发。

它最显著的特征就是那夺人眼球的宽体车身，

比一般
车宽了约<170mm>，所以可以容纳下宽大的赛车轮胎。

顾名思义，这款“Touring Car”是专为赛道设计的……

尽管如此，Silvia也受到了漂移爱好者群体的热捧。

事实上，为了兼顾漂移性能，这辆车甚至完整地保留了
手刹的配置。

不论是想要足够的赛道抓地力，还是追求漂移过弯时的
爽快感，这辆车一定都能够让您称心如意！\

en:
The "Black Series" is a name given to the meanest road cars
that Mercedes AMG produces.

This AMG GT is one of just five Black Series models
ever developed.

This means it's not just supremely powerful, it's also
supremely rare.

Mercedes AMG has experienced success in a variety of
motorsports genres, including Formula 1 and touring cars.

And the cutting-edge technology developed on the track has
trickled down to the Black Series.

The car's aerodynamics and chassis development incorporate
technology from the GT3 race machine.

The engine is one of AMG's jewels in the crown, boasting
<703ps> of power.

On the Nürburgring's Nordschleife in 2020, the AMG GT recorded
a time of 6:43:616, a record for production cars at the timeǾ
zh:
“Black Series”是我的Mercedes AMG生产的
终极公路车才能得到的头衔。

这辆AMG GT是有史以来开发的五款Black Series车型之一。

这意味着，这辆车不仅极度强劲——还极度稀有。

Mercedes AMG已经在许多赛事，包括F1和房车赛中取得了成功……

为上述赛事开发的顶尖技术也被运用到了Black Series上。

这辆车的空气动力学和底盘设计都采用了GT3赛车上的技术。

它搭载了一台AMG的顶级市售发动机，
能输出高达<703ps>的动力。

2020年，这辆车在纽博格林赛道的北环
跑出了6:43:616的成绩——当时市面车型的最快记录。

en:
Designed like an F1 machine, this road-going car
is certainly deserving of its hypercar status.

It is the result of a technological partnership between
Aston Martin and Red Bull Racing.

Its body features the latest aerodynamic know-how
and weight-reducing materials.

The car's styling was penned by Adrian Newey, a designer
responsible for countless F1 race machines.

The striking exterior is meant to maximize downforce
and harness the air that flows around its body.

Its power unit is unbelievably fierce.

Combining a 6.5-liter V-12 that revs past the 10,000-rpm mark and
an electric motor, it produces a hearty <1155ps>."
zh:
这是一辆按照F1赛车思路设计的公路车，
更是一款名副其实的“终极跑车”。

它是由Aston Martin和红牛车队
进行技术合作所诞生的产物。

它的车身运用了最新的空气动力学技术知识
和应用了最新的减重材料。

不出所料的是，这款车是由打造了多款传奇F1车型
的设计师阿德里安·纽维所设计。

其引人注目的外观其实功能兼备，可以最大化下压力
以及利用车身周围流动的空气。

它的动力单元也拥有令人难以置信的凶猛性能。

它结合了一款转速可超过<10000rpm>的6.5升V12引擎
以及一部高性能电机，可以输出<1155ps>的动力。

en:
In 2015, the South Korean manufacturer Hyundai established
its 'Genesis' premium brand.

The G70 is the third model produced by the brand since its
inception.

It's the entry-level model of the Genesis sedan range.

Since debuting in 2017, the G70 has been widely praised for
its design...

Though that design was overhauled in 2020, adding an extra
layer of refinement to the car's striking appearance.

This 3.3T is the highest grade model in the G70 range.

It has a 3.3L V6 twin turbo engine, capable of a massive
<370ps>.
zh:
2015年，韩国车厂现代成立了名为“捷尼赛思”的高级旗下品牌。

G70是该品牌诞生后生产的第三个车型。

它也是捷尼赛思轿车系列的入门级车型。

自从G70于2017年公布以来，它的设计大受各方好评……

该车的设计在2020年进行了大幅修改，
使得这辆车本已新颖的外形变得更加精致了。

这辆3.3T是G70车型中的最高端版本。

它搭载了一台3.3升的V6双涡轮增压引擎，能输出
<370ps>的澎湃动力。

en:
This Gr.4 racing car is a Gran Turismo original, based on
the G70.

Its shape incorporates all the latest design trends, as well
as a restrained approach to aerodynamics.

It features a 4WD layout, just like its base car, and its
engine has been tuned to produce <420ps>./
zh:
这台Gr.4赛车是Gran Turismo的原创赛车，
原型为G70。

它的造型囊括了所有的最新设计，
并采用了较为克制的空气动力学外形。

与原型一样，这辆车也采用了四驱布局，但引擎出力被提高至了<420ps>。

en:
This Gr.4 racing car is a Gran Turismo original, based on
the Genesis X Concept.

The Genesis X Concept is a concept model, released in 2020.

It incorporates a futuristic design vision, based around the
signature Two Lines theme.

This car takes that model as a base...

And turns it into an all-new Genesis racing machine!
zh:
这台Gr.4赛车是Gran Turismo的原创赛车，
原型为Genesis X Concept。

Genesis X Concept是一辆于2020年亮相的概念车。

它的外形设计以标志性的双线为基准，
采用了未来的设计理念。

这辆车以那款车为基础……

将它改造成了一款全新的Genesis赛车！_

sourceName: Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept
en:
This is the racing version of the Genesis X Gran Berlinetta
Vision Gran Turismo Concept.

While the car is still a Berlinetta at heart...

New aerodynamic parts, such as a striking wing and a flat
underbody, provide much additional downforce.!
zh:
这是Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept
的赛车版本。

保留Berlinetta的核心设计理念的同时……

在空气动力学方面进行了升级，包括造型激进的大尺寸
尾翼和平滑的底板，额外提升了车辆的下压力。

en:
This Spyder is another variation of the Porsche
Vision Gran Turismo.

An open-top body, which are designated "Spyder" by the company,
have defined many a historic Porsche over the years.

The most famous of them were legendary race cars of the past,
like the Porsche 550 and 718 RS60 Spyders.

What distinguishes the Porsche Vision Gran Turismo Spyder
is its bold chop-top roof design.

With a seamless cowling covering the passenger seat,
you’d think it was a genuine, single-seat race car.

Like the coupe model, it is fitted with dual electric
motors in the front and back...

...that combine to produce an amazing <1114ps>
and <111kgm> of torque.
zh:
这款“Spyder”是保时捷Vision Gran Turismo的
一个衍生车型。

许多历史悠久的保时捷作品都拥有
这一开放式车身风格和“Spyder”标签。

尤其在保时捷550和718 RS60 Spyder等传奇赛车上
得到了最佳体现。

保时捷Vision Gran Turismo Spyder的与众不同之处在于
其大胆的切顶式车顶设计。

通过覆盖在乘客座位上的无缝罩子，
使它看起来就像是一辆真正的单座赛车。

与双门版一样，它在前后都安装有双电机……

带来<1114ps>的最大输出功率和<111kgm>的扭矩。{

en:
This Gran Turismo original Gr.3 racecar was based on
the Suzuki VGT.

To comply with Gr.3 specifications, it adopted
a simple FR layout.

Powering the vehicle was a twin-turbocharged V-8.

This powerplant was actually two Hayabusa engines from
the company’s flagship sports bike stuck together.

It redlined at a very high <10000rpm>
and churned out <586ps> of power.

Thanks to enlarged front and rear spoilers and added air ducts,
the body generated gobs of downforce.

Also, the use of carbon-fiber throughout the body
kept the entire vehicle extremely lightweight.

Sporting the colors of Suzuki’s motorcycle race team,
this particular Suzuki car is sure to turn heads on the track.
zh:
这辆原版Gr.3级别赛车
是基于Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo改装而来。

根据Gr.3的规格要求，它采用了普通的
前置后驱传动系统，

搭载一台狂野的双涡轮增压V8引擎。

事实上，这款引擎是由两台Suzuki旗舰级运动摩托车
Hayabusa的引擎组合而成。

它能达到<10000rpm>的转速，输出<586ps>马力。

除了全面提升的下压力、加大尺寸的前后扰流板
和新增的导气口……

这台猛兽还在全车身应用了轻量化碳纤维材料，
大幅减轻了自重。

此外，它还装备了Suzuki摩托车车队的官方配色，
在赛道上一定能夺人目光。

en:
Volkswagen introduced the first production version of its ID.
series of battery electric cars in 2020.

This ID.R played a symbolic role in the launching
of the new brand.

An all-electric racer, it was fitted with two electric motors
in the front and back that produced <680ps>.

And, an AWD system efficiently transferred the power
down to the ground.

A competitor in global time trial events since 2018,
the ID.R set several world records during its heyday.

It was the first car tobreak the so-called "eight-minute
barrier" at the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb.

Pikes Peak is the world’s premier hill climbing event,
held annually in Colorado, USA.

At the Nürburgring Norschleife in Germany, it beat the
previous recor set by an electric car by 60 seconds.

And, it was the first car to fish under 40 sends a the
legendary Goodwood Festival of Speed in England!
zh:
大众的ID.系列纯电动车在2020年推出了
它的第一个量产车型。

这款ID.R在新品牌投放和推广时起到了标志性的作用。

作为一辆全电动赛车，它的前部和后部各安装了两个电机，
能够输出<680ps>的功率。

由四轮驱动系统有效地将庞大的动力通过车轮传送到路面上。

自2018年以来，ID.R就开始参加全球范围内的计时赛事，
并已经创造了多项世界纪录。

它是第一辆在派克.国际爬坡赛上打破“八分钟大关”的汽车。

该比赛是世界上首屈一指的爬坡赛事，每年在
美国科罗拉多州举行。

在德国的纽博格林北侧赛道，它以缩短整整1分钟的成绩
打破了之前由电A汽车创造的记录。

同时，它也是第一辆在传奇的古德X德赛车节R`
以
于40秒的成绩完赛的汽车！

en:
This is the latest entry in Nissan's world-famous
Z-car range.

There have been seven generations of Z-cars over the years.

The first ones went on sale in 1969, meaning the range has
over half a century of history.

They're now some of the world's best-known sports cars!

The latest model includes many features from the first
generation, such as the long nose and the short deck.

What's more, it retains the classic Z-car FR layout.

The engine is Nissan's very latest turbo unit—the 3L V6 twin
turbo VR30DTT.

It's also benefitted from some specialist tuning, improving
its power and also its throttle response..
zh:
这是日产的Z系列中最新的车型。

自问世以来，Z系列已经有了七代车型。

初代Z型车于1969年上市，意味着
这个系列的历史已经跨越了半个多世纪。

它们现在已经成为了世界上最出名的车型之一！

这款最新车型采用了许多来自初代的特点，例如长车头和短车尾。

此外，它还沿用了经典的Z型车前置后驱布局。

这辆车搭载了日产最新的涡轮增压引擎——
3升的V6双涡轮增压引擎VR30DTT。

在经过专家调校之后，它的动力和油门反应时间都得到了改善。

en:
This is the second-generation BRZ, which debuted in 2021.

Much like the first-generation model, it is a well-sized,
lightweight car with a rear-wheel drive layout.

That said, it is a great leap forward in terms of
speed and handling.

Trust me, you’ll especially love how responsive
it is on corners!

Also, the increased body rigidity and aluminium roof help to
reduce weight and lower the car’s centre of gravity.

But that’s not all! In addition to the chassis, consider
the improvements to its engine.

There, an enlarged 2.4L displacement has contributed
to greater power and torque.

And tweaks to the inertia and friction of its moving parts
have made for better driving in the high RPM range.
zh:
这是在2021年亮相的第二代BRZ。

与第一代类似，它同样是一款尺寸适中的后轮驱动轻量
化跑车。

另一方面，它在速度和操控上实现了巨大的飞跃。

相信我，你绝对会爱上它在弯道中的优异响应！

此外，车身刚度的增加和铝制车顶都有助于减轻车重，
以及降低汽车的重心。

但这还不是新款车型全部优化！
除了底盘之外，引擎的改进也可圈可点。

引擎在扩容到2.4升后带来了更大的功率和更强的扭矩。

对活塞部件的惯性和摩擦力的调校，有效改善了高转速
时的驾驶表现。

en:
Are you familiar with the term "fourgonnette?"
It’s a French word that means a light van.

The Renault Kangoo was a best-selling fourgonnette
since its debut in 1997.

But the Kangoo is no ordinary van—it’s a very popular MPV
suited for camping and long-distance trips.

Access to the rear compartment was simplified by sliding doors
and folding seats that resulted in excellent cargo space.

This clever touch was often praised by fans as a
prime example of "ludospace."

A compact vehicle with a lot of versatility, the Kangoo embodied
the ingenuity that long defined French automotive design.
zh:
你知道“fourgonnette”这个词吗？这是法语中
“轻型厢式车”的专业术语。

自1997年问世以来，Renault Kangoo就一直是这一类
车型中的销量冠军。

但Kangoo不仅仅是一款普通的小型厢式车——它更是一款
备受欢迎的多功能休旅车，非常适合长途旅行和露营使用。

滑动门设计让后部空间的出入变得极为便利，可折叠座椅
则提供了更充裕的载货空间。

这种便利性也让它成为了众人交口称赞的
“休闲空间车”典范。

Kangoo虽然车身小巧，却蕴含丰富功能、充沛空间，
完美诠释了法国汽车设计的精妙之处。

en:
For more than six decades, the Porsche 911 has remained
a timeless icon within the brand's storied lineup.

In 2018, Porsche unveiled the eighth-generation model,
known as the "992."

Built on the new MMB platform, the 992 utilized more aluminum in
its construction, achieving a lighter curb weight.

The pinnacle of the 992 series was the 911 Turbo S,
a model that outshined its siblings in performance.

Powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.7-liter flat-6 that delivered
<650ps>/<81.6kgm> to all four wheels…

...this gasoline-powered engine catapulted the 911 to new heights
in a landscape increasingly dominated by electric vehicles.'
zh:
作为Porsche的标志性车型，911已有超过60年的历史。

2018年，它以“992”的代号迈入第八代。

992虽然采用全新的“MMB”开发平台，
但通过大量应用铝合金材料实现了轻量化。

作为992系列的旗舰性能车型，911 Turbo S自然实力非凡。

搭载3.7升水平对置六缸双涡轮增压引擎，可向四个车轮
输出<650ps>/<81.6kgm>的动力……

几乎可以说，它在电气化时代来临前将911系列
推向了新的高峰。

en:
The Urus was the first SUV to be designed by
world-famous maker of super cars, Lamborghini.

Taking design elements from such legends as the Countach
and the LM002...

...the Urus has reworked them into a functional 4-door
5-seat sport-utility vehicle.

Powered by a twin-turbocharged V-8 up mounted in front,
it’s capable reaching a top speed of more than 300 km/h.

At full throttle, you’ll swear it was a race car!

With its AWD system that excels on the roughest of roads,
the Urus is one super SUV.`
zh:
Urus是由举世闻名的超级跑车制造商Lamborghini
所设计的第一款SUV。

Urus借鉴了Countach和LM002等传奇车型
的设计元素……

并将它们活用在了这款非常实用的四门五座
运动型多用途汽车上。

Urus由一台前置的双涡轮增压V8引擎提供动力，
能轻松飙到<300 km/h>以上。

全速冲刺的时候，你一定会错以为座下是一辆赛车！

Urus的四轮驱动系统让它能够在哪怕最崎岖的道路上
发挥出优秀性能，是名不虚传的超级SUV！

en:
The Audi RS5 Turbo DTM had an incredible showing at
the Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM) in 2019.

A regular participant at DTM events, Audi had been
competing with RS5 variants since 2013.

But this 2019-spec Audi RS5 Turbo DTM was quite different from
its predecessors, notably its chassis and engine.

Built to meet the 2019 DTM’s Class 1 regulations...

...it combined a carbon-composite chassis with
a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 engine.

The driver of car No. 33 was none other than
René Rast of Audi Sport Team Rosberg.

His impressive seven victories over eighteen races
won him the drivers’ title that season.

Finishing at the top of the team rankings as well, this
double-title car is certainly one for the historyboksű
zh:
奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM在2019年的德国房车大师赛
上奉献了令人惊叹的演出。

作为德国房车大师赛赛事的常客，奥迪自2013年后
便一直派出RS5的不同型号参赛。

不过这辆2019款奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM却与其前代车型
的底盘和引擎截然不同。

这辆车按照2019年德国房车大师赛的“级别1”规格设计……

结合了碳复合材料底盘和一部2升4缸涡轮增压引擎。

然后，执掌这辆“33号”赛车的是别人，
正是奥迪运动Rosberg车队的雷内·拉斯特。

他在当年的18场比赛中拿下了惊人的七胜，
并成功加冕年度车手冠军。

与此同时，车队也以排行榜头名之姿结束了赛季，
将这辆双料I军赛车书写在了赛车运动史上。*

en:
This eighth-generation C8 certainly took the world by surprise
as the first Corvette to come with a mid-engine layout.

Since the birth of the Vette in 1953, the famed model
had always taken the form as a FR sports car.

While engineers toyed with the possibility of a mid-engine
Corvette since the 1960s...

...it wasn’t until this C8 that they were able to make
this dream a reality.

Combining a naturally-aspirated 6.2-liter V-8 engine
and an 8-speed dual-clutch transmission...

...the new Vette continues tradition with a fire-breathing
traditional OHV powerplant.
zh:
第八代C8做出了出人意料的选择，
带来科尔维特系列首款采用中置布局的车型。

自1953年首辆科尔维特诞生以来，这一声名斐然的
美国跑车品牌一直保持着前置后驱布局。

虽然工程师们自二十世纪六十年代以来一直不温不火地
尝试打造中置引擎科尔维特……

但这一梦想直到C8问世后才变为现实。

此车装备了一台6.2升自然吸气V8引擎，
搭配8速双离合变速箱……

沿用传统的顶置气门底置凸轮轴，使得C8的声浪和气势
感觉都与原本的科尔维特一般纯粹。

en:
The Porsche 911 GT3 RS is the modern incarnation
of the legendary 911 Carrera RS from 1973.

It was based on the 992 Porsche 911 GT3 from 2021...

...which was another special creation from Porsche’s
motorsports division.

Unique to the GT3 RS, however, is the technology it inherited
from race cars like the 911 RSR and 911 GT3R.

Whether it’s on the road or in your garage, this is one
sports car that simply exudes the racing spirit!
zh:
Porsche 911 GT3 RS是1973年的传奇车型
911 Carrera RS的现代版本。

这款车是基于2021年的992 Porsche 911 GT3所打造……

而后者本就是Porsche赛车运动部门的特殊作品。

不过GT3 RS的独特之处在于采用了从911 RSR和911 GT3R等
赛车处继承的技术。

不论是上路行驶，还是停在你的车库里，
这辆跑车无时无刻不彰显着真正的赛车精神！

en:
Japan’s 'kei cars' are a special class of miniature cars
that pack a lot of power into a rather small package.

Not only does the category include SUVs and sports cars,
but it even boasts 'kei trucks', including the Suzuki Carry.

Although the series dates back more than 60 years, this is
the 2012 model, belonging to the 10th-generation from '99.

Despite measuring <3.4m> in length, this truck can lift,
and its <658cc> engine is torquey even with a full load.

These days, used Carrys are making their way overseas,
a sign that the world is catching on to the kei car’s charm.
zh:
日本的“轻型车”指的是将充沛的动力塞进小车身
的一种微型汽车特殊类型。

这个类别下不仅囊括了SUV和跑车车型，甚至还
包含了“轻型卡车”，正如这辆Suzuki Carry。

这个系列已经拥有超过60年的历史，而这一辆是最新的
2012款，属于1999年推出的第十代车型。

尽管车身长度仅有<3.4m>，但它的运输能力毫不逊色，它的
大扭矩<658cc>引擎在满载情况下依旧性能卓越。

如今，二手Carry已经在海外市场流行开，标志着
全世界都开始领会到日式轻型车的魅力。

en:
Storability, operability, durability—commercial vehicles
certainly have a lot of boxes to tick.

And one that’s been ticking them for near 60 years is
Toyota’s forward control Hiace.

This Hiace is a 5th-generation model from 2004.

'DX' refers to the base grade or regular size developed according
to Japan’s five-number vehicle size regulations.

With room for a maximum of nine passengers, its seats can
be folded for additional storage.

Such efficient interior design has naturally made the Hiace
exceedingly popular as a base car for caravans.
zh:
储存能力、操控性、耐久性——商用车确实需要满足
诸多要求。

而近60年来持续满足这些要求的正是这一台Toyota的
前控式车型Hiace。

这款Hiace是2004年推出的第5代车型。

“DX”指的是车辆基础级别，即根据日本五号车辆尺寸
规定开发的标准尺寸车型。

它最多可容纳9名乘客，座椅可折叠以增加储物空间。

如此高效的内部设计使Hiace自然而然地成为了极受
欢迎的房车改装基础车型。

sourceName: Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo Street Mode
en:
This car is a Vision Gran Turismo model created by
the world renowned Italian design house, Italdesign.

Founded in 1968 in Turin, Italdesign has had a hand in the
development and design of more than 300 production cars.

The Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo takes its cues from
the extreme Parcour concept car from 2013.

Designed to be a versatile, all-purpose GT machine,
it is equally capable on the tarmac and off.

The V-10 engine is mounted amidships, while two
electric motors ower the front wheels.

Perhaps its most impressive feature is its carbon fiber and
aluminum fascia that covers the cockpit and engine unit.

The name "EXENEO" comes from the Latin word "xenium,"
which means "a gift for the guest."

And very fitingly, the cockpit and engine are
wrapped up like a wonderful present!
zh:
这是由举世闻名的意大利设计公司Italdesign
所打造的一辆跑车浪漫旅愿景。

这家公司于1968年在都灵成立，曾参与开发或设计过
超过300款量产车。

这款Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo参考了
2013年的“Parcour”概念赛车的激进设计。

它的设计出发点是成为一辆多功能的GT汽车，
提供同等优秀的公路和越野性能。

它的V10引擎位于车身中部，前轮由两部电机所驱动。

全车最利落的特征就是包裹整个座舱和引擎舱
的碳纤维与铝合金线条。

“EXENEO”这个名字来源于拉丁文的“xenium”，
意思是“送给客人的礼物”。

这辆车的座舱和引擎都被包装成一份华丽的UAg
用这个名字可谓非常贴n！

sourceName: Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo Off-road Mode
en:
This car is a Vision Gran Turismo model created by
the world renowned Italian design house Italdesign.

Since their founding in 1968 in Turin, they've had a hand in
either the development or design of over 300 production cars.

The Italdesign Exeneo Vision Gran Turismo takes cues from
their 2013 extreme 'Parcour' concept car.

It's designed to be a versatile all-round GT car,
equally capable both on and off road.

The V10 engine sits in the midship position,
while the front wheels are riven by 2 electric motors.

The most interesting feature though is the carbon fibre and
aluminium fascia that envelopes the cockpit and engine unit.

The name 'Exeneo' comes from the Latin 'Exenium',
meaning a gift for the guest.

And you can dfinitely see the cockpit and engine are
all wrapped up like a wonderful prent!

The ͥff-rod Mode' spec is outfitted to handle the toughest
terrain, with extra ride heightand ovrszed ires.
zh:
这是由举世闻名的意大利设计公司Italdesign
所打造的一辆跑车浪漫旅愿景。

这家公司于1968年在都灵成立，曾参与开发或设计过
超过300款量产车。

这款Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo参考了
2013年的“Parcour”概念赛车的激进设计。

它的设计出发点是成为一辆多功能的GT汽车，
提供同等优秀的公路和越野性能。

它的V10引擎位于车身中部，前轮由两部电机所驱动。

全车利落的特征就是包裹整个座舱和引擎舱
的碳纤维与铝合金线条。

“EXENEO”这个名字来源于拉丁文的“xenium”，
意思是“送给客人的礼物”。

这辆车的座舱和引擎都被包装成一份华丽的U物，
用这个名字可谓非常贴切！

这款“Off-road Mode”Y型调高了WL身q度，加大了轮胎尺寸，
专为应对最颠簸的地形所设计。

en:
The GR Corolla is indeed an exceptional sports car born
of GAZOO Racing’s motorsport success.

But with the MORIZO Edition, it was brought even closer
to the track, so to speak.

‘Morizo’ is the racing alias of Akio Toyoda, Toyota’s
president at the time of this variant’s debut.

Toyoda now serves as Toyota’s master driver, and plays
an active role in motorsport racing.

From its strong yet lightweight body to its souped-up engine
and transmission—this is one finely-tuned machine!
zh:
GAZOO Racing在赛车运动中的成功经验造就了
GR Corolla这款非凡的跑车。

随着MORIZO版的推出，它的赛道血统变得愈发浓厚。

“Morizo”其实是Toyota前总裁丰田章男在赛车时使用的别名，
该车发布时，他还没有卸任。

以大师级赛车手自居的丰田章男，对Toyota在赛车运动领域的
投入起到了推波助澜的作用。

从坚固而轻质的车身到高度调校的引擎和变速箱，这款车
可谓精雕细琢！>

en:
The Dallara SF23 Super Formula was built for Japan's
top-level formula racing series.

Debuted in 2023 as the successor to the SF19...

It is distinguished by two major features.

The first feature is its new aerodynamic design, which
promotes more wheel-to-wheel racing.

The second feature is its ‘carbon-neutral’ construction.

As a carbon-neutral racer, the SF23 makes use of
sustainable materials for its tyres and body cowl.

For example, its body cowl is made from low-emission
bio-composite materials.

And its Super Formula series tyres are also eco-friendly,
made from recycled materials.

Like before, power is supplied by both Toyota and Honda.
This car runs on a Toyota-made engine.
zh:
这辆达拉拉SF23超级方程式是专为日本最顶级的
方程式系列赛所打造。

它首发于2023年，是SF19的后继车型。

这台车有两个非常鲜明的特点：

首先是它全新的空气动力学设计，旨在鼓励
车手们进行短兵相接的竞速。

第二项特点则是“碳中和”构造。

作为一款“碳中和”赛车，SF23的轮胎和车身板材
采用了可持续材料。

比如，其车身板材使用低排放生物复合材料制造。

而其超级方程式系列专用轮胎也采用了可回收材料。

和前代车型一样，这个型号的动力系统由丰田和本田
联合提供。此版本安装了一台由丰田制造的引擎。

en:
The Dallara SF23 Super Formula was built for Japan's
top-level formula racing series.

Debuted in 2023 as the successor to the SF19...

It is distinguished by two major features.

The first feature is its new aerodynamic design, which
promotes more wheel-to-wheel racing.

The second feature is its ‘carbon-neutral’ construction.

As a carbon-neutral racer, the SF23 makes use of
sustainable materials for its tyres and body cowl.

For example, its body cowl is made from low-emission
bio-composite materials.

And its Super Formula series tyres are also eco-friendly,
made from recycled materials.

Like before, power is supplied by both Toyota and Honda.
This car runs on a Honda-made engine.
zh:
这辆Dallara SF23 Super Formula是专为日本最顶级的
方程式系列赛所打造。

它首发于2023年，是SF19的后继车型。

这台车有两个非常鲜明的特点：

首先是它全新的空气动力学设计，旨在鼓励
车手们进行短兵相接的竞速。

第二项特点则是“碳中和”构造。

作为一款“碳中和”赛车，SF23的轮胎和车身板材
采用了可持续材料。

比如，其车身板材使用低排放生物复合材料制造。

而其超级方程式系列专用轮胎也采用了可回收材料。

和前代车型一样，这个型号的动力系统由Toyota和Honda
联合提供。此版本安装了一台由Honda制造的引擎。

en:
The Toyota Himedic is one of Japan’s most iconic
ambulatory vehicles.

Not only does it transport sick and injured persons
to the hospital...

But it is also fitted with a wealth of medical devices
necessary for saving lives...

Allowing first-responders to perform essential medical
procedures while en route to the ER.

For this reason, it is sometimes referred to as
a ‘high-standard ambulance.’

Toyota’s first Himedic made its debut in 1992, and was
the first ambulance of its kind in Japan.

The name ‘Himedic’ is a catchy portmanteau
of the words ‘high’ and ‘medical.’
zh:
Toyota Himedic是日本最具代表性的救护车之一。

它不仅负责将伤病员送往医院……

车内还配备有大量抢救必备的医疗设备……

让急救人员在前往急诊室的途中就能实施必要的急救操作。

因此，它有时被称为“高标准救护车”。

Toyota的第一辆Himedic于1992年首次发布，也是该类别救护车
首次在日本亮相。

“Himedic”这一名字本身便是以“高”和“医”的英文综合而成。-

en:
An automaker with over 140 years of history behind it,
Peugeot has found particular success in compact cars.

Nowhere is this more evident than in the '2008,' a compact
SUV from 2013. This here is the 2nd-gen update from 2019.

What do you think of its commanding presence? Despite
measuring <4.3m>, this car has the full force of an SUV.

Note the lion-claw headlights and fang DRLs—don't they roar
Peugeot, a maker instantly recognisable by its lion emblem?

This car offers a unique cockpit distinguished by a small
steering wheel and distinctive digital instrument panel.

With its exceedingly graceful, cat-like suspension, it is an
athletic vehicle that is perfectly suited to sports driving.
zh:
标致是一家拥有超过140年历史的汽车制造商，
在紧凑型车领域尤为成功。

最能体现这一点的就是2013年推出的紧凑型SUV“2008”。
这里展示的是2019年的第二代改款。

你觉得它的气势如何？尽管长度不足<4.3m>，但这辆车
却拥有SUV的全部能力。

注意看那狮爪般的大灯和獠牙式日行灯——无不在
咆哮着提醒你，这款车属于那个以狮子为标志的品牌。

这辆车提供独特的驾驶舱，配备小巧的方向盘
和别具一格的数字仪表盘。

凭借极其优雅、如猫科动物般的悬挂系统，它是一辆
完美适配运动驾驶的活力座驾。

en:
Nissan has made a significant mark on the SUV landscape, with
standout models like the Qashqai leading the way in Europe.

Introduced in 2006, the Qashqai quickly became a household name,
and now, it's in its third generation since 2021.

The third-generation Qashqai marked a milestone by bringing
Nissan’s innovative e-Power technology to Europe in 2022.

As a series hybrid, its remarkable fuel efficiency and smooth
driving experience set itself apart from other SUVs.

Visually, its signature Vmotion grille and coupe-like roofline
provided a fine beauty rarely seen in compact crossovers.

The Qashqai remains in the center of Nissan’s global strategy,
with more than four million units built in the UK to date.?
zh:
日产曾为SUV市场贡献过多款热销车型，比如在
欧洲广受欢迎的逍客。

逍客于2006年首次亮相，目前已进入2021年问世
的第三代。

作为将e-Power技术引进到欧洲的车型，第三代逍客
在2022年引入了串联混合动力系统。

凭借出色的燃油经济性和驾驶性能，它在
众多SUV竞争对手中脱颖而出。

在美学设计上，独特的Vmotion进气格栅和轿跑式车顶
展现了紧凑型车独有的美感。

作为日产全球战略的重要角色，逍客迄今
已在英国生产超过400万辆。

en:
An SUV built for both weekdays and weekends, the Toyota RAV4
was a car that defied simple categorization.

This fifth-generation model, introduced in 2018,
broke new ground in design and functionality.

The Adventure grade carried rugged styling and had an efficient
2.0-liter engine paired with a CVT and all-wheel drive.

Of particular note was its Dynamic Torque Vectoring AWD system,
which directed torque to the rear wheels for sharper cornering.

For everyday driving, the system coulddisengage
all-wheel drive to enhance fuel efficiency.

Its Panoramic View Monitor gave drivers a bird’s-eye view around
the vehicle, making parking or navigating rough terrain easier.

Equally at home in the city or in the wild, the Toyota RAV4
pomised to take you anywhere, and do so in style.
zh:
兼顾日常通勤与周末出游的丰田RAV4荣放
是款难以简单定义的运动型多用途汽车。

这台在2018年推出的第五代车型
在设计与功能性方面均不同以往。

作为Adventure版本，它的车身造型十分硬朗，
还搭载了高效的2升引擎、无级变速箱与全轮驱动系统。

它的动态扭矩矢量分配全轮驱动系统尤其值得关注，
可将扭矩分配至后轮以提升过弯性能。

公路性能方面，该车可以切<关闭全轮驱动
来提高燃油效率。

全景模式影像监测系统让驾驶员能从俯视角度
观察车辆周围，在泊车或行驶在崎岖路面上时尤为实用。

丰田RAV4荣放能够轻松应对城市与野外出行，
助你心所欲，自由驰骋！

en:
Have you ever heard of a "crossover SUV?" It combines the
ruggedness of an SUV with the sleekness of a coupe.

Here is a prime example, developed as part of Toyota’s global
strategy to meet the demands of the 21st century.

It was called the C-HR.

Measuring just <4360mm> in length, this compact car featured
a complex body design that exuded both strength and style.

It featured a 1.8-liter hybrid powertrain, delivering an impressive
fuel efficiency of <30.2km/l>, or a turbocharged 1.2-liter engine.

As Toyota envisioned, the C-HR broke records around the globe.

Practical yet sporty, a prototype of this unconventional
crossover took on the legendary Nürburgring 24 Hours race!
zh:
你听说过“跨界SUV”吗？这是一种将SUV的硬朗
与轿跑车的运动感完美融合的车型。

眼前的这款跨界车是Toyota为满足21世纪多样化市场需求而开发的
全球战略车型。

它就是“C-HR”。

作为一款总长仅为<4360mm>的紧凑型汽车，
其富有层次感的车身设计完美诠释了力量与时尚的结合。

搭载1.8升混合动力或1.2升涡轮增压动力总成，
其源自Prius的混合动力系统实现了<30.2km/l>的卓越燃油经济性。

C-HR不负Toyota期望，一经推出，就在全球市场创造了佳绩。

这款独特的跨界车不仅实用性强，还具备运动基因，其原型车
曾征战过纽博格林24小时耐力赛！

sourceName: CR-V  e HEV EX BLACK EDITION  ’21
en:
Everyone appreciates a sport utility vehicle that combines
commanding visibility with dependable off-road capability.

Enter the Honda CR-V, which was introduced in 1995. Featured
here is the fifth-generation model, launched in 2016.

Measuring <4.6m> in length and <1.85m> wide, it shares its
underpinnings with the tenth-generation Civic.

Notably, this was the first CR-V to offer a hybrid powertrain,
delivering impressive fuel efficiency even at highway speeds.

Spacious and comfortable—particularly in the back—it provides
more than 1,100 liters of cargo space with the rear seats folded.

Equipped with advanced driving assists tailored to modern needs,
the fifth-generation CR-V is a car for town and country.
zh:
有谁会不爱一款既能提供良好视野，又拥有可靠
越野性能的运动型多功能车呢？

1995年首次面世的本田CR-V就是一辆这样的车。
这里介绍的是2016年推出的第5代车型。

它沿用了第10代思域的平台，车身长度和宽度
分别为<4.6m>和<1.85m>。

这辆车最值得一提的特点是首次在车系中采用了
混动单元，以及在高速下拥有十分优秀的油耗。

这款车空间大，乘坐舒适，特别是后排。如果把
后排座椅放倒，还能够提供超过1100升的货运空间。

为了满足现代驾乘需求，第5代CR-V还配备了先进的
驾驶辅助技术，城市通勤和远程出行都能轻松应对。

en:
Modern Mazdas are known for their elegant designs,
and this CX-30 is no exception.

Take a moment to admire its profile—the way the light dances
across its sculpted lines. Stunning, isn’t it?

But the CX-30 is far more than just a pretty face. Beneath that
sleek exterior lies Mazda’s innovative SKYACTIV-X engine.

Capable of burning a very lean air-fuel mixture at high pressure,
it stands as a next-generation engine—clean and efficient.

The X Smart Edition enhances the SKYACTIV-X base package
with a variety of driver-assist features.

Balancing control and comfort, the CX-30 possesses the heart
of a sports car wrapped in a crossover SUV body.
zh:
现代Mazda以优雅的设计著称，这款CX-30更是集大成者。

细致观察它的侧面轮廓和车身光影，是不是令人
叹为观止？

但CX-30的过人之处不仅在于外表。它搭载的SKYACTIV-X引擎
可谓技术卓越。

这款引擎能在高压环境下燃烧极度稀薄的空燃混合物，
堪称高效环保的“新世代动力”。

而X Smart Edition在这一基础上还增添了多项智能
驾驶辅助功能。

在操控性与舒适性之间达到完美平衡，CX-30
为驾驶者带来超乎想象的愉悦体验。

en:
This Gr.4 race car is based on the MAZDA3.

It was built to compete in the Super Taikyu series, one
of Japan’s most popular events for production touring cars.

Small but stylish, its swan-neck rear spoiler is among
its many design highlights.

The NR-A is a sports car with a very special place
in Mazda’s Roadster series.

It was developed to be driven on both city streets
and the racing track.

The standard model was equipped with an enhanced drivetrain,
large brake rotors...

And an upgraded suspension system.

It even included a NR-A-branded roll cage and bucket seats,
items required for competition racing.

A Roadster with a long and storied history, the NR-A debuted
in 2002, during the era of the second-gen NB Roadster.

That same year, Mazda launched a one-make party race series
for numbered NR-A grade Roadsters.

The Roadster Party Race continues to be one of Japan’s
most popular race events.
zh:
在Mazda的Roaster系列中，NR-A拥有特殊的地位。

它的设计既考虑了城市街道使用，
也考虑到了赛道比赛。

标准版本就配置了改进后的传动系统、大型碟刹……

以及经过升级的悬挂系统。

甚至还加入了带有NR-A标志的防滚架和桶型座椅
——两者都是正式比赛必备的装备。

NR-A作为一款历史悠久、经历丰富的车型，首发于2002年，
当时在售的MX-5还是第二代型号NB。

同年，Mazda还专门举办了单一车种派对系列赛，
仅限有编号的NR-A Roadster参加。

这一赛事从此延续了下来，并成为了日本最有人气的赛事之一。

en:
If you like sports cars at all, you can’t help but get
excited at the unveiling on a new Honda Type R.

I actually got to test-drive the predecessor to this model—
the FK8 Civic Type R.

The track was a high-speed winding road, with sharp
corners that seemed to distort my field of vision.

But in spite of the strong vertical and lateral Gs, I was
able to brake hard into each corner with ease.

I remember thinking to myself, ‘Wow! The Honda Civic Type R
is really next-level stuff!’

But just when I thought the Civic Type R had hit its peak...

Out came this FL5, which far surpassed the FK8, both
technically and in terms of driving experience.
zh:
如果你喜欢跑车，肯定会情不自禁地为
新款Civic Type R的亮相而振奋。

我实际试驾过这款车型的前身——FK8 Civic Type R。

测试赛道是一条蜿蜒的高速路，有不少
视野十分受限的急弯道。

尽管垂直和横向的G力都很大，我还是能够完成大力刹车，
顺畅地转过每个弯道。

我记得自己当时在想：“哇！
这款Honda Civic Type R的性能真是一流！”

结果就在我以为Civic Type R已经站在巅峰时……
这辆FL5闪亮登场。

无论是在技术规格上还是在驾驶体验上，
它都远远超越了FK8。

en:
Since its debut in 2007, Nissan has consistently introduced
upgrades to the GT-R on an almost annual basis.

When the 15th-anniversary model was revealed in 2022,
many believed it would mark the end of an era.

Defying these expectations, Nissan continued to refine the
GT-R, leading to the release of the 2024 model.

Featuring a new aerodynamic body, the car benefits from
enhanced cooling and improved downforce.

The electronic suspension has also been further refined.

And the T-spec model incorporates carbon-ceramic brakes
and a specially calibrated suspension.

These advancements elevate the GT-R to new heights in the
evolution of the touring car.
zh:
自2007年首次推出GT-R以来，Nissan几乎每年都会推出
升级版本。

当15周年纪念版在2022年推出时，人们普遍认为这将
是系列的最后一款。

然而，似乎是为了打破这种预期，Nissan继续对这款车
进行改进，随后推出了这款2024年车型。

其全新的空气动力学设计提供了更好的冷却效果和
更强的下压力。

电子悬挂系统也得到了优化。

这款T-spec车型应用了碳陶瓷碟刹和特别调校的悬挂系统……

将GT-R在高性能房车领域的进化推向了新的高度。

en:
This is the Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo.

It's a single-seat concept car with a futuristic design—
Ferrari's first foray into the virtual motorsports world.

This model is inspired by sports prototypes from the
1960s and 1970s...

...and it shares some of its DNA with legendary race cars,
such as the Ferrari 330 P3 and the 512S.

This is a car that builds on Ferrari's racing pedigree to
make its mark in the endurance races of the future.

The Ferrari VGT's body construction...

It stands to reason, therefore, that its aerodynamic
properties are cutting-edge.

Its powertrain is a turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 hybrid, just like
the one used in Ferrar's LMH.

Because the FIA's regulations don't actually apply to the
VGTit is in fact re poerful than the LMH!
zh:
这辆车叫做法拉利Vision Gran Turismo。

它是一辆采用未来主义设计的单座概念赛车
——是法拉利对虚拟赛车领域的首次尝试。

它的灵感来自于二十世纪六十年代和七十年代的原型跑车……

并融入与法拉利330 P3和512S等传奇赛车相同的DNA。

这是一辆传承法拉利赛车血统，并渴望在未来的耐力赛中
留下印记的车。法拉利VGT的车身结构……

从国际汽联的勒芒超级跑车规则&汲取灵感，

无怪乎能将空气动力学的效应实现至巅峰水平。

它的动力系统来自一台3升涡轮增压V6混合动力引擎，
和法拉利LMH上使用的引擎完全相同。

由于国际汽联的规则并不适用于VT，
因此，它事实上比LMH还要动力强劲！

en:
The AMG GT3 is a popular race car that has competed
in GT3 races all over the world.

This is an update to the original model that made its debut
in 2019.

In addition to being more aerodynamic, it has undergone
a complete chassis overhaul to improve handling.

More durable than ever, and featuring a new parts-management
system, the AMG GT3 has been optimized for private teams.

And, with its enlarged grille, you’ll be able to
distinguish it immediately from its predecessor.
zh:
AMG GT3是一辆人气极高的赛车，参与了
全世界范围内的多项GT3赛事。

这是一辆2019年推出的原始型号的升级版。

除了空气动力学性能更强之外，它的底盘也进行了全面改造，
并提升了轮胎性能。

这款AMG GT3专为私人车队进行了特别优化，
提升了整体强度，并采用了全新的零部件管理系统。

另外它还换用了更大尺寸的前格栅，一眼就能分辨出
它和前代车型的区别。

sourceName: Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept
en:
Unveiled at the Gran Turismo World Series 2023 World Finals,
this first-generation Genesis Vision Gran Turismo...

Is distinguished by an iconic two lines’ brand identifier
that links its quad lights and crest grille.

Its cab-back design, which positions the driver
further back from the front...

Is based on proportions common to the entire Genesis
model line-up.

Such factors make it a VGT that emotionally applies Genesis’
Athletic Elegance design philosophy.(
zh:
第一代Genesis Vision Gran Turismo于
Gran Turismo系列赛2023世界总决赛现场公布。

它最亮眼的设计便是以品牌标志性的双“抛物线”线条
元素将四盏条状大灯和盾徽形格栅进行了有机衔接。

此外它还采用了驾驶舱后移设计，
让驾驶员的位置更远离车头……

这款车型也同样延续了Genesis整个产品线
普遍采用的车身比例。

这些因素让这款VGT车型以充沛的感情
体现了Genesis的“运动优雅”设计理念。

en:
This Vision Gran Turismo is inspired by Bulgari’s
"Aluminum" wristwatch from 1998.

In terms of form, materials and coloring, it perfectly
represents the design and spirit of its namesake.

The "barchetta" body is an archetype of sportiness...

...showcasing the creativity and character of traditional
Italian car design.

It pays homage to the many concept cars of the 1960s and
1970s, the golden age of Italian carrozzerie.

And a pure expression of Bulgari’s timeless design DNA.
zh:
这款Vision Gran Turismo的灵感源自Bulgari
于1998年推出的“Aluminium”腕表。

无论从造型、材质还是色彩上，
它都完美体现了同名产品的设计和精神。

这一“barchetta”车身是典型的跑车造型……

展现了意大利传统汽车设计的创意与个性。

它是对60年代和70年代众多概念车以及意大利
车身制造商的“黄金时代”的致敬……

也是Bulgari永恒经典设计DNA的纯粹体现。

en:
Founded in 1895, Škoda is an established automaker
with almost 130 years of history behind it.

Active in motorsport since its early days, the company
has competed in countless races and rallies.

Škoda’s first Vision Gran Turismo was a single-seater EV
inspired by its racing history.

Design-wise, it pays homage to the 1100 OHC, which
competed at the Le Mans 24 Hours in 1957.

An all-wheel-drive car, its four motors, one for each wheel,
boast a combined output of 800 kW (<1087ps>).

The two liveries that adorn its carbon monocoque chassis
each have a story to tell.

While one uses the 1970s rally-bred 130 RS as its motif...

The other takes inspiration from the Vision 7S, a concept
car unveiled in 2022.
zh:
