创建于1895年的斯柯达是一家拥有超过130年历史的
知名汽车制造商。

这家公司自从创立初期就积极投身赛车运动，参加过
无数场比赛和拉力赛。

斯柯达的首款Vision Gran Turismo就是一辆从他们的赛车历史中
汲取灵感而打造的单座电动车。

从设计上看，这辆车是向在1957年参加了勒芒24小时耐力赛的
经典赛车1100 OHC致敬。

作为一款全驱车，它为每个车轮都配备了一部电机"
总共可以输出800千瓦（<1087ps>）的动力。

官方为它的碳纤维单体车壳车身推出了两款涂装，
每一款都有特别的来历。

其中一款采用了1970年代的拉力赛车130 RS作为
其设计主题。

而另一款的灵感则来源于2022年亮相的
概念车Vision 7S。]

en:
AFEELA is Sony and Honda’s vision
of 'the future of mobility.'

A prototype of the car was unveiled in early 2024 at CES®,
the world’s biggest tech trade show.

Dubbed the 'AFEELA Prototype 2024'...

It employs the latest sensing technology and AI to expand
the possibilities of movement.

This includes features that optimise a natural
driving experience...

And a personal mobility agent that communicates
intelligently with the driver and their passengers.

The media bar on the front works as an external
communication device...

While the large dashboard display enlivens the cabin
with all kinds of entertainment.

The future of mobility, AFEELA marks a revolution in
the act of movement itself.
zh:
艾菲拉是索尼和本田对于“移动性的未来”
这一主题的愿景。

其原型于2024年初在全世界最大的国际消费类电子产品展览会®上惊艳亮相。

这款车被命名为“艾菲拉Prototype 2024”……

采用了最新的传感技术和人工智能，极大拓展了
交通出行的可能性。

这些创新功能中包含了对自然驾驶体验的优化……

以及可以与司机和乘客进行智能交流的个人出行代理。

位于车头处的媒体栏可以起到外部交流设备的作用……

而车内的大型仪表板也能够以各种娱乐方式
活跃客舱内的氛围。

艾菲拉不仅昭示了汽车的未来，也标志着移动出行
方式本身的革新。<

en:
A shift from combustion to electricity-based power units
has not marked the end of the sports car.

No car proves this fact more than the Mission X,
a fully electric concept from Porsche.

You might even say that it is a technology beacon for
the sports car of the future.

It serves as an homage to the great Porsche cars of the past,
while representing a technological breakthrough for the future.

The fastest road-car to conquer the Nürburgring's famous
Nordschleife loop...

...the Mission X is an ambitious automobile that pushes
the limits of possibility.

It follows in the footsteps of the 917 LIVING LEGEND,
Porsche Vision Gran Turismo, and Porsche Vision Gran Turismo Spyder.
zh:
动力系统从内燃机向电气化的转变
并未宣告跑车时代的终结。

Porsche全电动概念车“Mission X”就是最有说服力的证明。

你甚至可以称它为“未来跑车的技术灯塔。”

它既是对Porsche过去伟大车型的致敬，
也是开拓驾驶领域未来的技术突破。

征服著名的纽博格林北环赛道的最快量产车……

Mission X是Porsche雄心勃勃的设计，突破了可能性的极限……

延续了917 LIVING LEGEND、Porsche Vision Gran Turismo
和Porsche Vision Gran Turismo Spyder的创新精神。,

en:
F1 machines of the early 1990s were technologically simple
yet remarkably elegant.

Gran Turismo’s very own formula machine, the F3500-A
was born from a deep admiration of this bygone era.

Like actual F1 race cars of the time, the chassis
is made from negative molded carbon fiber.

The car's naturally-aspirated 3.5-liter V-12, with pneumatic
valves, is capable of reaching up to 15,000 revs.

It's got a 6-speed semi-automatic gearbox with paddle shifters
and a pushrod suspension, jus like the classic cars of yesteryear.

The body features a distinctive high-nose design, with front wings
from the nose rather than being underslung.

Proving there's no end to the evolution of F1 machines,
the F3500-A serves as a benchmark for whatis possible.
zh:
1990年代初的F1赛车虽然技术上相对简单，却是
极具优雅和艺术感的经典之作。

Gran Turismo中的F3500-A
脱胎于团队对这一时代赛车的深切景仰和致敬。

它模仿了当时的F1赛车，采用负压模成型的碳纤维材料
打造车架。

搭载一台使用气动气门的3.5L自然进气V12引擎，
最高转速可达15000转。

与换档拨片结合的是一款6速半自动变速箱，
悬挂方面采用了当时的经典推杆式悬挂系统。

单体车壳采用高鼻设计，前鼻翼并非下悬挂式，
而是直接与鼻锥相连，向两侧展开。

F3500-A可以视作是这一领域发展的模板，
展现了F1赛车不断进化的可能性。

en:
EVs might not have the most exciting image, but there is
one example that shatters all preconceptions.

I’m talking about the Hyundai IONIQ 5 N.

The "N" at the end of its name refers to Hyundai’s two
testing grounds, Namyang and the Nürburgring.

The IONIQ 5 N is a true embodiment of driving pleasure.

In addition to a total output of 478 kW (<650ps>), it has
fully variable front and rear torque distribution.

When set to rear-bias, this car can drift, and its sound delivers
the excitement of a naturally-aspirated engine.

No doubt, the IONIQ 5 N will change your mind about EVs.
It’s a beast that has raised the bar for electric cars!
zh:
虽然电动汽车通常给人以缺乏激情的印象，
但有一款电动汽车彻底颠覆了这种偏见。

它就是现代艾尼氪5 N。

名称中的“N”代表现代汽车的
两个测试基地——南阳和纽博格林。

艾尼氪5 N完美诠释了驾驶的乐趣。

前后轴均配备电机，其四轮驱动系统的总动力输出达到478千瓦（<650ps>）。

其模拟的排气声浪也能带来媲美自吸发动机的振奋感。

毫无疑问，艾尼氪5 N将颠覆你对电动汽车的陈旧看法——
它是一款为电动汽车设立了新标杆的猛兽！

en:
Surely you’ve heard of Nismo, right? Nissan’s legendary
motorsports division?

In 2004, Nismo released the R34 GT-R Z-tune, the ultimate
complete tuner car to mark its 20th anniversary.

Since the Z-tune was based on the discontinued R34 Skyline GT-R,
it needed to be crafted from chosen pre-owned examples.

But that didn’t make it any less of a Nismo. Take the engine, for
example—a 2.8-liter RB26DETT, purpose-built for Super GT.

There was also the precision spot welding, CFRP parts, re-tuned
suspension and brakes, and newly developed aero parts.

Fewer than 20 were ever built, yet the Z-tune became a defining
milestone in the second generation of the GT-R legacy.
zh:
你一定听说过Nismo吧？就是Nissan那个传奇的
赛车运动部门。

2004年，Nismo推出了R34 GT-R Z-tune，这款终极完全体
车型是为了纪念该部门在汽车创新领域深耕20年的成果。

由于Z-tune是基于已经停产的R34 Skyline GT-R打造的，
只能从精心挑选的二手车中寻找合适的车型作为基础。

但这丝毫不影响它的“Nismo”血统。就拿引擎来说——
这台2.8L RB26DETT与GT500比赛中使用的引擎相同。

更不用提车身采用了点焊工艺、CFRP碳纤维部件、重新
调校的悬挂和制动系统，以及全新的空气动力学套件。

虽然产量不足20台，但Z-tune无疑成为了
GT-R第二代车型中的里程碑式作品。

en:
The spirit of Honda’s first kei-car, the 1967 N360,
lives on in the modern N-ONE.

And nowhere was that more evident than in the second-generation
RS model from 2022.

Wearing the legendary RS badge, this version came with
a turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual gearbox.

A close-ratio gearbox and reinforced clutch gave
the RS a rugged, driver-focused character.

With traits like the aggressive black trim and a purposeful stance,
the N-ONE RS was designed to project speed and intensity.

Compact and lightweight, it was a small car that punched well
above its weight—and surpassed expectations in every corner.\
zh:
Honda首款轻型车N360在1967年展现的卓越工程技术，
如今在出色的N-ONE车型中得以传承。

你眼前看到的是N-ONE第二代RS版本，于2022年推出。

秉承Honda运动车型的传奇命名传统，这款RS
凭借涡轮引擎和6速手动变速器脱颖而出。

搭载密齿比变速箱和重载离合器，这是一台
专为带来纯粹运动驾驶体验而生的座驾。

从内到外，N-ONE RS的设计都在诠释速度与激情，
尤其是那些黑色边饰，更为其增添了几分战斗气息。

小巧轻盈的它，是一台能够超越所有预期的动感小车。

en:
AFEELA is set on redefining mobility itself, and that vision
comes into sharp focus with the groundbreaking AFEELA 1.

Its exterior was minimalist and purposeful, free of unnecessary
elements—even the door handles followed this philosophy.

Looking inside, the AFEELA 1 truly set itself apart. A full-width
large display stretched across the dashboard.

It came paired with an Active Noise Cancelling audio system
that created a refined, immersive environment.

There was also an intelliget personal agent, which could learn
your preferences and habits through natural conversation.

Powering these features was an ECU with 800 TOPS of processing
power, enabling advanced driver assistance technologies.

Offered in both Origin and Signatre trims, the AFEELA 1 changed
everyday driving into something truly extradinary.
zh:
艾菲拉品牌致力于革新“移动出行”概念，
而这一切在艾菲拉1身上体现得淋漓尽致。

你会发现它拥有简约纯净的外观设计，摒弃了一切浮华
装饰，连门把手都做了隐藏式处理。

事实上，艾菲拉1真正的亮点在于其内饰，
配备了横跨整个仪表台的大尺寸显示屏……

搭配主动降噪音响系统，
共同打造出移动空间的终极体验。

该车还配备了智能个人助理来为驾乘人员提z支持，
它能通过对话学习用户的偏好和习惯。

这一设计以及其他先进驾驶辅助功能之所以得以实现，
全靠一颗拥有800万亿次计算次数/秒算力的强大电子控制器单元。

艾菲拉1提供“Origi”和“Signature”两个版本，
这是一台能够化平凡为“非lE”的座驾hp

en:
The Chevrolet Corvette is, without a doubt, an icon
of American sports car design.

And driving the legendary ‘Vette into the future is
this electrically-powered hypercar, the CX Concept.

Look at its Coke-bottle body, or the slope of its roof...
Doesn’t it remind you of the great Corvettes of old?

Naturally, its styling is rooted in aerodynamic principles,
resulting in marvellous performance on road and track.

But the best part is its novel fan-powered downforce system,
which ensures optimal aerodynamic balance across the car.

An all-wheel-drive electrified car, its 2,000 horsepower
are provided by four electric motors.

Big and bold, it’s a car that’s sure to carry the Corvette
spirit into a new era!
zh:
Chevrolet Corvette毫无疑问是
美国跑车设计的经典象征。

而引领传奇的Corvette驶入未来的正是这款
电动终极跑车——CX Concept。

面对那可乐瓶造型的车身，还有车顶的流线倾斜角度……
你是否会回想起那些经典的老Corvette？

它的造型自然地融入了空气动力学设计理念，
无论在公路还是赛道上都能展现卓越性能。

最精彩的是它的创新风扇下压力系统，
确保了整车的最佳空气动力学平衡。

作为全轮驱动的电力跑车，其四台电机提供了
2000马力的澎湃动力。

大气磅礴、大胆创新，这绝对是一款能将Corvette
精神传承到新时代的汽车！

sourceName: Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept
en:
The CX Concept is an electric hypercar that is meant
to carry the legendary Corvette line into the future.

Among its variants is the CX.R Vision Gran Turismo,
a beast that was built to defy the rules of the road.

Developed specifically for track use, it's lighter and more
aerodynamic than its sibling.

Powering its heart are three motors and a twin-turbo V8
that runs on e-fuel, perfect for range and endurance racing.

The car’s interior has been primed for competition, with
minute considerations made for cornering and steering.

Seen from the outside, its yellow and black coat harken
back to its GT racing pedigree.

The ultimate high-performance model, the CX.R is sure
to mark a new era of racing glory for the legendary ‘Vet
zh:
CX Concept是一款电动终极跑车，承载着
将传奇Corvette产品线延续到未来的使命。

CX.R Vision Gran Turismo是其变体车型中的一员，
这是一款为打破道路常规而生的猛兽。

专为赛道驾驶而开发，相比同门车型更轻盈、
空气动力学优势更明显。

其动力核心由三台电机和一台双涡轮V8引擎组成，
采用电子燃料，非常适合长距离和耐力赛事。

车辆内饰完全按竞赛标准打造，
过弯和转向操控都经过精心考量。

从外观来看，黄黑相间的涂装彰显了
其GT赛车的纯正血统。

作为终极高性能车型，CX.R必将
为传奇的Corvette开启赛车荣耀的崭新篇章。

en:
The letter 'N' is a special marking for Hyundai cars,
designating the company’s know-how and passion.

The ELANTRA N is one such car—the ultimate high-performance
FF sports sedan.

Encased in its sleek body is a 2L turbo boasting <280ps>
of power, and capable of going 0-<100km/h> in 5.3 seconds.

The car is offered in 6-speed MT and 8-speed DCT, the latter
of which is equipped with an N Grin Shift overboost feature.

The suspension uses electronically controlled dampers
and an eLSD that allows for next-level high-speed cornering.

But the cherry on top is an N Sound Equaliser that lets
the driver enjoy their ideal exhaust sound while driving.

A sporty yet practical 4-door sedan, the ELANTRA N makes
everyday life exciting!
zh:
字母“N”是Hyundai为旗下汽车打造的特殊标识，
象征着品牌的技术实力与激情。

ELANTRA N也是如此——这是一台终极高性能前驱运动轿车。

流畅的车身内搭载了一台2升涡轮增压引擎，
输出功率达<280ps>，0-<100km/h>加速仅需5.3秒。

该车提供6速手动与8速双离合变速箱两项选择，
后者更支持N Grin Shift超增压功能。

悬挂采用电子控制减震器与eLSD电子限滑差速器配合，
能实现前所未有的高速过弯。

而点睛之笔在于N Sound Equalizer，让驾驶者
能按个人喜好定制排气声浪。

这台兼具运动性与实用性的四门轿车ELANTRA N
让日常生活也充满激情！

sourceName: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo
en:
After more than 160 years of success, Opel remains
an ambitious trailblazer of the automotive industry.

Carrying the spirit of the classic Corsa into the
future is the Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo.

The GSE label stands as Opel’s pledge to create high-performance,
emission-free cars for a new electric era.

This is an exceptionally fast machine, powered by dual motors at
the front and rear that together produce an astonishing <800ps>.

It can sprint from 0-<100km/h> in just two secods and reach a top
speed of <320km/h>, truly living up to the Opel “blitz” emblem.

Its imposing exterior was defined by the Opel Compass, formed
by the front grille and the central crease of the hood.

With its emphasis on sustainability, the GE Vision Gran Turismo
promises to carry sports-car driving boldly into the1st century.<pԳ
zh:
历经160多年辉煌历程，Opel依旧是
汽车行业雄心勃勃的开拓者。

承载经典Corsa迈向未来的正是这款
Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo。

GSE标识象征着Opel致力于为电动新时代
打造高性能零排放汽车的承诺。

毫无疑问，这是一台极其迅捷的座驾，
前后双电机驱动，综合输出功率高达<800ps>。

0-<100km/h>加速仅需2秒，最高速度达<320km/h>，
堪称Opel“闪电”徽标的化身。

由前格栅与引擎盖中央棱线共同构成的Opel Compass
让车身外观格外醒目。

GSE Vision Gran Turismo的车型设计还着重考量
可持续发展理念，立志将运动跑车的驾驶感带入21世纪。

en:
Have you heard of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING? It’s a new brand born
of Mazda’s exceptional achievements in motorsports.

One car that embodied the full extent of Mazda’s racing
expertise was the MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R.

As its name suggested, it was based on the ND Mazda Roadster,
although beneath the surface it was something totally different.

The 2.0-liter engine is a rarity in Japanese soft-tops—featuring
hand-assembled heads and pistons.

In terms of power, it pushed th boundaries of what a
production car could achieve, with <200ps>.

Its chassis was reinforced, the suspension used height-adjustable
Bilstein dampers, and the brakes supplied by Brembo.

Alas, production was limited to just 200 units. A true works-tned
roadster, it was a rare and shining gem.
zh:
你听说过MAZDA SPIRIT RACING吗？
这个全新品牌源自Mazda在赛车领域的非凡成就。

MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R正是一款
凝聚了Mazda所有赛车技术的集大成之作。

顾名思义，它基于ND Mazda Roadster打造，
但其内部构造却焕然一新。

这台2升引擎在日本敞篷跑车中极为罕见，
配备特制气缸盖和活塞，全部由手工组装。

在动力性能方面，它将量产车规格推向极致，
可爆发出<200ps>的强劲动力。

底盘刚性十足，悬挂采用高度可调的Bilstein减震器，
刹车系统则来自Brembo制造。

遗憾的是产量仅限200台！
相信我，这款经过厂队调校的敞篷跑车堪称稀世珍品！

en:
Polestar is a premium EV brand from Sweden with a
unique focus on speed and sustainability.

Its flagship car is the Polestar 5, a grand AWD saloon
measuring <5m> in length.

Its panoramic glass roof doesn't compromise visibility
thanks to a camera-supported virtual rear-view mirror.

Powered by dual motors at the car’s front and back,
the performance model can output 650 kW...

And employs BWI MagneRide dampers that can read the road up
to 1,000 times per second, increasing comfort and speed.

Its 800V battery supports charging rates up to 350 kW, and
its rear motor can be detached to boost efficiency.

Sustainable inside and out, the Polestar 5 may very well be
a guiding light for automotive design in the years to come.
zh:
Polestar是来自瑞典的高端电动品牌，
对于速度与可持续性有独到专注。

其旗舰车型Polestar 5是一款大型四驱轿车，
车长达到<5m>。

全景玻璃车顶丝毫不影响后方视野，
这得益于通过摄像头实现的虚拟后视镜。

前后双电机加持的Performance版可输出650千瓦……

还配备了BWI MagneRide减震器，每秒可扫描路面信息
高达1.000次，从而提升行驶时的舒适感与疾速。

800V高压电池支持最高350千瓦充电功率，
后电机可分离，以提升能效。

由内到外贯彻可持续理念的Polestar 5，
很有希望成为未来汽车设计的指路明灯。

en:
Making its debut in 2022, the mid-engine 296 GTB
was Ferrari’s first V-6 plug-in hybrid.

Praised for its compact dimensions and featherweight
agility, it was a road car built for the track.

The 296 GTB would go on to serve as the foundation for the
296 GT3, successor to the storied 488 GT3.

To meet GT3 regulations, Ferrari replaced the hybrid system
with a pure twin-turbo V-6, producing 591.7 bhp.

Assembly was entrusted to the legendary French outfit Oreca,
which also provided maintenance and after-sales support.

Since its debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona, the 296 GT3
quickly proved itself as a relentless competitor.

By the end of 2024, with 100 victories to its name,
it had become the undisputed star of GT3 racing.
zh:
2022年推出的中置引擎296 GTB是
Ferrari首款V6插电混动跑车。

它以紧凑尺寸与极致轻量化著称，
堪称为赛道而生的公路猛兽。

事实上，296 GTB正是296 GT3的研发基础，
后者接替488 GT3成为新一代战驹。

为使该车符合GT3赛事规范，Ferrari将其混动系统更换为
纯双涡轮V6引擎，输出动力达591.7 BHP。

组装由传奇法国赛车制造商Oreca操刀，
并提供后续维护和售后支持。

自2023年戴通纳24小时赛首秀以来，
296 GT3不断证明其纯正血统，展现出不可撼动的实力。

截至2024年底就已豪取100胜，
当之无愧地成为了GT3赛事的耀眼明星。

en:
Ferrari was an early adopter of hybrid technology, as
evidenced by the LaFerrari and the SF90 Stradale.

The 296 GTB was also a plug-in hybrid, but it was powered
by a V6, which Ferrari first adopted for the Dino.

This 3L twin-turbo V6, when combined with an electric motor,
boasts an output of <830ps>.

Not only does this hybrid technology reduce CO2 emissions,
but it also offers drivers a high output.

The car’s exterior, with its low nose, is another big draw,
making nods to the classical forms of the legendary 250 LM.

Measuring <4565mm> in length, it’s surprisingly compact, and
its light V6 only adds to its advantages on the track.

Without a doubt, this is one car that shows Ferrari’s desire
to make electrification hene secret weapon in motorsport.
zh:
Ferrari是混动技术的先行者，
LaFerrari和SF90 Stradale便是例证。

296 GTB也是一款插电混动车型，不同的是它
搭载了V6引擎——Ferrari最初为Dino采用的配置。

这款3升双涡轮增压V6引擎结合电机，
综合输出功率可达<830ps>。

混动技术不仅有助于降低二氧化碳排放，
更能提供强劲动力输出。

车辆外观的另一大亮点是其低鼻锥设计，
向传奇车型250 LM的经典造型致敬。

车身长度仅<4565mm>，极为紧凑，
轻量化V6引擎在赛道上更有优势。

毫无疑问，这款车彰显了Ferrari
将电气化作为赛车运动新型秘密武器的决心。

en:
If you've heard of Mine’s, then you are a true “Car Guy.”

Mine’s is a Japanese tuning firm renowned for its GT-Rs.

Its most celebrated creation was the BNR34 GT-R N1 base,
a fully loaded, high-performance street car.

Capped at <600ps>, its RB26DETT engine was tuned for
seamless acceleration across the entire rpm range.

Its ability to lap the Tsukuba Circuit in less than a minute was
the ultimate testament to Mine’s engineering prowess.

In 2021, this example underwenta full restoration, driven
by a strong desire to preserve it for future generations.

Only its GT-R badge bore battle scars—a subtle yet striking
detail added by Mine’s president, Michizo Niikura.

Once the subject of a 300,000,000 yen offer, tme would tell
how it might one day be appraised on the global stage.
zh:
若你知晓Mine's大名，那你一定是位真正的“玩车佬”。
Mine's是一家日本专业改装厂，专精于改造GT-R车型。

其最负盛名的作品基于BNR34 GT-R N1 base打造，
是一款性能卓越、配置齐全的高性能街车。

其所搭载的RB26DETT引擎峰值功率被设定在<600ps>，
专为在常规转速区间内提供线性加速而打造。

这台车在筑波赛车场跑进了一分钟大关——
充分印证了Mine's的顶尖工程造诣。

2021年，此车进行了全面修复，
因为人们强烈希望将其完好保存，以传后世。

唯有车头的GT-R徽标留有往日激战的痕迹——
这一匠心细节正是Mine's总裁新仓通藏先生提出的。

这台曾获3亿日jM\的座驾，
其国际舞台的^值，且待时间评说。]

en:
Gran Turismo players may already have been familiar with
the special formula machine known as the F3500-A.

The F3500-B was its variant, although both cars were
born of the same admiration for 1990s F1 racing.

The key difference lay in their power units. Where the F3500-A
employed a V-12, the B model carried a V-8.

Although less powerful, the V-8 delivered an output of <710ps>.
Light and compact, it carried advantages of its own.

Note the newly added front wing, crafted specifically or the
car’s high nose and offered in three unique designs.

Beyond showcasing an evolution of the hanging wing concept,
it was a visual delight.

Setting the benchmark for formula machines, the F3500-B
delivered an experience that only a V-8 coud provide.
zh:
《跑车浪漫旅》的玩家或许早已对
名为F3500-A的特殊方程式赛车耳熟能详。

这款F3500-B是其衍生型号，两款车均
源于对90年代一级方程式赛车的致敬。

二者的主要区别在于动力单元：
F3500-A采用V12引擎，而B型则搭载V8引擎。

V8的动力虽稍逊，但最大输出仍达<710ps>，
紧凑且轻量化的引擎结构更增独特优势。

注意观察新增的前翼，专为匹配该车的高鼻锥设计，
并提供了三种独特款式。

它不仅展现了悬吊式前翼设计的演进，
更带来视觉上的享受。

作为方程式赛车的标杆之作，F3500-B
带来了独属于V8引擎的驾驭体验。

en:
What hasn’t already been said about the Porsche 911,
that historic and legendary sports car par excellence?

This GT3 R was derived from the 911 (992) introduced in 2018.
It may resemble a road car, but it was engineered for racing.

Notably, its displacement was increased to 4.2 liters,
and the engine was tilted forward by 5.5 degrees.

A revised layout extended the wheelbase to <2507mm>, and both
the front and rear axles employed a multilink suspension.

The underfloor design concep was particularly striking, and
the swan-neck mount for the rear wing was a novel touch.

Meanwhile, the interior featured a centered seat, roll cage,
and a 10.3-inch display.

A car with a truly international clientele, the 911 GT3 R
proved its raing prowess at events across the world.
zh:
对于保时捷911这款无与伦比的历史传奇跑车，
人们早已穷尽赞美之辞。

眼前这台GT3 R正是基于2018款911（992）打造。
它虽然形似公路跑车，实则是专为赛道竞速而生。

相比911，它的显著变化在于引擎排量增加到了4.2升，
且引擎姿态向前倾斜了5.5度。

布局经过优化，将轴距延长到了<2507mm>，前后轴
均采用多连杆悬挂系统。

底板的设计理念相当惊艳，尾翼的天鹅颈式支架
也是富有新意的神来之笔。

同时，在座舱内，中央驾驶位、防滚架和10.3英寸显示屏
一应俱全。

作为饱受全球车迷喜爱的车型，911 GT3 R
还在世界各地的赛场上证明了其非凡实力。

en:
Ever heard of the “TCR” racing category? It’s where
2.0-liter FF touring cars battle it out on the track.

Ever since this perennially popular category began, Hyundai
has been actively developing cars to compete in it.

This ELANTRA N TC is the third-generation successor to
the i30 N and Veloster N.

Exploiting the full potential of the ELANTRA N, it becomes
the ultimate lightweight, aerodynamic machine.

Although its power and torque remain within regulation limits,
its advanced chassis settings deliver superior handling.

Already carrying several victories from around the globe, it has
earned a stellar reputation among racing privateers.

Thanks to its unique design, this is one car that truly
stands out on the track!<
zh:
你听说过“TCR”赛事吗？这是专为2升级别前置前驱房车
而设的比赛。

自从这项经久不衰的赛事诞生以来，
Hyundai一直积极打造赛车来参与其中。

眼前这台ELANTRA N TC是i30 N和
Veloster N的第三代继任车型。

它深度释放了ELANTRA N的潜能，化身为一台追求
极致轻量化和空气动力学性能的终极竞速机器。

在动力和扭矩均符合赛事规则限制的前提下，
通过精密的底盘调校，实现了卓越的操控表现。

此车目前已揽获全球多项赛事桂冠，在私人车队中
赢得了极高的声誉。

凭借独到的设计，这无疑是一台能在赛道上
尽显锋芒的实力派跑车！

en:
Perhaps best known as a smartphone maker, Xiaomi arrived
on the EV scene in spring 2024 with its record-setting SU7.

The SU7 Ultra is a high-performance model that ran the
Nürburgring Nordschleife with a time of 7:04:957.

Its body employs innovative Gigacasting technology
that seamlessly integrates the battery and chassis.

Powered by three electric motors (one in front and two at rear),
it delivers a maximum output of <1548ps>!

A host of aerodynamic components and lightweight carbo-fiber
panels help it achieve a maximum downforce of <285kg>.

The suspension combines air springs and adaptive dampers with
torque-vectoring control for greatly enhanced handling.

With automobiles now part of Xiaomi’s expanding ecosystem,
the S7 Ultra is poised to stand as its flagship model.
zh:
以智能手机制造商闻名的小米，在2024年春季凭借
创纪录的SU7强势进军电动车领域。

SU7 Ultra高性能版本以7分04.957秒的成绩
征服纽博格林北环赛道。

车身采用创新的CTB一体化电池技术，
实现电池与底盘的无缝融合。

搭载三电机系统（一前两后），最大功率达<1548ps>！

众多空气动力学组件与轻量化碳纤维板材
共同创造高达<285kg>的极致下压力。

悬挂系统集成空气弹簧与自适应减震器，
配合扭矩矢量分配系统显著提升操控表现。

随着汽车业务加入小米生态，
SU7 Ultra必将担当品牌旗舰重任。

en:
The Chevrolet Camaro is one of the most iconic American cars.
Its first-gen model from 1966 commands near-mythic respect.

This example is a restomod, pairing the spirit of the original
with modern high-performance upgrades.

In terms of presence, this is an intimidating machine. Built low
to the ground, it wears aggressive aero components.

The wide-mouth front bumper enhances cooling, while
chrome trim is blacked out and carbon-clad.

Under the hood sits a supercharged V-8 producing
667ps> of power, making it a formidable hot rod.

Its roll-cage interior houses a sequential gearbox
and Alcantara bucket seats with a refined edge.

With its blend of classic style and cutting-edge tech, this
is a special Camaro built to compete inany era.
zh:
雪佛兰科迈罗是美式汽车中最具代表性的车型之一。
该系列于1966年问世的第一代车型至今被车迷奉为神作。

眼前这台车是基于经典车型的修复改装版，
巧妙融合了原版车型的复古氛围感和现代高性能改装。

外观上，这台车显露出威慑力十足的强大气场。
低趴的车身姿态咄咄逼人，展现精良的空气动力学套件。

宽体前杠有效提升了散热效能，原本的镀铬件
则被黑化处，覆上了碳纤维材质。

引擎盖下，一台机械增压的V8引擎迸发出
<667ps>的磅礴动力，展现出最狂野的改装车气质。

防滚架座舱内，序列式变速箱与欧缔兰麂皮
桶椅相得益彰，透出精致品d。

经典外观与前沿科技的完美交融，
造就了这台足PA在任何时I视雄的非凡科迈罗。

en:
Renault is best known for its compact cars, but its
technical prowess extended even to its SUVs.

This was nowhere more evident than in the Renault Captur,
the perfect marriage of compact style and SUV strength.

Here is the second-generation model from 2019, easily
recognizable by its C-shaped signature lighting.

Available with gasoline, diesel and mild hybrid engines, the
range introduced Renault’s first plug-in hybrid model.

Renault hybrids were built with F1-tested technology, maning
they were fast and offered unparalleled control.

Inside, the Captur featured a floating center console
with a 7-inch display and smartphone connectivity.

Boasting comfort and convenience in a compact package,
the Captur was a small but mighy hero of everyday life.
zh:
对大众而言，Renault的紧凑型车型更为家喻户晓，
但其旗下的SUV车型也体现了高超的技术水平。

最显著的例证便是Renault Captur，紧凑型风格
与SUV运载力的完美结合体。

这里的这台是2019年的第2代车型，
标志性的C型灯光设计很容易分辨。

和Renault的第一款插电式混合动力车型一样，该车型有
汽油版、柴油版和轻度混合动力版的引擎可供选择。

Renault的混合动力车型采用F1比赛中验证过的技术，
因此在高车速下仍能保证无与伦比的可操控性。

在内饰方面，Captur采用了悬浮式中控台，
带有7英寸显示屏和智能手机互联互通功能。

Captur以紧凑的尺寸实现了引RPi的舒适度和便利性，
是Q款小巧而又强悍的日用多y手。

en:
The rapid rise of Chinese automotive design has been evident
across everything from road cars to supercars.

And the Yangwang U9 by BYD stands as a shining example—
an electric supercar that captured the art of speed.

Its bold yet graceful form was penned by Wolfgang Egger,
a renowned automotive designer behind several European icons.

Built on BYD’s e⁴ platform, the U9 featured quad motors
capable of delivering a combined output of <1305ps>.

It also employed the DiSus-X system,integrating hydraulic and
pneumatic controls to enhance stability and precision.

A limited-edition variant, the U9 Xtreme, reached a top speed of
<496.22km/h>, making it one of the fastest EVs in the world.

In 2025, it posted a lap time of 6:59.15
at the Nürburgring Nordschleife.

Representing a pinnacle of Chinar advanced EV thnoloy,
the U9 stands as a rare gem in the automotive world.
zh:
中国汽车设计的显著进步已
遍及从家用车到超级跑车的各个领域。

比亚迪仰望U9便是其中一颗璀璨的明珠——这是一款
真正诠释了何为“速度艺术”的电动超跑。

其造型大胆而优雅，由曾打造多款欧洲传奇车型的
知名设计师沃尔夫冈·艾格设计。

U9基于比亚迪“易四方”平台打造，搭载4电机，
综合输出功率高达<1305ps>。

其云辇-X系统融合了液压与气动技术，
精准控速度与姿态。

限量款的U9 Xtreme的最高时速更可达到<496.22km/h>，
使其问鼎全球最快电动车。

2025年，它在传奇的纽博格林北侧赛道
创下了6:59:157的圈速纪录。

作为中国先进电动汽车i术的巅峰代表，
U9无疑是汽车界罕见的瑰宝。

en:
Le Mans Daytona h (LMDh) regulations were introduced in 2023
to reduce racing costs for sports car prototypes.

BMW responded by introducing the M Hybrid V8, a successor
to the V12 LMR that won Le Mans in 1999.

It has the wide kidney-shaped grilles of a BMW road car, but
the laser-lit headlight outlines feel pretty futuristic.

BMW chose a chassis built by Dallara, with a 4-litre V8 twin
turbo engine, based on one used in the DTM.

The M Hybrid V8 debuted at the IMSA Championship in 2023,
and the World Endurance Championships the following year.

In 2025 it secured a 1-2 finish at the eighth IMSA race and
second place at Imola, in the World Endurance Championships.

It has also served as the base for BMW art cars, but there's
a lt or to come from it on the track!
zh:
勒芒-戴通纳混合动力（LMDh）规则于2023年引入，
旨在降低原型跑车的赛事成本。

根据该规则，BMW推出了M Hybrid V8，期望它
能成为1999年勒芒冠军车型V12 LMR的继任者。

宽大的双肾形格栅赋予了它BMW公路车的神韵，
而激光光纤照明技术勾勒的头灯轮廓则充满未来感。

BMW选择了Dallara制造的底盘，并配备了一台
4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，基于DTM赛事所使用的动力单元。

M Hybrid V8于2023年在IMSA锦标赛中首次亮相，
次年便征战世界耐力锦标赛。

2025年，M Hybrid V8在赛季第八场IMSA比赛中包揽冠亚军，
并在世界耐力锦标赛第二站伊莫拉站中夺得第二名。

它还被选为了BMRD车项目的创作载体。
不n，它在赛道上的传奇才刚b~开始Y

en:
Porsche has a long history in endurance racing, and the 963
was designed to meet Le Mans Daytona h regulations.

It carries elements of Porsche’s road car design in its exterior,
with a chassis produced by Multimatic Inc.

Power comes from a  twin-turbo 4.6-liter V-8 hybrid engine,
a unit with roots in the legendary 918 Spyder.

In 2023, Porsche joined forces with Team Penske,
unleashing the 963 in the IMSA Championship and WEC.

In the U.S., it quickly racked up three IMSA victories,
but really began to shine the following season, in 2024.

It captured both the IMSA drivers and manufacturers' championships,
as well as the WEC drivers title.

Porsche even created a special roadworthy version, the RSP.
The 963 is truly a jewel inPorsche’s racing crown.
zh:
Porsche在耐力赛领域拥有悠久的历史，
为符合勒芒-戴通纳混合动力（LMDh）规则，他们打造了963。

其外观融入了Porsche公路车的设计元素，
底盘则由Multimatic Inc.制造。

其动力由4.6升V8双涡轮增压混合动力引擎提供，
与传奇车型918 Spyder有相同的技术根源。

2023年，Porsche与声名显赫的Penske车队强强联手，
将963投入IMSA锦标赛和WEC的赛场。

在美国，它迅速斩获三场IMSA胜利，
但真正大放异彩是在接下来的2024赛季。

该车型不仅包揽了IMSA的车手和车厂双料冠军，
还拿下了WEC的车手总冠军。

Porsche甚至为其打造了一个名为RSP的特殊公路版本！
963无疑是Porsche赛车snS的一颗璀璨明珠。

en:
The Le Mans Daytona h regulations reduced the cost of racing
prototypes, but also introduced restrictions on components...

So Ferrari decided to return to the top class of the WEC
after 50 years with a car designed for Le Mans regulations.

This was the 499P, built in the tradition of the 312 P.
An AWD with a 3-litre V6 twin turbo and a hybrid motor.

The 499P took pole position in its debut race in 2023,
and stunned the world by finishing in third place.

The climax of its season was the 4th race, however, where Ferrari
won at Le Mans for the first time since the 250 LM in 1965.

This race also marked Le Mans 100th anniversary, and the 499P
became the car that won that historic race.
zh:
勒芒-戴通纳混合动力规则降低了
原型跑车的赛事成本，但也对部件施加了诸多限制……

于是，法拉利在阔别50年后决定重返世界耐力锦标赛
顶级组别，其出战的赛车正是针对勒芒规则而专门设计。

这款车便是499P，沿袭312 P基因的全轮驱动车型，
搭载一台3升V6双涡轮增压引擎与一台混动电机。

2023年，499P在首场比赛中便夺得杆位，
并最终荣获第三名，令世界为之震惊。

该赛季的高潮出现在第四场比赛中，
499P帮助法拉利自1965年以250 LM夺冠后首次问鼎勒芒。

这场比赛见证了勒芒赛事成立一百周年，
也见证了499P拿下历史性的一冠。

en:
Peugeot once dominated endurance racing with the 905 and 908,
and the 9X8 marked its first entry in the Hypercar class.

Developed by Peugeot Sport, the all-wheel-drive 9X8 combines
a twin-turbo 2.6-liter V-6 with a front electric motor.

Check out the lion-claw light signatures, a design cue
it shares with Peugeot road cars.

The early 9X8’s wingless design drew plenty of attention,
but a large rear wing was eventually added in 2024.

The tires also were changed to a staggered setup,
helping improve aerodynamics and weight distribution.

It showed its refined speed in the 2025 season, finishing
a close second in the seventh race at Fuji.

With its bold approach, the 9X8 aims to redefine what a hypercar
can be: a powerful beastwith a personality all its own.
zh:
标致曾凭借905和908等车型称霸耐力赛领域。
9X8则是其首款涉足终极跑车组别的车型。

这款车由标致运动开发，搭载一台2.6升V6双涡轮
增压引擎，并配备电动机。

灯组上的狮爪图案值得留意——这也是标致公路车
的标志性特征。

早期的9X8采用无尾翼设计，一度备受瞩目，
但最终在2024年还是加上了大尺寸后尾翼。

此次升级还包括将轮胎改为前窄后宽配置，
大幅优化z空气动力学性能与重量分布。

在2025赛季中，9X8展现了精准调校后的速度，
并在富士站的第七场比赛中以微弱劣势屈居亚军。

9X8大胆的理念旨在重新定义终极跑车的边界——
这头猛兽独个性，实力不容小觑。

en:
Everyone knows about the importance of safety cars, the
vehicles deployed during rolling starts, or after accidents.

Ordinary road cars are generally used, but it goes without
saying that ordinary-level performance isn't enough.

Gran Turismo has therefore produced this special safety car
version of the 992‑generation Porsche 911 Turbo S.

The 992-gen 911 made its debut in 2018, drawing attention
for its adoption of the all-new MMB platform.

This Turbo S appeared two years later, with its 3.8-litre
twin turbo and 4WD setup providing rock-solid performance.

Doing 0-<100km/h> in 2.7 seconds and with a top speed
of <330km/h>, it fulfils its role as safety car with aplomb.

The roof-mounted light is the unsung hero that maintains
orerand safety out on the track.
zh:
大家都知道安全车的重要性。
它们会在滚动发车或发生事故时出动，引领车阵。

通常安全车由普通公路车充任，但普通车的性能
显然有些力不从心。

因此，《跑车浪漫旅》精心打造了这款特别车型，
基于992世代保时捷911 Turbo S的安全车规格版本。

992世代911于2018年首次亮相，
因采用全新的MMB平台而备受瞩目。

这款Turbo S在两年后问世，其3.8升双涡轮增压引擎
与四轮驱动系统提供了极其稳定的性能。

它从0加速到<100km/h>仅需2.7秒，最高速度可达<330km/h>，
能从容胜任安全车的角色。

安装在车顶的指示灯是维持赛道秩序与安全的无冕英雄。

en:
There is a question looming over the modern age: Is the
sports car destined to go the way of the dodo?

The IONIQ 6 N is Hyundai N’s answer to that question,
redefining the sports car for the EV era.

Its sleek streamliner silhouette boasts a Cd of 0.27, blending
aerodynamic efficiency with striking design.

Beneath that shape is <609ps> and 740 Nm of torque.
But there is more here than mere brute force.

When N Grin Boost is activated, the IONIQ 6 N’s
0-<100km/h> sprint drops to just 3.2 seconds.

Its N e-Shift simulates a physical gearbox, backed
by the roar of its N Active Sound+ system.

Crowned 2026 World Performance Car, this machine
proves the electric sports car’s future has arrived.
zh:
我们这个时代面临着一个严峻的问题：
跑车是否会像渡渡鸟一样走向灭绝？

IONIQ 6 N是Hyundai N品牌给出的答案，
它重新定义了电动车时代的跑车本质。

其流线型车身拥有0.27的风阻系数，
将空气动力学效率与惊艳设计融为一体。

外壳之下蕴藏着<609ps>动力和740 Nm的扭矩。
但等等！它的实力远不止蛮力。

启动N Grin Boost后，IONIQ 6 N的
0-<100km/h>加速时间仅需3.2秒。

同时，N e-Shift系统模拟了传统变速箱的换挡感受，
配合N Active Sound+系统的引擎轰鸣，体验更加沉浸。

这款车荣获2026世界性能车称号，
标志着电动跑车的未来已经到来。

en:
The Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé is a classic car
with a real racing pedigree.

It was based on the legendary W194 racing coupé,
which won races all over the world...

Including the 24 Hours of Le Mans
and the Carrera Panamericana.

Its victory at the latter really turned heads
in North America.

When east coast importer Max Hoffman asked the German
manufacturer to produce a road version of the W194...

Mercedes-Benz boldly stepped up to the task.

The 300 SL 'Gullwing' Coupe was the result
of this undertaking.

It's undoubtedly one of the most important models
in the company's history!
zh:
有着真正的赛车血统的Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé
是一辆无可争议的经典跑车。

它是基于传奇赛车W194设计制造的。

W194在全世界赢下了包括勒芒24小时耐力赛在内的无数赛事。

它甚至在卡雷拉泛美拉力赛中取胜，让北美车迷也为之
侧目！

东海岸的进口商马克斯·霍夫曼请求德国制造商生产W194
的量产公路版本。

Mercedes-Benz毫不犹豫就接下了订单！

而“鸥翼车门”300 SL Coupe就是这次豪赌交易的产物。

它无疑是这家公司史上最重要的车款之一！

en:
The F40 was the last Ferrari to have been personally
approved by the company's founder, Enzo Ferrari.

The development codename for the F40 was 'LM',
standing for 'Le Mans'.

This goes to show that it was designed as a road car
with the look of a race car.

There's a widely held impression that the F40 suffers
from turbo lag and a peaky engine.

But I consider it to be a very refined example
of Ferrari engineering.

Many a professional driver has assured that the peakiness
is not an issue if the turbo is properly controlled.

So if you have the driving skill, I'm sure
you’ll be able to handle it./
zh:
F40是最后一辆由公司创始人Enzo Ferrari亲自批准生产的Ferrari。

F40的开发代号是“LM”，勒芒的英文缩写。

它是一辆按照公路车来设计，但具有赛车外观的车。

外界有一种普遍的说法，认为F40的涡轮迟滞明显，引擎
的输出曲线也偏高。

但我个人认为这是一款代表着法拉利车辆工程技术水平
的车型。

多位职业车手证实，只要对涡轮的控制得当，
引擎的转速曲线就不是问题。

所以如果您的驾驶技术不错的话，我相信您一定可以驾驭它。

en:
The 1997 Castrol TOM'S Supra is one of the most famous
race cars in the history of Japanese motorsport.

The All Japan Grand Touring Championship was a very
popular event in Japan from the late 90s to the early 2000s,

Featuring cars like the Nissan Skyline GT-R, the Honda NSX,
and of course, the Toyota Supra.

Nissan's GT-R had always dominated the series title
from the start of the championships...

And the first Japanese car that challenged and overthrew
the GT-R was this 1997 Castrol TOM'S Supra.

The Supra would go on to win the All Japan Grand Touring
Championship four times in total.

But it's this iconic TOM's Supra that I remember most fondly.
zh:
1997嘉实多TOM'S Supra是日本汽车运动史上最著名的赛车之一。

全日本GT锦标赛曾是90年代末期到2000年代初日
本非常热门的汽车赛事。

参赛车型包括了日产Skyline GT-R、本田NSX，
当然也少不了丰田Supra。

日产GT-R在赛事早期是最具有统治力的赛车……

且这辆1997嘉实多TOM'S Supra是最先向它们发起挑战
并夺走其统治地位的日本挑战者。

Supra在日后总计赢得了四次全日本GT锦标赛，

但给我留下最深刻印象的还是这辆标志性的TOM'S Supra。

en:
Do you know about the 1991 Le Mans 24 Hours?

In the final year that rotary engines were allowed to compete,
Mazda defied the odds and won in miraculous fashion.

The winning race car was the 787B, powered by 4-rotor engine,
which outlasted powerhouse rivals like Jaguar and Porsche.

The victory was made even sweeter by the fact that Mazda
became the only Japanese company to win the historic race.

After a bad showing the previous year, no one expected the
787B to do well in 1991, qualiying in 19th position.

However, the Mazda team was undeterred and ran a strategic
and consistent race, taking the checkered flag.

The drivers who accomplished the impossible were Volker Weidler,
Johnny Herbert and Bertrand Gachot.

After the rce, the now-historic No. 55 car was safely stowed
away to be preserved forer.

Then,ʃn 201, the car was restored and returned to Le Mans for a
demo run celebrating the 20h annierary f its ictry.
zh:
您对1991年的勒芒24小时耐力赛了解吗？

那是允许转子引擎赛车参赛的最后一年，
马自达也抓住了机会一举夺魁！

在那场令人震惊的赛事中，这辆编号为55的787B成为了全
场的天皇巨星。

因为马自达此前几年在勒芒屡次出师不利，这场来之不易的
胜利就显得更加的甘美——

1990年，787在比赛中大败而归，而1991年更是因为糟糕的排
位赛表现而只能从19位发车。

但马达车队并未气馁，克服了一切困难，取得了传奇般的
伟大胜利。

这实际上也是勒芒比赛史上第一次由日本赛车夺冠。

获得冠军的55号赛车在赛后被妥善保存。

在2011年它还接受了全面M原，在勒芒故地重游庆祝获胜
20周年的辉煌时刻！]

en:
This is a 1970 model, first-generation Dodge Challenger.

And it happens to be an R/T series, powered by a 426 Hemi
engine, which features hemispherical combustion chambers.

The 1970 models debuted in 1969, and customers had a choice
between the basic straight-six model and this R/T.

The basic model was classified as a "pony car," while the R/T
was considered a true muscle car.

Relatively few Dodge Challenger R/Ts were produced,
so today they are worth quite a lot.

In fact, I'd go so far as to say that this Hemi R/T is a true
collector's item.
zh:
这是第一代的Dodge Challenger，推出于1970年，

而且它恰好是台R/T版本，由一台426 Hemi引擎驱动。
这是一台使用半球形燃烧室的引擎。

1970年车款在1969年亮相，消费者可在两款车型中进行选择：
基础款的直列6缸版本和这款R/T版本。

基础款的定位是一辆“小马车”，而R/T才是真正的肌肉车。

Dodge Challenger R/T的产量相对较少，
因此它们今天的售价也非常高昂。

实事求是地说，这辆配备了Hemi引擎的R/T敞篷车是一辆真
正值得收藏的珍品！

en:
The Ferrari 330 P4 is, without a doubt, one of the
most beautiful race cars in the world.

And one of the rarest also.

The Ferrari P series are sports cars with a mid-mounted
V-12 engine.

First developed in 1963, they have an amazing track record,
with many historic wins over the years.

The development of the P series was stepped up
to challenge Ford at Le Mans...

...and it reached its pinnacle with the P4 in 1967.

At the 1967 Daytona 24-hour race, two 330 P4s and one 412P
pulled off a spectacular 1-2-3 finish.

Even if you include the P3 modified to P4 specifications,
only four 330 P4s were ever produced.
zh:
Ferrari 330 P4无疑是世界上最美、

也是最稀有的赛车之一。

Ferrari P系列是搭载中置V12引擎的跑车，

首次开发于1963年，并在当时的许多比赛中书写了辉煌的
历史。

为了在勒芒24小时耐力赛中与Ford对抗，P系列的开发力量
得到了补强，

并在1967年的“P4”中达到了巅峰。

在1967年的戴通纳24小时耐力赛中，两辆330 P4和一辆412P技
惊四座，包揽了前三。

即使算上改装成P4规格的P3，330 P4总共也只生产了4辆。

en:
The 365 GTB4 remains one of the most memorable Ferraris.

It made its debut in 1968...

...as the successor to iconic 1960s Ferraris
like the 250 GT Lusso and the 275 GTB.

It is a front engine/rear-wheel-drive model,
powered by a 4-cam <4390cc> V-12.

Like all Ferraris of the period, the first number indicated
the displacement per cylinder.

The "GT" stood for "Gran Turismo."

The "B" designated it as a "Berlinetta,"
meaning that it was a coupe.

And the "4" represented th 4-cam engine with
double overhead cams on each cylinder bank.

Most people know this car as the
Ferrari Daytona.

A name inspired by the company's historic 1-2-3 finish at
the Daytona 24 Hours in '67, a year prior to its release.

A major acievement indeed!
zh:
365 GTB4是真正的旗舰车型。

它于1968年首次亮相，

是1960年代法拉利指标性车款
250 GT Lusso和275 GTB的后继者。

这款前置引擎、后轮驱动的车型由一台前置的<4390cc>4凸轮V12
引擎驱动。

像那个时期的所有Ferrari一样，名字中的数字表示每个气缸
的排量，

“GT”则代表“gran turismo”。

B代表“Berlinetta”，
表明这是一台双门跑车。

最后的“4”则代表每个气缸组都装有双顶置凸轮的四
凸轮引擎。

此外，法拉利365 GTB4又普遍被称为
“法拉利戴通纳”，

因为在其发布的前一年，Ferrari在1967年戴通纳24小时耐力赛
中取得了独占前三的历史性战绩。

这GvD一项一重大成就。*

en:
When most people think of the Ford GT40, they think of
Carroll Shelby, and they wouldn't be wrong.

But it's worth mentioning that Shelby wasn't actually
involved with the first GT40 Mark I, debuted in 1964.

The Mark I was a car with a fantastic concept.

I think the way it retains the look of a classic GT car
makes it especially beautiful.

The only thing the Mark I was missing was the reliability
required for endurance racing.

That's why Ford decided to hand a large part of its
racing programme over to Carroll Shelby.

The rest of GT40's glorious story is, of course, history.

But the GT40 Mark I is where it all began, and obviously
it's considered a prized collector's item.
zh:
大多数人听到Ford GT40时，都会想到卡罗尔·谢尔比，
他们这样想没有错。

但值得一提的是，谢尔比本人其实与1964年登场的首款GT40 Mark I
并无关系。

GT40 Mark I是一款有着杰出概念设计的跑车。

因为它保留了传统GT赛车的外形，我认为这一点令其
尤为惊艳。

Mark I唯一缺少的是耐力赛所需的可靠性。

所以Ford才将他们的赛车项目中相当大的一部分事务交给
了卡罗尔·谢尔比掌管。

此后GT40的光辉事迹，史册上早有公论。

但GT40 Mark I才是传奇的开端，而其作为稀有的汽车收藏品，
自然也是实至名归。

en:
The 1965 Shelby GT350 is a variant of the Mustang
that debuted in 1964.

It was a model that was born from the collaboration between
Ford and Carroll Shelby,

and has a fantastic history of successes
in the world of racing.

Ford's then General Manager, Lee Iacocca, is generally
regarded as the man behind the Mustang.

In addition to knowing how to build cars people wanted.
Iacocca understood the value of motorsport,

which is why he entrusted the Mustang's
racing project to Shlby.

The result of this new collaboration was the GT350.

Being made specifically for racing, it's very spartan
compared to the standard Mustang,

its light, 2-seat setup and high-performance 289 engine
ensured success in SCCA and other compettion races.
zh:
1965年的Shelby GT350可以视作是1964年首次亮相的Mustang的
一个变种。

它是Ford和Carroll Shelby合作诞生的车型，

并在赛车界缔造了一段赫赫有名的成功历史。

Ford当时的总经理Lee Iacocca被普遍认为是
催生Mustang的幕后功臣。

Iacocca不仅知道如何制造大众想要的汽车，而且深刻理解赛
车运动的价值，

因此他才把Mustang的赛车项目委托给Shelby。

双方新合作的产物就是这台GT350。

由于是专门为赛车运动制造的，与标准的Mustang相比，车内
装潢非常粗犷，

但双座配置带来的轻量化和高性能的289引擎确保了其在
SCCA和其他比赛中的巨大成功。

en:
The legendary Miura supercar was actually Lamborghini's
first midship design.

This car is chassis 0706—the second of the first five cars
built—and is the oldest Miura in existence

Even for a brand as storied as Lamborghini,
the Miura is especially legendary.

Its chassis—designed by Gian Paolo Dallara—was displayed
without a body, at the 1965 Turin Salon.

Those who saw it thought it was a sure sign that Lamborghini
was going to start racing!

The reaction was enough topersuade company founder
Ferruccio Lamborghini to greenlight its development,

and the first prototype Miura was completed the
following year in 1966.

This chassis number 0706 has miraculously survived the years
without any restoration work,

nd it was entered in the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance
in 2008, where iwon the Gran Tismo rophy.
zh:
传奇的Miura超级跑车是兰博基尼的首款中置引擎车型。

这辆底盘编号0706的Miura是最早打造的五辆原型车中的第二辆，
也是现存年代最久远的一台！

即便对于充满传奇历史的兰博基尼来说，
Miura的故事也堪称传奇。

在1965年的都灵车展上首次亮相的只有底盘——
由詹保罗·达拉拉操刀设计，车身外观并未进行展示。

然而，有幸目睹此车者都将其视作
兰博基尼要进军赛#界的标志！

这样的公众反应足以说服创始人费鲁吉欧·兰博基尼
批准继续研发的计划。

第一辆Miura原型车便在第二年的1966年完成了。

这台0706奇迹般地在没有经过任何复原工作的情况Q保存
到了今天，

它还在2008年亮相圆石滩经典车展g
并赢得了Rj座Grn Turismo奖杯。

en:
Is the McLaren F1 the greatest supercar of them all?
Quite possibly.

McLaren's founder, Bruce McLaren, had always wanted
to enter the road car business...

But died in 1970 before a true production car
could be developed.

The company would not start working on road cars again
until the late 1980s.

This three-seater McLaren F1 was finally born in 1992.

Conceived and engineered by Gordon Murray, the exterior
and interior were designed by Peter Stevens.

Many aspects of this car, including the weight balance
and distribution, are close to perfection.

Needless to say, with only 106 built,
they're not easy to get.

It’s little wonder that the McLaren F1 is one
of the most desirable supercars ever.
zh:
这辆迈凯伦F1是最伟大的超级跑车吗？我觉得算。

实际上，迈凯伦的创始人布鲁斯·迈凯伦一直想要进入公路车市场。

可惜他在真正的量产车开发完成前就于1970年去世了。

直到1980年代后期，公司才开始重新考虑公路车的开发计划。

这款3座的“迈凯伦F1”终于在1992年姗姗来迟。

此车由戈登·穆雷构思和设计，
外观和内饰则交由彼得·史蒂文斯操刀。

这辆车在各x面的性能，包括配重平衡和动力平衡，都
堪称完美。

它的稀有程度自不用说：总共只生产了106辆，要想入手
十分不易。

这样一想，迈凯伦F1成为史上最受追捧的超级跑车之一，就
一点
不稀奇了！]

en:
This McLaren F1 GTR is the overall winner
of the 1995 Le Mans 24 Hour race.

The drivers in the race were Masanori Sekiya, J.J. Lehto,
and Yannick Dalmas,

and Sekiya was the first Japanese driver to win the famed race,

and Lehto was also the first Finn to claim this honor.

Although design engineer Gordon Murray was not
keen on entering it in races,

he agreed to make some aerodynamic alterations,
and the result was a win at its first race,

which happened to be at Le Mans!

 Following the Le Mans victory, McLaren resolved to
continue developing the GTR as a race car,

making this a crucial icon in both the history
of McLaren and in the history of Le Mans.
zh:
这辆McLaren F1 GTR是1995勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军车。

参加比赛的车手是关谷正德、J.J. Lehto和Yannick Dalmas，

关谷还是第一位赢得这项著名比赛的日本车手，

而Lehto也是第一位获得这一荣誉的芬兰人。

尽管设计工程师戈登·穆雷对于让它参加比赛并不感冒，

但还是同意作出一些空气动力学方面的改动。结果就在
处女秀上取得胜利，

更重要的是，那场比赛就是勒芒大赛！

在勒芒胜利之后，McLaren决定继续将GTR作为赛车来开发，

这也使它同时成为了McLaren历史和勒芒历史上的一个重要标志。

en:
A winner at Le Mans, a competitor in Formula 1,
and one of America’s greatest car enthusiasts...

Carroll Shelby has a permanent place in automotive history.

After retiring as a driver, Shelby became a constructor,
with a focus on road cars that could win races.

The Cobra is one of the iconic cars produced by Shelby.

The first production lots were shipped out
in the spring of 1963...

And were initially powered by Ford’s 260 CID engine,
which were soon replaced by the 289 CID unit.

Then the legendary Cobra 427 was introduced in 1964.

Powered by a 7L Ford 427...

It was intended by Shelby to defeat Ferrari in competition.

With their proven competition pedigree
and aggressive looks...

Big block Cobras are sogh ater by car enthusiasts
all over te world.
zh:
卡罗尔·谢尔比不仅在勒芒24小时耐力赛中拿到过冠军，甚至参加
过一级方程式比赛。他是美国最伟大的汽车狂人之一……

在汽车历史上永久地占有一席之地。

在从赛车手的身份退役后，他转而成为一名汽车架构师，
专注于开发能够赢得比赛的公路车。

“Cobra”是谢尔比的代表作之一。

第一批Cobra在1963年春天发售，

最初搭载了福特的260 CID引擎，但很快被289 CID动单元所取代。

传奇的Cobra 427则于1964年推出。

Cobra 427由一台7升福特427引擎驱动，

这是谢尔比亲自选择的引擎，目的是在比赛中将法拉利拉下马。

由于其成熟的赛车血统和咄咄逼人s外观，

大块头的Cobra被世界各地的汽车爱好者所追捧dA

en:
This 250 GTO is one of the last Ferraris to combine
the characteristics of road cars and racing cars.

It's not the rarest Ferrari of them all, and maybe
there are fairer models around.

But if you like good stories, I'm sure you'll become
fond of this car!

Even if you include the 330 GT and the series 2 cars,
only 39 of these 250 GTOs were built in total.

and each one of them has its own unique tale.

This car, chassis number 3729GT, is a right-hand drive
built for the UK.

It was purchased by Jaguar dealer
and race car driver John Coombs,

and it was originally white but painted red in 1966.

Really famous drivers including Graham Hill, Richie Ginther
and Mike Parkes, drove this car in the UK during the 1960s.

I was later owned and raced by the British racing driver
Jack Sears for seval years.

ince 999 it's been owned by former Microsoft President
and chief operating officer, Jhn Shile.<p/
The ric of  pricular car tkes this long stored
history intoȉccount.
zh:
250 GTO是最后一代混合了公路车与赛车特性的法拉利之一。

它可能不是最稀有的法拉利，也不是外观最动人的，

但如果您对车辆背后的精彩故事感兴趣，那您一定会
喜欢上它！

即使算上330 GT和后续2系列的车，250 GTO也总共只生产了
39辆。

而且每一辆车的背后都有着独特的故事。

我们眼前这辆的底盘编号为3729GT，是一辆针对英国市场制
造的右舵版本。

它被捷'经销商和赛车手约翰·库姆斯购入。

原本白色的车身在1966年被涂成红色。

在60年代，包括格拉汉姆·希尔、里奇·金瑟和迈克·帕克斯在内的
多位著名英国车手都曾驾驶过它。

后来有几它归属于英国赛车手杰克·西尔斯，甚至还参加过比赛i
1999年]它入了前微软总裁和首席运营官约翰·雪利的收藏。
