en:
Jaguar played a huge part in the history of the
24 Hours of Le Mans,

winning this famous race five times in the 1950s with the
C-Type and D-Type.

However Jaguar withdrew from competition at Le Mans after 1956,
and didn't show interest in racing again until the 1960s.

But development of a sports car to succeed the D-Type
had been secretly underway.

That successor of the D-Type, is the car you see before you,
the XJ13 with a midship mounted V12.

But unfortunately, this XJ13 never made it to Le Mans.

By the time the car was ready, management's priorities
had changed again.

We can only imagine what might have happened,

had Jaguar been part of the legendary Ford-Ferrari tussle
at the '67 Le Mans.
zh:
捷豹在勒芒24小时耐力赛的历史上曾经极为活跃，

在20世纪50年代凭借C-Type和D-Type五次赢得这一著名赛事。

然而，这家公司于1956年后退出勒芒赛事，直到20世纪60
年代才重新表现出对比赛的兴趣。

不过，D-Type的后继者的设计开发一直在秘密进行。

它便是您眼前看到的这台配备中置V12引擎的XJ13。

不幸的是，这辆XJ13从未如愿踏上勒芒的征途。

当这辆赛车准备完毕的时候，管理层的优先战略目标又
发生了变化。

我们只能幻想，如果捷豹参与了1967年勒芒耐力赛
福特与法拉利那场堪称传奇的战斗，

最后会是什么样的结果。

en:
This is one of the most recognisable cars from the 1990s
German touring car championship known as the DTM.

After entry criteria were loosened in 1993, the DTM became a
platform for developing some very powerful cars.

One of these was the Alfa 155 2.5 V6 TI, the car fielded
by the Alfa Romeo works team.

Winning 12 out of 20 races in 1993...

It secured a championship title for both the
driver Nicola Larini and the manufacturer.

The DTM was later absorbed into an international
competition before being discontinued in 1996.

This meant that Alfa Romeo would go down in history as the
only non-German manufacturer to win the series.

One of the most significant DTM cars, it is more unique
because it’s not German.
zh:
这是1990年代的德国房车大师赛中最为人熟知的几款赛车
之一。

在1993年降低了准入标准后，德国房车大师赛成为了开发测试马力强大
的车款的舞台。

阿尔法罗密欧厂队的155 2.5 V6 TI便是其中之一。

它在1993年的20场德国房车大师赛比赛中取得12胜，

拿到了车手（尼古拉·拉里尼）与制造商双料冠军。

德国房车大师赛后来正式并入一项国际性赛事，并在1996年停办。

这意味着阿尔法罗密欧是在德国房车大师赛历史上唯一获得冠军的非德国制造商。

顶着这样的光环，让这台德国房车大师赛冠军车显得更加出类拔萃。

en:
The 1969 Z28 was the last of the first-generation Camaros
and is considered one of the greatest of them all.

After only three years of production, 700,000 units were sold.

The lineup included 12 different engines,
including inline-6- and V-8-powered variants.

This Z28 represented the top-of-the-line version of
that first-generation model.

It came with a high-revving 5.0-liter V-8,
a 4-speed manual gearbox and power disc brakes.

And the car was distinguished as a Z28 by two wid stripes
that ran the length of its body.

There's an interesting backstory to the Z28's engine, too.

It was actually based on a race engine. The 5.0-liter V-8
was essentially a de-tuned version of the engine...

...originally developed for thePenske Camaro
that competed in the SCCA Trans Am Series.

The Penske Caro was drivenʈy thelegendary American
race driver Mark Donahue.

He won the Trans Am series in oth 198 nd 169.%
zh:
1969 Z28是第一代科迈罗的末期型号，
也被认为是产品线里最出色的车型。

第一代科迈罗仅仅只生产了3年……

它的12种不同引擎配置车型，包括直列6缸
与V8引擎版本，仍销售出了70万辆。

这辆Z28是第一代科迈罗中最典型的代表。

它配备了高转速的5升V8引擎，四速手动变速箱
和效果出众的碟刹……

其经典标志之一便是横穿整个车体的两条宽涂装色带。

哦，它的{擎背后也有一个有趣的小故事。

它实际上是以赛车引擎为基础开发的，
5升引擎的去竞速调校版本。

相当于最初为美国赛车俱乐部泛美系列赛开发，
并搭载到潘斯克科迈罗上参加比赛的款。

著名的美国赛车手马克·多纳休
曾驾驶一台潘
r克科迈罗jL…

在1968年和1969年连续两年赢得泛美系列赛。%

en:
Have you ever considered who had the most influence over
modern racing car technology?

For me, that would be either Colin Chapman or Jim Hall.

Chapman, of course, was the founder of Lotus.
But do you know Jim Hall?

Not only is he the founder of Chaparral Cars...

But he is also a Formula 1 driver and a brilliant
engineer.

The most innovative of all the Chaparral cars was
this 1970 2J, or 'sucker' car.

It featured two fans at the rear of the chassis, which were
part of a suction system that produced downforce.

Other innovations included an adjustable spoiler and a
two-pedal semi-automatic transmission...

All in all, it’s one of the most outlandish and imaginative
race cars ever produced.

The 2J was undoubtedlyChparal's greatest achievement,
and lves on in motorsport legend to thiday.
zh:
您有没有思考过，谁才是对现代赛车技术影响最大的人物？

我会提名Colin Chapman和Jim Hall。

众所周知，Chapman是
Lotus的创始人，但您知道Jim Hall吗？

他是Chaparral Cars的创始人，

也是一位F1车手，还是一位才华横溢的工程师。

Chaparral最具创新意义的作品是这款1970年的2J，也被称作“吸
尘器”。

它的底盘尾部安装了两个风扇，通过吸力来产生下压力。

它的其他创新设计还包括可调节的扰流板和双踏板半自
动变速箱……

总而言之，这是史上最奇特和最有想象力的赛车之一。

2J毫无疑问是Chaparral最伟大的成就，至今也是赛车运动的一
项传奇。

en:
The "Hakosuka" Skyline has become a cult classic for
Japanese car enthusiasts.

Of the various models, this 2-door hardtop GT-R,
known by its model number, KPGC10, stands out.

This car remains on the most-wanted list for many collectors.

Among the car's many charms was its engine.

It was the direct descendent of the high-performance engine
in Japan’s first prototype race car, the Prince R380.

Fewer than 1200 KPGC10s coupes were produced. Including
the 4-door models, the total is still only around 2000 cars.

This car made a name for itself by winning 49 consecutive races
in the Japanese Touring Car Championship.

Owning it means owning a piece of that
incredible history.
zh:
轮廓分明的“Hakosuka” Skyline在全世界都
有着无数拥趸。

其中，这辆双门硬顶GT-R，
因其型号KPGC10而闻名于世……

至今令全世界的收藏家们趋之若鹜。

引擎是它众多的魅力之一……

该引擎是日本首辆赛车原型车，
Prince R380上的高性能赛车引擎的直接继承者。

KPGC10总共只生产了不到1200辆，算上四门版也只有2000辆左右。

这还是一台在日本房车锦标赛中连续取得
49胜的历史传奇赛车。

拥有了它，就如同拥有了那段不可思议的历史。

en:
McLaren's founder, Bruce McLaren, had always wanted to get
into the road car business.

In 1969, his company had plans for road cars which were
essentially slightly modified Can-Am racing cars.

These were the M6GT and M12GT.

However, only a few prototypes were made...

Meaning Bruce’s dream wasn't truly fulfilled
until the 1990s...

With the birth of the Gordon Murray designed
street legal McLaren F1.

The McLaren F1 is still considered by many to be
the world's finest supercar.

This McLaren F1 GTR is the racing version
of the McLaren F1.

The stock F1 was so powerful that, for Le Mans, it had to be
detuned from <636ps> to <600ps> to compete.

Also, because the McLaren F1 engine was built by BMW...

The F1 TRwa raced by BMW's works team.

Eually known for its beautiful FINAʈivery, t sň of
he ever-popular rac cars of BMW Motorspor.
zh:
迈凯伦的创始人布鲁斯·迈凯伦一直想要进军公路车领域。

1969年，他们就计划推出公路车款。本质上则是经过
少许改装的加拿大-美国挑战杯赛车。

它们是M6GT和M12GT。

然而，这个项目只制造了几辆原型车……

直到20世纪90年代，他的梦想才通过戈登·穆雷设计的……

可合法上路的“迈凯伦F1”的诞生而真正实现。

迈凯伦F1至今仍然被许多人认为是世上最好的超级v车。

这辆迈凯伦F1 GTR是迈凯伦F1的赛车版本。

原有的F1性能太过强大，以至于在参加勒芒比赛时，
必须将动力从<636ps>下调到<600ps>，才能参赛。

迈凯伦F1引擎是由宝马制造的……

F GTR也顺理成章地成为了宝马车厂车队的比赛座驾。

z在这里看b的FNA涂装版本不但以美艳而闻名，
更是备受宝马赛车运动最受J迎的
n一。

en:
The Nissan Skyline GT-R has a storied racing history.

It established a tradition that was carried on by the
second-generation GT-R.

The 1999 Pennzoil Nismo GT-R was powered by
the RB26DETT, an inline-6 engine.

It won the All Japan Grand Touring Championship.

It remains one of the most consistent race cars to
ever wage war in the competitive series.

While the R34 GT-R took the title again
in 2003, which was its final year...

...the battle-tested engine under its hood had lready
been swapped in favor of a V-6 powerplant.

This means that this 1999 Pennzoil was the last GT-R
to win the series title with the iconic inline-6.

There's just something special about this inline-6-powered model.
For me, its achievements ae nothing short of legendary.
zh:
日产Skyline GT-R曾拥有过一段传奇般的赛车历史。

它确立了这一传统，且在第二代GT-R上
得以延续。

1999年的Pennzoil Nismo GT-R由一台直列6缸RB26DETT引擎
提供动力，

一举夺得了全日本GT锦标赛冠军。

在这一年中，它表现出了坚如磐石的性能，
证明了自己是天生赢家。

当它在2003年再次夺冠时，
这一代GT-R也步入了末年，

连引擎都已经换成了新的V6引擎。

这意味着这台1999年的Pennzoil是最后一台搭载Nissan标志性
直列6缸引擎赢得系列赛冠军的GT-R。

这款直列6缸车型非常特殊。在我看来，
它的成就本身已是个传奇。

en:
The Ford Mark IV dominated the 1967 Le Mans 24 hour race,

and it was a momentous achievement for Ford,
which had also won the prior year.

The car was powered by the 7L V8 engine that Carroll Shelby
had chosen for the Mark II,

But its chassis was completely different.

This chassis was based on the J-car that was under development
to meet new regulations…

incorporating cutting edge aerodynamic innovations.

As a result, the Mark IV was incredibly quick.

So quick in fct, that it finished a full four laps ahead of
the second-placed Ferrari 330 P4 at Le Mans in 1967.

It's also worth noting that the drivers Dan Gurney and
A.J. Foyt were both American,

making this the first victory for an all-American team
in te history of the 24 hours of Le Mans.

And it's because of these facts at the Ford Ma IV
as a special place in motorsport history. j
zh:
这是福特的一项重大成就——在1967年主宰勒芒24小时耐力
赛的福特Mark IV。

不仅如此，上一年的比赛桂冠也是由Mark IV摘得的。

该车配备了卡罗尔·谢尔比为Mark II挑选的引擎，

但是使用的底盘完全不同。

该底盘来自研发中的J-car，后者的研发旨在满足新发布的
比赛规则……

还整合了当时最先进的空气动力学特性，

使得这台Mark IV的速度快到可怕。

在1967年的{芒耐力赛正赛中，它以足足领先亚军法拉利330 P4
四圈之多的优势完赛！

由于两位参赛车手丹·格尼和A.J. 福伊特都是美国人，

于是这就成了全美籍车手车队在勒芒24小时耐力赛上的
首胜i

这些独一无二的成就帮助Mark IV在赛车运动史上占据Qb特
殊的位
W。

en:
You'd be hard pressed to find a wilder, more bewitching
street-legal car than the Alfa Romeo Giulia TZ.

It's also incredibly rare, with only around
12 ever built.

And what’s truly noteworthy is that this race car...

...has no history of crashes and has never undergone
any restoration work.

You can see why it has become a collector's item.

It should come as no surprise that this TZ2 won the Gran Turismo
Trophy at the 2009 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
zh:
您很难找到哪辆车能像Alfa Romeo Giulia TZ这般狂野、迷人，
同时还能在路上合法行驶。

不仅如此，它也非常的稀有，
总共只制造了12辆左右！

它的存在简直就是一个奇迹……

像这样一辆纯粹的赛车，居然从来没有发生过碰撞，
也从未接受过修复。

这样的无伤历史，想要不出名也难！

锦上添花的是，TZ2还在2009年的圆石滩经典车展获得了
Gran Turismo奖杯。

en:
Despite their early success in the 1950s, Jaguar didn't enter
a works team at Le Mans again for almost 30 years.

In fact, they wouldn't return to the race until 1986,
when they entered the XJR-6.

The XJR-6 was designed by Tony Southgate,
who had made his name in Formula 1,

and it was powered by a naturally aspirated V12 engine.

It was the heyday of turbocharged cars, and the XJR-6's uniquely
high-pitched exhaust note was instantly recognizable.

The sight and sound of a Jaguartearing around the track
once more certainly got the fans excited!

Two years later, Jaguar entered the XJR-9
and finally won at Le Mans,

 for their first new victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans since an
Ecurie Ecose D-Type won in 1957.

It ha been more than thirty years since their last win!

That alone is enougto secure thisʃconiccar's
place in the annals of racing history!
zh:
尽管捷豹在20世纪50年代
就早早地创下辉煌战绩，

但在之后的将近30年时间里，
捷豹都再没有以厂队的身份参加过勒芒耐力赛。

一直等到1986年，他们才带着XJR-6重返赛场。

XJR-6由当时在F1声名遐迩的托尼·索思盖特设计，

配备了自然进气V12引擎。

当时涡轮增压车型的声势日渐浩大，而XJR-6爆裂清脆的排
气声夹在其中，获得了很高的辨识度。

一辆捷豹赛车在赛
上飞驰的景象和巨大的轰鸣声都能让
车迷兴奋不已！

两年后，捷豹带着XJR-9在勒芒重新登上领奖台。

这是自1957年Ecurie Ecose D-Type获胜以来，
他们在勒芒24小时耐力赛中的首次胜利。

距他们上次夺冠已经过去了30多年！

仅仅这一条，就X确保这款J志i汽车被载入赛车运
动的史册里！

en:
This Nissan R92CP is the fastest Group C racing car of them all.

It really is an absolute beast, reaching over <400km/h>
on Fuji Speedway's long straight.

Group C races used to be extremely popular in Japan in their day,

The year after the FIA World Endurance Championship was created,
Japan had already set up its own endurance racing series.

This series was initially dominated by Porsche,

but Nissan and Toyota quickly grew stronger to become
its top contenders.

The R92CP -designed by Nissan's Kazutoshi Mizuno and built
entirely in-house, was developed for the former C1 class,

and its level of maturity as well as its speed
were way ahead of its competition.

Even legendary drivers of Japan such as Kazuyoshi Hoshino ad
Masahiro Hasemi spoke of R92CP's acceleration with dread.
zh:
这辆Nissan R92CP在所有C组别赛车中速度名列榜首！

这辆车绝对是一匹真正的猛兽，曾在富士赛道的长直道
上跑出超过<400km/h>的速度。

C组别的比赛在日本曾经非常流行。

事实上，在FIA创立世界耐力锦标赛的第二年，日本就建
立了自己的耐力系列赛。

这个系列赛最初由Porsche主宰，

但Nissan和Toyota迅速崛起，成为其主要竞争者。

R92CP由水野和敏设计，所有零件均由Nissan自行制造组装，
原本是为了参加曾经的C1组别而开发的。

它的完善度和速度都要远远领先于其竞争对手。

就连日本传奇车手星野一义和长谷见昌弘也对R92CP无可比
拟的加速能力望而生|T

en:
If you're looking for a car that will really give you a
taste of traditional American hot rod culture...

Then the 1932 Ford Model B, or ‘Deuce’, as it is
affectionately called, is a great place to start.

The name ‘Deuce’ comes from its two-door
configuration.

Popular as a base for customisation...

It is a prime example of a custom hot rod.
zh:
如果您正在寻找一辆能够真正体验美国传统改装车文化
的汽车……

那么又被大家昵称为“Deuce”的1932年Ford Model B
或许会是个不错的开始。

“Deuce”这个名称来源于车型的双门配置。

它是广受欢迎的改装车基础车型，

你可以将之当做美国定制改装车的一个典型范例。!

en:
Franco Scaglione was a designer who applied the principles of
aeronautical engineering to car design during his career.

He is perhaps best known for his B.A.T. design concept cars.

B.A.T. stands for "Berlina Aerodinamica Tecnica," and these were
experimental vehicles designed for aerodynamic testing.

This car predates B.A.T. 5, which is usually considered
the first of the B.A.T series.

But the owner Chris Drake and many historians believe
that this car spawned the B.A.T. series...</>
...and should be considered to be B.A.T.1.

First presented at the 1952 Turin Motor Show, it was later
owned by the Packard Motor Car Company.

Lovingly restored over a period of seven years,
Drake's hard work paid off in 2010...

...when, a the famous Pebble Beach Concours
d'Elegance...

...it won the Gran Tismo Trophy!
zh:
弗朗哥·斯凯荣内在他的整个职业生涯中都致力于
把航空工程的理念应用到汽车设计当中。

他最著名的作品当属B.A.T.概念赛车。

B.A.T.是“车辆空气动力学技术”的缩写，
这批实验车也确实被用于空气动力学测试。

尽管编号存疑，但这辆B.A.T.5通常被视作B.A.T.车系中的第一辆……

但车主克里斯·德雷克以及许多历史研究者相信
正是它启发了B.A.T.系列……

所以它才1真正的B.A.T.1。

这台车在1952年的都灵车展首次亮相，
随后归属于帕卡德汽车公司。

经过历时七年的精心修复。德雷克的辛勤工作
终于在2010年得到了回报……

这辆车出席了圆石滩经典展，

并为他赢得了一座超级跑车奖杯。

en:
To me, when Leonardo Fioravanti was at Pininfarina
and designing for Ferrari...

..remains one of the greatest periods in the company's history.

Starting with the Dino 246 and culminating with this 288 GTO,
most cars featured mid-mounted V-8 engines.

Although its styling may appear sleek and feminine, the rear
fenders are an indication of its mighty power.

Only Fioravanti could craft such a beautiful mid-engine car!
Some would say that the GTO is the epitome of his genius.

The 288 GTO’s model name is derived from its twin-turbocharged
2.8-liter V-8 powerplant.

Only 270 were ever made, so they're not that easy to find.
Still, it's a must-have for any serious Ferrari collection.
zh:
我的个人意见是，列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂在Pininfarina
操刀设计的时期是Ferrari历史上最伟大的时期之一。

从Dino 246开始萌芽，直到这款288 GTO臻于巅峰，大多都配
备了一台V8中置引擎。

虽然此车的造型可能看起来比较阴柔纤细，但宽厚的后
挡泥板表明了它所蕴含的强大功率。

也只有菲奥拉万蒂才能设计出如此曼妙的中置引擎汽车！

事实上，还有人说他的天才智慧都浓缩体现在了这台GTO
当中。

此车的名称288 GTO取自其装载的2.8L V8双涡轮增压引擎。

这款车只生产了270辆，所以现在一车难求。但只要您收
藏Ferrari，就绝对不能缺少它！

en:
The Countach had a huge impact on the motor industry, and
plotted the course Lamborghini has followed ever since.

Its development was headed up by the brilliant engineer
Paolo Stanzani...

Who, together with designer Marcello Gandini,
produced this scissor-doored masterpiece.

Although Countachs were produced for over 25 years,
the first generation LP400 remains the most popular.

There's just something different about the way it drives.
The fact only 150 were made adds scarcity value, too.

You can be certain these Countach LP400s are only going to
become more popular in the years to come.
zh:
Countach的出现对汽车工业产生了巨大的影响，并就此确立
Lamborghini之后一直遵循的路线。

它的开发是由天才工程Paolo Stanzani牵头负责的……

他与设计师Marcello Gandini合作无间，
联合设计了这款剪刀式车门的杰作。

尽管Countach的生产持续了25年以上，第一代的LP400
仍然是最受车迷欢迎的。

其驾驶体验颇有独特之处。而且只生产了150辆的事实也
让它身价倍增。

我可以确定地说，在未来的几年里，Countach LP400
只会变得更加抢手。

en:
If I were to ask you to think of Swiss F1 team,
chances are you'd think of Sauber,

which was founded by Peter Sauber, a keen amateur race driver.

Sauber built his first race car in 1970,
and drove it in hill climbs.

Sauber then focused on the management side of things, and the
team experienced early success with the BMW-engined C5.

In many ways, that success was the launchpad which propelled
the team all the way to Formula 1 in 1993.

Prior to its F1 involvement, Sauber's greatet achievement
was the C9, a Group C race car developed with Mercedes.

The C9 made its racing debut in 1987, and soon tasted victory.

In the 1989 season it was virtually unrivaled,

becoming the winner of the World Sports Car Championship
and inning the 24 Hours of Le Mans!
zh:
提到瑞士的F1车队，您自然会想到索伯车队。

车队的创始人Peter Sauber是一位激情四溢的业余赛车手。

他在1970年打造出了他的第一辆赛车，并驾驶它参加爬坡赛。

后来，他将重点转向管理，而他的车队也凭借搭载BMW引
擎的C5取得了早期的成功。

这种成功在方方面面激励着车队，推动他们在1993年登上
F1大赛的舞台。

在参与F1之前，索伯车队最大的成就是C9：一款与Mercedes
合作开发的C组别赛车。

C9于1987年在赛场上首次亮相。不久就尝到了胜利的滋味。

在1989年赛季中，它表现得所向披靡，

连续夺得了世界跑车锦标赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军！~

en:
The Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe may be the most
valuable Shelby Cobra of them all.

Determined to win Le Mans for Ford...

Carroll Shelby asked friend and employee Pete Brock
to design a coupé body for the Cobra.

Spec-wise, it was virtually the same as the 289 Cobra, but
the coupé body boosted its top speed by over <30km/h>.

Taking class victories at Le Mans and Daytona, this Cobra
became the champion of the FIA GT Class in 1965.

With only six Daytona Coupes in existence, including
prototypes, they are almost mythical in their rarity.
zh:
Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe可能是Shelby Cobra中
价值最高的一款车型。

在下决心要为Ford赢得勒芒耐力赛后……

Carroll Shelby便邀请他的朋友兼雇员Pete Brock
为他设计Cobra的的车身。

它的规格配置几乎与289 Cobra完全相同，
但得益于双门车身的引入，最高速度提高了<30km/h>。

这款Cobra在勒芒和戴通纳都赢得了其所属组别的比赛，
最终又赢得了1965年国际GT制造商锦标赛GT组冠军。

包括原型车在内，Daytona Coupe只生产了六辆，如此稀少的产量
也把这台车推上了封神的位置。

en:
This unique Plymouth roadster is best known for having been
designed by Carrozzeria Ghia.

But do you know where the "XNR" name comes from?

If you try to read “XNR” out loud, it sounds just like
"Exner," doesn't it?

It's the name of the legendary American designer
Virgil Max Exner...

...who led Chrysler's design for much of the 1950s and 1960s.

He developed various designs in conjunction with
Luigi Segre of Carrozzeria Ghia.

Many innovative and interesting designs
resulted from this collaboration.

And this XNR Ghia Roadster was one of them.

The XNR also made waves in 2011 when it claimed the Gran Turismo
Trophy at the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
zh:
这款独特的Plymouth敞篷跑车的出名之处在于
它是由Carrozzeria Ghia设计的。

但您知道“XNR”这个名字是怎么来的吗？

您读一下就会发现“XNR”听起来很像“Exner”，对吧？

这款车的名字正是取自美国传奇设计师Virgil Max Exner，

他于上世纪50至60年代主要领导Chrysler的设计。

他与Carrozzeria Ghia的Luigi Segre 合作完成了许多设计，

二人的合作带来了大量创新而有趣的作品。

这辆XNR Ghia Roadster就是其中之一。

这辆XNR还于2011年在圆石滩经典车展夺得了Gran Turismo奖杯，
再次吸引了所有人的目光。

en:
Ferrari's 250 GT series owes much of its renown to this car,
the 250 GT Berlinetta.

The model was announced by Ferrari in 1959, and marked a
decisive shift away from previous 250s.

One of the most notable differences was the <2400mm> wheelbase,
which was <200mm> shorter than its predecessors.

This gave the car better handling, and led to the name
"SWB," which stands for "short wheelbase."

The V12 engine was also more powerful,

and driven by great drivers including Stirling Moss Graham Hill,
and Carroll Shelby,

 the model proved to be an outstanding success.

The total production of the Ferrari 250 Berlinetta was
around 160 cars in total.

Some of these featured an aluminum body for racing, while
others like this onehad steel bodies for street use.
zh:
Ferrari的250 GT系列所拥有的知名度很大程度上来自于这款车，
即250 GT Berlinetta。

这款车由Ferrari在1959年宣布推出，标志着与以前的250车型风
格的彻底转变。

最明显的差异之一是长为2400毫米的轴距，比前代车型缩
短了近200毫米。

这让该车获得了更好的操控性，并获得了“SWB”这个代表
“短轴距”的名号。

它搭载的V12引擎的功率也更加强大。

当时的大部分伟大车手，例如Stirling Moss、Graham Hill，
以及Carroll Shelby都驾驶过它。

这款出类拔萃的车型在当时取得了巨大成功。

250 Berlinetta大约生产了160辆。

其中一些采用赛车的铝制车身，而另一些则采用l_V
型的钢制车身。*

en:
No sports car says 'America' quite like
the Chevrolet Corvette!

This second-generation model, also known as the Sting Ray
was especially popular.

Later versions featuring the L88 racing engine are very
collectable, and regularly sell for over $1 million.

This 1963 coupé is perhaps best known for its split
rear window.

It's a design feature that was only used in the first-year
models because it limited rear visibility.

The one-year 'split window' Sting Rays are hugely popular,
and are among the most collectable Corvettes.
zh:
没有哪款跑车能比Chevrolet Corvette更能体现美国味！

其中，被称为Sting Ray的第二代Corvette车型特别受欢迎。

搭载L88赛车引擎的后期版本非常值得收藏，其售价经常
超过100万美元。

这款1963年的双门硬顶跑车车型最为人称道的是其分体式
后窗。

受限于狭窄的后窗视线，这一设计特征仅仅出现在首发
版车型上，随后就被取消了。

总而言之，搭载了分体式车窗的首发年Sting Ray极其受欢迎，
也是最有收藏价值的Corvette之一。

en:
Let me introduce you to one of the most important cars in
the long history of the Corvette: the Sting Ray Racer.

Corvettes have been raced enthusiastically,
ever since their debut in 1954.

In 1957, Zora Arkus-Duntov, an engineer and keen
racing driver who worked for GM...

Produced the Corvette SS, the first Corvette built
specifically for racing.

This Sting Ray Racer is essentially a Corvette SS
with an open-top body.

It is based on drawings by Peter Brock, a renowned
designer of GM.

The development of the Sting Ray Racer was led by
Bill Mitchell, then the new GM design chief.

The design of the Sting Ray Racer is known for having had
a significant influence on the history of the Corvette.

Later, another GM desiger Lrry Shinoda, refined it
into the 2 Corvette.
zh:
请允许我向您介绍Corvette的悠久历史中最重要的车型之一：
Sting Ray Racer。

自1954年首次亮相以来，Corvette就受到了赛车界的广泛欢迎。

当时为GM工作的工程师兼车手Zora Arkus-Duntov
特别热衷于驾驶它参赛。

1957年，他创造了Corvette SS，
是第一辆专门设计为竞赛用途的Corvette。

这台Stingray Racer本质上是一台采用了敞篷车身的SS。

它的车身设计由GM的著名工程师Peter Brock操刀，

赛道版则是在新任GM设计部主管Bill Mitchell监督下研发而来。

Sting Ray Racer的设计显著地影响了Corvette车系的发展史，

再后来，另一位GM的设计师Larry Shinoda又对这一设计
做出了改进，创ioQ经典的Corvette C2。*

en:
Toyota's 2000GT ranks among the most beautiful GT cars
in history.

It is truly a masterpiece of Japanese car design.

When it debuted in 1967, it sold for a little over
two million yen, or around $6,800.

Today, it would fetch high six figures in dollars.

A minor design modification in 1969 divides the 2000GTs
into early models and late models.

The 2000GT competed in numerous speed trials
where it set records.

It was even raced by Carroll Shelby in 1968.

All in all, it's a fabulous car, and one which you can enjoy
owning for many years.
zh:
作为日本汽车设计的伟大杰作之一，

Toyota 2000GT已跻身世界上最美丽的GT跑车之列。

当它在1967年首次亮相时，售价只略高于200万日元，在当
时约等于6800美元。

如今，它的售价按美元计算已达到六位数的天价。

按照1969年的小改款划分，2000GT可以被分为早期和后期型号。

2000GT参加了许多速度测试，并创下多项项速度记录，

甚至在1968年的比赛中担任Carroll Shelby的座驾。

总之，这辆无与伦比的车在您的收藏中停上多少年都依
然值得回味。

en:
The 4WD Sport quattro S1 revolutionized the automotive
industry in the 1980s.

You only have to look at its achievements in the
World Rally Championship for proof of that!

The Sport quattro S1 was developed
for homologation in Group B rallying.

As a result, only 200 were ever built.

But that's not the whole story to this particular
Sport quattro S1.

This is an S1-E2, a further evolved version of the S1.

It won the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb in 1987,
with Walter Röhrl at the wheel.

This victory would prove to be the last hurrah for the
Sport quattro, as Audi pulled out of Group B rallying in 1986.

Without a doubt, this is one of the greatest among greats.
zh:
Audi 4WD Sport quattro S1在1980年代彻底革新了汽车工业。

它在世界拉力锦标赛上的成绩就已经足以证明这一点。

Sport quattro S1是为满足B组别拉力赛事认证规范而进行开发的
原型车，

因此只生产了200辆。

但关于这一台车的故事到这还没结束！

这辆S1-E2实际上是原版S1的改进版本。

在1987年，Walter Röhrl驾驶这台车赢得了派克峰国际爬坡赛。

这也是Sport quattro最后一次赢得冠军。
因为在1986年，Audi就退出了B组别。

毋庸置疑，这款车是传奇中的传奇。

en:
The 500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe was one of the great
Ferraris of the 1950s.

There are a few different types of the Ferrari Mondial.

This is one of two coupés that were built to race
the 1954 Tour de France!

Unfortunately, it retired out of the race.

But this may have been best, given how well it was
taken care of throughout the years.

The car was bought by a French collector and safely stored
away in a chateau for several decades.

So when John Shirley acquired the car in 2002...

Everything from the engine to the paint finish
was in perfect condition!

After only minor work was he able to enter it in
the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance in 2012.

Unsurprisingly, it went home with the Gran Turismo
Trophy.<
zh:
500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe是50年代最伟大的Ferrari之一。

Ferrari Mondial有几种不同的型号，

而这辆是为1954年的环法汽车赛而制造仅有的两辆之一！

遗憾地是它并未完赛，

但因祸得福，这辆车随后得到了完善的养护并保管多年。

这辆车被一位法国收藏家买下，并安全地存放在一座城
堡里数十年之久。

因此，当John Shirley在2002年获得这辆车时，

它从引擎到油漆都处于完美的状态！

在稍加保养之后，他就带着这辆车参加了2012年的圆石滩
经典车展。

不出意料，它将当年的Gran Turismo奖杯捧回了家！

en:
Amédée Gordini was a legendary tuner of Renault
and Simca cars...

And may be best known for his achievements at Le Mans.

Gordini was a hard-working Frenchman who went on to become
an F1 race car constructor—basically, a genius.

For many years, Gordini partnered with Renault to produce
performance versions of the company's mass-market cars.

This Renault 8 Gordini is one such example and probably the
most popular of the official collaborations.

The fact that it's near twice as powerful as the base model
just goes to show what a genius tuner Gordini really was.

The classic blue-paint-with-whit-stripes, V-shaped bonnet
and boxy styling still has legions of fans to this day!
zh:
Amédée Gordini是Renault和Simca汽车的传奇调校大师，

因其在勒芒比赛中的成就而广为人知。

这位勤奋的法国人甚至还参与了一级方程式赛车的制造，
换句话说，这一位是真正的天才。

多年来，Gordini一直与Renault合作，生产面向大众市场车型的高
性能版本。

这辆官方合作的Renault 8 Gordini就是个不错的范例，而且可能是
最受欢迎的范例！

这台车的性能相比基础车型几乎翻了一番，足以证明Gordini
确实是一位天才的调校大师。

带有白色条纹的经典蓝色漆面、V形引擎盖和方正的造
型使得此车至今仍坐拥大量的粉丝！

en:
The Mazda RX-500 is a supercar that is nothing short
of mythical.

Built in 1970 for the 50th anniversary of Toyo Kogyo, known
today as 'Mazda', it debuted at the Tokyo Motor Show.

This RX-500 was conceived as a successor
to the famed Cosmo Sport of the 1960s.

Unlike the Cosmo Sport however, its rotary engine
was not mounted in front but rear-midship...

And was a high rpm type that could rev up to <14000rpm>.

With <250ps> and weighing only <850kg>,
the RX-500 was an extremely fast car.

Only one RX-500 was ever built as a concept model, and
in 2008 it was restored by Mazda to its original glory.
zh:
Mazda RX500是一款神奇的超级跑车。

它于1970年为了纪念Toyo Kogyo（即现在的Mazda）
创立50周年而制造，并在东京车展上展出。

RX500是60年代广负盛名的Cosmo Sport的继任者。

与Cosmo Sport不同的是，它的转子引擎没有安装在前面，而是
采用了中后置布局。

这款转子引擎专为高转速而调校，最高转速高达<14000rpm>。

高达<250ps>的马力配上仅有<850kg>重的车身，RX500的速度快得惊人。

RX500仅有一台概念车存世。在2008年，经Mazda修缮后，它恢复
了往日的神采。

en:
The 8C name refers to the engine's eight cylinders, and
these cars are the iconic pre-war Alfa Romeos.

The inline-8 was designed by the genius Italian
engineer Vittorio Jano.

The “Berlinetta” body was made by famed coachbuilder
Touring.

There were only five Berlinettas made in total.

This particular one, from 1937, appeared in many motor
shows and catalogues.

It also won "Best of Show" at the Pebble Beach
Concours d'Elegance in 2018.

It then won the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este
the following year...

...before winning the Louis Vuitton Classic Concours Award.

I doubt many other cars have won prizes at three of the
world's biggest concours.

Needless to say, its current value is nothing short of
astronmialű
zh:
8C的名号不仅对应了引擎的8个气缸，也致敬了Alfa Romeo
战前生产的标志性车型。

直列八缸引擎由意大利天才工程师维托里奥·亚诺设计完成，

“Berlinetta”车身则由著名车身制造商Touring打造，

而且，Berlinetta只生产了五辆。

这辆1937年下线的8C在圈内声名远播，曾在许多车展和拍
卖目录中现身。

它还在2018年的圆石滩经典车展中赢得了“最佳巡展”
的名号，

并在第二年的埃斯特别墅车展中再次斩获殊荣。

它还赢得过路易·维登经典车展奖。

我怀疑有多少其他车型能包圆世界三大展会的奖项！

毋庸置疑，它现在的售价已经是个天文数字了。~

en:
The F50 was the successor to the F40, and was one of
the most Spartan cars Ferrari ever produced.

The idea came from Enzo Ferrari's son, Piero,

who wanted to create a road car similar to an F1 race car
for the company's 50th anniversary.

This is reflected in things like the F50's V12 engine being
mounted in the same structure as the Ferrari F1 machine.

The V12 engine in-house is also based on the V12 used in
the Ferrari F1 racers.

So if you're in the mood to drive a Ferrari F1 around town,
the F50 is the car for you!
zh:
F50是F40的继任者，也是法拉利制造过的最“朴素”的汽车之一。

它的设计理念来自于恩佐·法拉利的儿子皮耶罗，

后者希望打造一款接近一级方程式赛车的公路车来庆祝
公司成立50周年。

这一理念反映在了F50的V12引擎上。这台V12引擎是基于法拉利
的一级方程式赛车设计的，

然后安装在同款一级方程式赛车结构打造的车架上。

如果您有兴趣想要开着法拉利的“F1”赛车招摇过市，F50就
是您的不二之选！~

en:
The D-Type is one of the most important cars in the history
of Jaguar motorsport.

It is also one of my favourite driving cars of the 1950s.

While it shares components with the double
Le Mans-winning C-Type...

Its all-aluminium monocoque body was a radical departure
from that model.

Its straight-six engine was also significantly tuned for
both power and reliability.

C-Type designer Malcolm Sayer also worked his magic
on the D-Type...

Fitting a fin to factory team cars to enhance stability
at high speeds.

The D-Type retired on its Le Mans debut in 1954, but
returned in 1955 to win three consecutive races.

Just 68 of this legendary racing car were produced,
with the works cars being the most desirable.
zh:
D-Type是Jaguar汽车运动史上最重磅的车型之一，

也是我最喜欢的50年代车型之一。

尽管它与两次赢得勒芒比赛的冠军赛车C-Type共享部件，

但全铝单体车壳带来了全新的巨变。

其直列六缸引擎也针对功率和耐用性进行了显著调校。

D-Type的外观设计由曾参与过C-Type设计的Malcolm Sayer完成，

并在车厂车队的赛车上专门安装了鲨鱼鳍翼片，以强化
高速行驶时的稳定性表现。

D-Type在1954年首次参加勒芒耐力赛时因故退赛，但在1955年王
者归来，取得了三连冠。

这款传奇之车仅仅生产了68辆，其中又属车厂车队的那
几台最受热捧。 2

en:
The E-type Coupé, which made its debut in 1961, had a huge
influence on sports car design.

The engine in the car's nose was based on the straight-six
that won Le Mans five times in the C- and D-types.

Although known to the world as the 'E-type', in
North America it is often called the 'XK-E'.

The beautiful body, which evolved from the D-Type sports
racer, was designed by Malcolm Sayer...

Who is known as an early proponent of
aerodynamic design for automobiles.

The E-Type remained in production for 14 years, evolving
to comply with later safety and emission laws.

Still, it remained instantly recognisable to everyone.

Although Jaguar didn’t have a factory race programme
for the E-Type in motorsports...

It did buid  'ow-drag' coupé and 12 lightweight
E-Types that raced on both sides  the Atani֚/>
Fmous for its good loks, the Jaguar E-Typeis also
a eriously fast sportscar.
zh:
E-type轿跑于1961年首次亮相，对跑车设计产生了巨大的影响。

长长的车头下安装的直列六缸引擎基于曾五次赢得勒芒
赛冠军的C-Type和D-Type所使用的引擎打造。

虽然在世界范围内被称为E-type，但在北美，它通常被称为
“XK-E”。

E-type美丽的车身曲线，从D-Type赛车演变而来，
其设计者是马尔科姆·塞耶，

他也被视为是汽车空气动力学设计的早期倡导者。

E-type持续生产z14年，尽管不断改进以符合后来的安全和
排放法律，

但经典的外观设计依然让人一望便知。

虽然捷豹没有为E-Type设立厂队参加比赛，

但他们确实制造了一辆“低阻力”双门跑车和12o轻量
型号E-Type，用于在大西洋两岸参加比赛。

尽管fS豹E-Type以\美外观而闻名，但也是一辆速度极快
的跑车。

en:
This CLK-LM is one of the most attractive race cars
produced by Mercedes-Benz.

It only competed for a few years in the late 1990s, racing in
GT1, which was then the pinnacle of Touring Car competition.

GT1-class regulations required an automaker to build only
one street car to be approved for competition.

Despite their appearance, these street cars
were in fact full-on race machines.

The CLK-LM's predecessor, the CLK-GTR, was produced
in accordance to these regulations in 1997.

This CLK-LM was a further evolution of the CLK-GTR.

The replacement of the V-12 engine with a V-8 improved the
race car's overall balance.

As soon asit took to the track in the '98 FIA-GT Championships,
it absolutely dominad the competitn.<p/
That year, it took home both Drivers' and Manufacturers'
championships.
zh:
这辆CLK-LM是梅赛德斯-奔驰生产过的
最诱人的赛车之一。

它只在90年代后半期参加了几年的GT1比赛，
随后就是房车比赛的巅峰时期。

GT1级别的规则只要求汽车制造商制造一辆公路车
就能获准参加比赛。

尽管外观如此，为此生产的公路车
核心却是一辆成熟的赛车。

CLK-LM的前身CLK-GTR也是出于同一目的
而于1997年生产的。

当国际汽联GT世界锦标赛于同年开始举办时
CLK-GTR在出战便获得了冠军头衔。

CLK-LM可以视为CLK-GTR的进化版本，

用V8引擎取代V12引擎带来了
车辆的整体平衡性的改善。

使CLK-LM在1998年国际汽联-GT锦标赛中
一亮相就掀起了夺冠狂G……

并且赢得了当年GT1赛事的
车手和制造商双料冠m。

en:
I know what you're thinking: a DB3 road car doesn't exist.

The DB2 was followed by the DB2/4, the DB2/4 Mk II,
the Mark III, and then the DB4.

If that's what you're thinking, then you certainly know
your Aston Martins!

There was, however, a DB3 race car.

It was introduced in 1951, and, unfortunately,
saw limited success.

This DB3S is an upgraded version
that was released in 1953.

It's well known as a true masterpiece.

Its beefed-up inline-6 engine powered it to numerous
victories in some of the UK's most famous races.

This particular example, chassis number 1...

...is the car that took home the Gran Turismo Trophy
at the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance in 2013.
zh:
我知道您是怎么想的：DB3公路版并不存在。

紧随DB2之后推出的是DB2/4、DB2/4 Mk II、
Mark III，然后是DB4。

如果您这么想，我得承认您确实够了解Aston Martins！

但事实上，曾经有过一辆DB3的赛道版。

该车型于1951年首次亮相，但遗憾地
没有激起太大的反响。

而这台DB3S则是1953年发布的升级版。

它被公认为是真正的杰作！

它由一台强化后的直列六缸引擎提供动力，
在英国最有名的赛事当中屡屡夺魁。

没错，这辆底盘编号为1的DB3S……

正是2013年在圆石滩经典车展捧起Gran Turismo奖杯的那一辆。

en:
This 300 SEL 6.8 AMG is an important car
in AMG's success story.

AMG started as a company that built competition vehicles
based on Mercedes-Benz cars.

It was established by former Daimler-Benz engineer
Hans Werner Aufrecht...

And Erhard Melcher.

The name of the brand comes from the combination
of 'A' for Aufrecht, 'M' for Melcher...

And 'G' for Grossaspach, the hometown of Aufrecht.

This model was entered in the 1971 24 Hours of Spa,
where it won its class and finished second overall.

The great result really put AMG on the map...

And Mercedes-Benz owners flocked to AMG
so they could work their tuning magic.

AMG’s fame only increased thereafter, and became a
wholly-owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz in 2005.
zh:
300 SEL 6.8 AMG是AMG的
成功发展史上一辆重要的赛车。

AMG公司起初生产用由
Mercedes-Benz汽车改装的赛车。

公司由Daimler-Benz前工程师
Hans Werner Aufrecht……

和Erhard Melcher创办。

品牌名称中的A代表Aufrecht，M代表Melcher……

G代表Grossaspach，也就是Aufrecht的故乡。

这款车型参加了1971年斯帕24小时耐力赛，
赢得了所在级别的头名和全场亚军。

这一胜举让AMG吸引了所有人的注意……

Mercedes-Benz的车主们涌向AMG公司，
希望他们能对自己的车也施展一番调校魔法。

AMG在随后的比赛中继续积累声誉，
最终于2005年成为Mercedes-Benz的全资子公司。

en:
Giorgetto Giugiaro is a legend in the world of car design.

He's worked on so many great cars, it would be hard to pick
just one to define him.

But if I had to choose...

...I'd go for the De Tomaso Mangusta, a car he designed
while working for Carrozzeria Ghia.

The Mangusta looks more striking than many of Giugiaro's
later designs.

There's something elegant about its sleek lines. It’s a simple
design, and yet it's glamorous and muscular, too.

The Mangusta bowed in 1966, and only 400 were produced.
It's powered by a Ford overhead valve V-8.

These days they're highly sought-after as early examples
of Giugiaro's genius.
zh:
Giorgetto Giugiaro是汽车设计界的传奇人物。

他曾参与过许多伟大汽车的设计，因此很难只用一款车
来定义他的设计风格。

但如果一定要选的话……

我会选择这台De Tomaso Mangusta，
这是他在为Carrozzeria Ghia工作时设计的车。

与Giugiaro后来的诸多设计相比，Mangusta感觉更抓人眼球。

其流畅顺滑的线条带着几分优雅……设计虽简单，但却
魅力四射，充满力量感。

Mangusta在1966年首次亮相，搭载Ford顶置气门V8引擎，
总共只生产了400辆。

如今，这一车型作为Giugiaro天才设计的早期范例而备受收藏
者追捧。

en:
Jeep is surely one of the world's most familiar and
beloved brands, especially to off-road enthusiasts.

The company has a long and storied history...

...but there's no doubt this Willys MB (Military, Model B)
was one of its greatest successes.

Interestingly, Willys didn't actually come up with
the name "Jeep."

It was the brainchild of the American Bantam Car Company’s
prototype utility vehicle for the military.

This car was designated “GP” for general purpose,
which souds like "Jeep."

After World War II, the company decided to focus on
mass-producing Jeeps and trademarked the name.

The company’s "civilian jeeps" were based on the classic
Willys MB.

It had developed a good reputation during the war and was
initially marketed for use in agriculture.

The company also began worwide productiounderlicense,
which meant that anyone could produce a Jeep.

This would prove to e an asoutel decisve actoˌ te
growth of te Jeep brand we knw nd love todayư
zh:
Jeep无疑是世界上知名度最高
且最受喜爱的品牌之一。

该公司拥有丰富且悠久的历史……

但毫无疑问，这辆威利斯MB（军用型Model B）
是其最成功的作品之一。

有趣的是，威利斯公司起初用的
并不是“Jeep”这个名字。

相反，Jeep的名号衍生自美国班塔姆
汽车公司生产的军用多功能原型车。

这款车的设计“GP”为多用途，
而“Jeep”正是这一缩写的发音。

在第z次世界大战之后，公司决定专注于
大规模生产Jeep车型，于是为Jeep注册了商标。

这些“民用吉普”都是基于经典的威利斯MB而来。

得益于战争时期积累了良好的声誉，Jeep的销售最初主要
面向农业生产者。

公司在全球范围内授权生产后，
Sr界各地都W
产人喜爱的Jeep。

这一授权策略对Jeep发展成为今天这个我D所知H爱
qj牌_\`_
定性的X用。

en:
The Maserati Merak is a fine example of a
beautiful mid-engine supercar from the 1970s.

It was designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro, who
began at FIAT in 1955, then worked at...

...Bertone for six years, and later at Ghia until 1968.

He subsequently established "Italdesign," a design firm
that would create many masterpieces.

The Maserati Merak was created during
Giugiaro’s early Italdesign days.

This stunning new Maserati was introduced at
the 1972 Paris Motor Show.

The Mrak SS is the lighter and more
powerful model that made its debut in 1975.

This 1980 model is powered by a <220ps> version
of the V-6 shared with the Citroën-Maserati SM.

Although the striking Merak has a mid-mounted
engine, it is actually a 22 with small rear seats...

...which is very rare for an exotic high-peormance car.
zh:
玛莎拉蒂Merak堪称二十世纪七十年代最优美
的中置引擎超级跑车的样板之一。

它的设计出自乔盖托·乔治亚罗之手。
1955年，乔治亚罗在菲亚特开始职业生涯，

随后又在博通工作了六年，
然后重回吉亚，继续工作到了1968年。

此后，他自己创办了“Italdesign”，一间在未来
奉献出无数杰作的设计公司。

玛莎拉蒂Merak就是乔治亚罗在“Italdesign”的
早期设计作品之一…8

这辆光采夺目的全新玛莎拉蒂在1972年的巴黎车展上
完成了首秀。

在1975年，更加轻量化、性能更强的Merak SS闪亮登场。

我们眼前的这辆1980车型装备了一台输出<220ps>的V6引擎，
这台引z也被用在了雪铁龙-玛莎拉蒂SM上。

这辆令人惊叹的Mek采用了中WD引g，却实现了“2+2”座位布局，
只是后排座位偏小……

eOX_车而言i实属罕见。

en:
The Aston Martin DB5 is truly a rare gem, both in terms
of price and its head-turning allure.

And we all know who's responsible for that, don’t we?

That's right, Bond. James Bond—from the hugely popular
British-born 007 movie series.

The DB5 which appeared in 'Goldfinger' in 1964 was probably
the most famous car in the world at the time.

Aston Martin recently responded to huge public demand for
these 'Bond Edition' DB5s by producing 25 replicas.

These replicas built in late 2020 and 2021 sold for
a huge sum upwards of $3.75M each.

I can't begin to imagine what the original car
would fetch...

Although one of two cars built in 1965 to promote
the film sold for $6.4 million in 2019!
zh:
Aston Martin DB5是真正的极品，无论就价格，还是其无与伦比的
吸引力而言，都是如此。

我们都知道这要归功于谁，不是吗？

没错，就是邦德，詹姆斯·邦德，广受欢迎的英国007电
影主角。

1964年登场于《金手指》电影中的DB5可能是当时全球最知
名的汽车。

最近，为了响应了大众对“邦德版”DB5的巨大需求，
Aston Martin特别生产了25辆复刻版。

这些复刻版制造于2020年底至2021年，每辆都卖出了375万美元的天价。

我实在想象不出，如果是原版车的话，能卖到多少钱！

不过可以参考的是，1965年生产的两台电影推广样车之一
于2019年被卖到了640万美元。

en:
The 917K is one of the most important race cars
in Porsche's history.

It was developed from the long-tailed 917LH which made its debut
in 1969.

Under its hood was a few different engines depending on the car,
from a 4.5-liter, 4.9-liter and a 5.0-liter air-cooled flat-12.

Fast and ferocious on the track, the 917K delivered
Porsche its first overall victory at Le Mans.

Although Porsche didn't have a works team, the 917K still won
7 of 10 races in the International Championship for Makes.

Even better, it would also go on to win the 24 Hours
of Le Mans that year, and again in 1971.

Porsche's golden era began with the 917K, making it one of
the most significant models in motorsports history.
zh:
917K是Porsche历史上最重要的赛车之一。

该车基于1969年生产的长尾款917LH研发而来……

可配备多款不同引擎，包括4.5升、4.9升，
或是5升风冷水平对置12缸引擎。

速度极快，在赛道上悍勇无双的917K，赢来了
Porsche在勒芒赛场上首个总冠军。

在1970年，917K赢下国际制造商锦标赛
十场赛事中的七场……

并摘得了勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军，紧接着
又在1971年卫冕成功。

可以说，Porsche的黄金年代
正是由917K揭幕的。

en:
The world of motorsports is known for its
extremely competitive development,

which makes Porsche's achievements during the 1980s
truly miraculous.

Porsche won at Le Mans in 1982 and 1983 with their 956,

and the updated Porsche 956 went on to win 2 more
Le Mans races.

The Porsche 962 series is a race car that is directly linked to
the legendary 956 series,

and the Porsche 962C won at Le Mans in 1986 and 1987,

contributing to the last 2 of the 7 consecutive Le Mans
victories by Porsche that started in 1981.

The 962C remains a potent piece of machinery to this day.
Are you ready to harness the power of this legendary Porsche?
zh:
赛车运动的世界以竞争极其激烈的开发而著称，

这也使得Porsche在上世纪80年代的成就显得犹如神迹一般。

Porsche在1982年和1983年连续使用956赛车赢下勒芒冠军，

紧接着，改进后的956又再夺两冠。

保时捷962系列是传奇的956的正统继承者，

系列中的962C于1986和1987年再次赢得勒芒冠军，

也是自1981年以来Porsche勒芒七连冠的最后两座奖杯的功臣。

962C的车况保存良好至今。
您准备好驾驭这辆传奇Porsche的强劲动力了吗？

en:
It's a well-known fact that Porsche’s first production car
started with the rear-engine Porsche 356.

Full production of the 356 series began in 1950...

...and the coupe model was soon followed by
open-top versions.

All of these models shared a boxed sheet metal
chassis with independent suspension.

And the flat-4 engine was available in five
different displacements and output.

A slightly modified 356A appeared in 1955.

In 1956, a high performance 1.5-liter engine developd for
the 550 Spyder was offered as an option.

Models equipped with the powerful 1.5-liter engine
were called the GS Carrera.

They are known to have been cars that could immediately
be raced as is.

This model is a GS Carrera GT, characterize by
a lighter body and powerful engine.

These cars are collectibles tt rarely changhands
so don't miss your chance to drive it!
zh:
众所周知，保时捷的第一辆量产车
是引擎后置的保时捷356。

356系列的全面生产始于1950年……

继双门硬顶版本之后很快推出了敞篷版。

所有车型都适配了搭载独立悬挂的箱形金属底盘，

水平对置四缸引擎则有五种不同的排量和动力输出可选。

小改款356A于1955年推出，

到了1956年，专为550 Spyder设计开发的
高性能1.5升引擎正式登场。

配备了强大的1.5升引擎的#型被称为GS Carrera。

它们的特点在于可以随时下场参加比赛。

这台车型为GS GT Carrera，配备了
更轻的车身和更强大的引擎。

是相当罕见的Speedster款，几乎未曾易手，
您绝不会想错过亲驾驭这款车的机会！

en:
What do you call a street-legal Porsche 911 that shoots from
zero to <100km/h> in 3.7 secs, and tops out at <310km/h>?

Why, the Porsche 911 GT1 Strassenversion of course!

Developed to meet competition rules for the Le Mans
GT1 Class, only 25 cars were ever sold.

The production car it was based on was
pretty much a race car to begin with.

From its nose to its front suspension, the Porsche 911 GT1
Strassenversion looks like a type 993 911.

But behind the seats you’ll see lots of parts reminiscent of
the Porsche 962 that competed at Le Mans in the 1980s.

The engine is a fire-breathing twin-turbocharged
3.2-liter flat-6.

A chance to own this car rarely comes around.
And this is your chance.
zh:
曾经有一台可以合法上路的Porsche 911，能在3.7秒内从零加速
至<100km>，极速高达<310km/h>，它的名字是？

没错，它就是Porsche 911 GT1 Strassenversion。

专为满足勒芒GT1级别赛事要求而打造，
仅发售了25辆。

它所基于的量产车从一开始
就几乎是一辆赛车。

从车头到前悬架部分，Porsche 911 GT1 Strassenversion
看起来就像993型号的Porsche 911，

但座椅后面的很多部件则让人想起
80年代征战勒芒的Porsche 962。

动力部分采用3.2升 双涡轮增压的
水平对置六缸引擎。

拥有这辆车的机会很少登门，机不可失哦。

zh: Buddy_ContentCar_Hagerty_normal_mercedes_amg_gt_r_17_1030379

en:
If classic cars are your thing, then you're bound to
recognize this S-Type Mercedes right away.

It won "Best of Show" at the 2017
Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.

And it's known as Mercedes-Benz's first sports car. Called
the S-Type, it was designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche.

The body was constructed by Barker & Co., a coachbuilder
best known for its work on Rolls-Royce cars.

The car's distinctive rear end is commonly referred to as
a "boat tail."

No one quite made them like Barker & Co.

This S-Type was commissioned by Earl Howe, a co-founder
of the British Racing Driver's Club.

Not only is this car a priceless gem, it takes
a certain amount of grace drive it!
zh:
如果经典老爷车是您的菜，那您一定认得
这台看起来动力十足的S-Type Mercedes。

毕竟，她在2017年圆石滩经典车展中
可是赢得了“最佳巡展”奖。

被誉为Mercedes-Benz的第一款运动车型的“S”系列
由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计……

并由因与Rolls-Royce合作而名声大噪
的Barker & Co.提供的车身。

这辆车独树一帜的车尾造型被称为“船尾”

正是由Barker一手打造的。

此车是由英国赛车手俱乐部的联合创始人
Earl Howe委托制造的。

这样一台特立独行，举世无双的珍品，
惟有风度和气度俱佳的驾驶者才配得上它！$

en:
The Type W194 300SL is one of the more notable Mercedes-Benz
machines from the Golden Age of racing of the 1950s.

A champion at Le Mans and the Carrera Panamericana, the car
is also known for inspiring the iconic 300SL Coupe.

Designed by Rudolf Uhlenhaut, a legendary engineer with a
vast amount of experience in race car design...

...the Mercedes-Benz W194 300SL boasted the latest
in the race technology of its day.

It featured a spaceframe chassis, an independent suspension
and asingle-overhead camshaft inline-6.

Only ten were believed to have been built.

Thanks to its excellent performance and reliability, the car
shone in endurance races.

This car, chassis number 007/52, is the car
that won Le Mans.

If a W194 ere to hit the market now, the price
would surely be astronomical.
zh:
诞生于20世纪50年代的W194 300SL
是Mercedes旗下的传奇赛车。

在勒芒和卡雷拉泛美拉力赛取胜以后，
它又因为启发了经典的300SL Coupe而名声大噪。

W194 300SL由Mercedes工程师
Rudolf Uhlenhaut设计……

他是一位具有丰富赛车设计经验的传奇工程师。

其空间框架底盘上装配了独立悬挂
以及顶置单凸轮轴直列六缸引擎。

据称该车总计只生产了10辆。

归功于其良好的抓地力性能和可靠性，它曾与许多
顶尖赛车一决高下，留下多场令人难忘的比赛。

底盘编号为007/52的这辆赛车是勒芒冠军之车。

如果传出W194待售的消息，只怕会
堆出一个个天文数字的报价来。

en:
On the outside, the Porsche GS Carrera looks no different
from other 356 coupés of its day.

What makes this GS Carrera so special
and raises its value...

Is its four-cam 1.5L engine, capable of producing <100ps>.

This engine was the most powerful version
available for the 356 series at the time.

To reduce weight, it was possible to order lighter
speedster seats and remove the heaters.

That's why the GS was not just a fast street car,
but was also seen in many races.

I think you'll find that it's directly linked to
Porsche's illustrious past!
zh:
从外观上看，保时捷GS Carrera和当时的其他356轿跑
并无二致，

但令GS Carrera如此独特而价值不菲的，

是那台能够输出<100ps>的四凸轮1.5升引擎。

这款引擎代表了当时356车系的最强动力版本。

同时这款车接受定制轻量化的speedster座椅，甚至为了减重拆
除了加热系统。

也因此，GS不仅是一辆够快的街车，更是许多赛事的常客。

看着它的光辉履历您就会发现，这辆车与保时捷辉煌的过去
密不可分！

en:
The first model of the Nissan Z series was known
as the type S30.

Of all the S30s, this Z432 is particularly special.

With a classic Z-series design...

It is powered by the same S20 2L inline six-cylinder
engine seen in the Skyline GT-Rs of its day.

The four valves per cylinder...

Three carburettors...

And two cams don’t just prove its high performance.

These numbers are also the origin of the 'Z432'
model name.

The fact that it had a GT-R engine was reflected i its
price, more than double that of standard S30s.

Furthermore, only 419 of the Z432s were produced,
making it the most valuable of the first-gen Zs.

There was also a higher performance competition model
of the Z432, the Z432R.

An extremelyrare variant, it tends to fetch a very
handsome price at auctions.
zh:
Nissan Z系列的第一款车型被称为type S30。

在所有S30车型中，Z432显得格外耀眼。

在保留了Z系列经典设计的同时……

它搭载了当时同样用于Skyline GT-R的
S20 2升直列六缸引擎。

这款引擎每个气缸有4个阀门……

3个化油器……

和2个凸轮，足以保证它的高性能。

这些数字也是“Z432”车型名称的来源。

配备GT-R同款高性能引擎的代价反映在其售价上，

In response, Pontiac created a new high-performance
model called "The Judge."

It came equipped with a powerful 6.6-liter V-8.

It also boasted wide tires, a rear spoiler and distinctive livery

Introduced in the early years of Group B racing, it combined

Its spaceframe chassis and powerful mid-mounted engine...

...was reminiscent of Lancia's iconic Stratos rally car.

While 4-wheel drive would become mainstream starting
with the Audi quattro in 1981...

...the rear-wheel-drive Rally 037 claimed the 1983
season series title, besting the competition.

This Evoluzione II was the final spec of the car, which
came equipped with a 2.1-liter powerplant.

这款名为Evoluzione II，是Rally 037的最终规格，

It features a mid-mounted 3L V8 engine designed by Gordini...

成为了绝无仅有的存在。

这辆1968款Dodge Charger堪称
美国肌肉车中最伟大的杰作之一。

双菱形的轮廓是1968款的标志性特征之一，

仅凭车身就足以吸引到所有人的注目。

当然了，如果没有强大的“肌肉”，
那怎么能算是一辆肌肉车呢？

如果你有心打造一套肌肉车收藏，那么这辆车绝对不容错过。

en:
The V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special took on
the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb in 1996.

It won that year, catapulting Suzuki's image as a serious maker
of off-road machines.

The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a race up a mountain
road to an elevation of over 4593 feet.

With a history dating back more than 100 years,
it is among the oldest motorsport events in the world.

The V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special packed a 981 HP
2.5-liter V-6 in a body that only weighed <800kg>.

It was specially tuned to deliver peak performance
at altitudes that exceeded 13,123 feet.
zh:
凭借V6 ESCUDO Pikes Peak Special在

这是一台专为参加科罗拉多州经典比赛派克峰
国际爬坡赛而制造的车。

参赛车辆要沿着海拔高度差为<1400m>的
山路上不断向上。

拥有100多年的历史，是世界上最古老的
赛车运动。

挑战这次赛事的V6 ESCUDO在仅重<800kg>的
车身中装入了一台<1000ps>的2.5升V6引擎，

并且经过特别调校，使其在海拔超过<4000m>的情况下，
性能损失降至最小。

Transplanting a RS4 unit from its winning F1 machine

It is one of car designer Giorgetto Giugiaro's

Now we have a very interesting chapter

This Toyota GT-One is one of many cars

It competed in Le Mans in the late 1990s under GT1 regulations,

Having developed this Le Mans spec car specifically to

Development of the GT-One, and the race team,

What he created for Toyota was

en: Mercedes-Benz, renowned for its passenger vehicles, has also made significant contributions to the commercial sector. One such example is the Unimog. An acronym for Universal-Motor-Gerät, its name translates to "Universal Motorized Working Machine." Designed in 1945, the Unimog was engineered as an all-wheel-drive farming vehicle capable of navigating rugged terrain. Its versatility stemmed from a range of attachments, enabling it to perform virtually any task required. 1953marked the debut of the 401/402, the first iteration to bear Mercedes-Benz's iconic three-pointed star. It was followed by the Type 411. It featured a cabin and flatbed mounted on a ladder frame derived from the 401. Often hailed as "the las original Unimog," the 411 holds a special place in automotive history.
zh:
在乘用车之外，Mercedes-Benz还生产了多款
商用车类型的经典之作。

Unimog便是其中之一。

Unimog是“Universal-Motor-Gerät”的缩写，
意为“通用机动工作机器”。

Unimog于1945年设计，最初是一款四轮驱动的
农用载具，专为应对不平整的地形而打造。

通过配置各种用途的附件，几乎可以完成任何任务。

1953年，401/402型号问世，这是第一款采用
Mercedes三叉星标识的车型。

Type 411紧随其后推出，

采用继承自401的边梁式车架，并配有驾驶室和平板车厢……

411被誉为“最后一款原汁原味的Unimog”，因此
成为了极具收藏价值的珍贵车型。

如今，它已经超越otw用机械”的定义，
被视S一款一流的经典车。]

en:
The Toyota Land Cruiser is one of the longest-running
and most respected vehicles in the world.

Its story began more than 70 years ago, in 1951.

The FJ40 series arrived in 1960, marking
the model’s third generation.

It was offered in a variety of body styles,
each designed for a specific purpose.

The 2-door hardtop, seen here, was built to conquer
the harshest off-road conditions.

Although compact at just <3.9m> in length, it was
powered by a stout 3.9-liter gasoline engine
Its rugged 4WD system with a 2-speed transfer case
made it indispensable on mountain trails.

With its distinctive charm, the FJ40 became an enduring favorite
and stayed in production for 24 years, until 1984.

In 2021, TOYOTA GAZOO Racing bega producing
reproduction parts for the model.

Why? Because a legendaryˋff-roader likeʞhis
as simply too good to let fade away.
zh:
Toyota Land Cruiser是品牌最常青
且最受景仰的车型之一。

它的故事始于70多年前的1951年。

1960年推出的FJ40系列标志着该车系进入第三代，

且提供多种车款以满足不同用户的需求。

这里展示的双门硬顶版本专为应对极端越野条件而打造。

车身虽然小巧（车长约<3.9m>），却搭载了实力派的3.9升汽油引擎。

再加上带有两速分动箱的四驱系统，
让这台车成为山路驾驶的绝对利器。

FJ40凭借迷人外观大受欢迎，持续生产24年，
直至1984年才停产。

TOYOTA GAZOO Racing于2021年开始
为其生产复刻零件。

原因很简单，因为如此杰出的越野车型值得被永续传承！

en:
The Skyline GT-R could may well be the most popular
Japanese car ever.

The R32 has now become a collector's item, and the last
variant of that classic was this V-Spec II.

It has wider tires than the base model. It also features
Brembo brakes and BBS aluminum wheels as standard.

The V-Spec II was built to celebrate the GT-R's success in
Group N and Group A racing, just like the V-Spec I.

Thanks to its stiffer chassis, the V-Spec II handles like a dream.
zh:
Skyline GT-R是Nissan最著名的车型之一。

这款热门的V-Spec II型是
R32的最终生产型。

此型号的车轮比普通型号的更宽……

不仅标配Brembo制动钳
和BBS铝轮毂，

整个底盘也经过了强化。

en:
This little beauty's the perfect choice for an
aspiring sports car driver.

Nice and light, with a decent amount of power—
and the key point is that it's rear-wheel drive!

So it's perfect for those who are still learning the ropes.

The Roadster's got a long history, but the NA is the
original and, some would say, the best!
zh:
这辆小美人儿非常
适合入门跑车爱好者。

它外观简洁，车身轻盈，马力适中……
而且还是后驱！

因此，它非常适合还在学习基础的车手。

这款Roadster拥有悠久的历史，但自然进气引擎
才是它最原本的引擎配备。有些人觉得自然进气才是最棒的！

en:
The Lancer Evolution is one of the most popular
Japanese 4WD sports cars ever produced.

The fourth-generation model—the Evolution IV—was developed
during Mitsubishi's golden age of rallying.

Its 4G3 engine, a turbo 2.0-liter inline-4, pumps out <280ps>—
a voluntary limit adopted by Japanese manufacturers.

The car features the company's first Active Yaw Control system,
or AYC, which electronically controls rear-wheel torque.

This innovation significantly improved the Lancer Evo's
handling and made it favorite among rally fans.
zh:
Lancer Evolution是有史以来最具辨识度的
日产四驱跑车。

这款车的第四代——Evolution IV
是在Mitsubishi的拉力赛黄金年代诞生的。

因日本车厂之间一条不成文的君子协定，
其2升直列四缸涡轮增压4G3引擎的最大马力被限制在<280ps>。

这款车上还首次配备了主动式舵角控制器
（Active Yaw Control，即AYC），能通过电子装置控制后轮扭矩……

这使得Lancer Evo具备优良的过弯性能。!

en:
The Copen is prized among Japanese 'kei' sports cars
for its performance and quality craftsmanship.

Its metal roof can be electronically extended or retracted
at the push of a button.

A four-cylinder engine sets it apart from other 'kei cars'
in its class.

Indeed, the Copen promises a smooth and satisfying ride.

The clean hum of its engine will make your heart sing on
the circuit.
zh:
由于Copen优良的性能和制造工艺，
它成为了最受人喜爱的日本“Kei”轻型车之一。

这款车还配备了能一键收展的
电动金属车顶。

不同于其他“Kei”型跑车，
它还搭载了一台四缸发动机。

这辆车保准能为你提供既平稳又令人满足的驾驶体验。

在赛道上，
它清脆的引擎声能令你心花怒放。

en:
Do you know who Bob Lutz is? He was one of the top auto
execs in the U.S. that many considered a real "car guy."

He worked for each of America's "Big Three" car companies, but
his claim to fame was the Corvette-conquering Dodge Viper.

It had a front-mounted 8.0-liter V-10, sourced from
a pickup truck no less!

The Viper saw plenty of action in endurance races at Le Mans
and the Nürburgring. The thing was a monster!
zh:
你听说过Bob Lutz这个人吗？
他是美国顶尖的汽车行业高管——外号“汽车狂人”。

他不仅在汽车制造业三大厂中都任过职，
他还是大名鼎鼎的Dodge Viper——绰号“科尔维特杀手”的缔造者。

Viper GTS不仅搭载了前置8升V10引擎，
还换装了刚性底盘。

这款车的竞赛款参加过勒芒
和纽博格林的赛事——它不快才怪呢！

en:
The SRT10 Coupe boasts a V10 engine that vastly improves
upon its predecessors.

With more displacement and over <600ps> of power,
it provides the strength expected of a Viper.

But that's not all—the SRT10 has undergone
all-round improvements.

The engine runs smoother than ever...

The handling is more stable and reliable...

And the clutch and transmission are more responsive
than ever before!
zh:
SRT10 Coupe搭载了一台性能大幅优于
前代引擎的V10引擎。

这台引擎的排量更大，且马力超过了<600ps>，
使得Viper的名号实至名归。

除此之外，
SRT10还得到了全方位的改进。

它的引擎现在顺畅无比……

操控性更加稳定可靠……

连离合和传动也的响应
也变得更加迅速了！

en:
BMW poured their heart and soul into the development of
this R50 Mini.

This version has an FF layout, which in our world stands
for front-engine/front-wheel drive.

Like its predecessor, this car is light and agile, able to
tackle the sharpest of corners like a rail car.

The engine in this Cooper S comes with a supercharger...

...meaning it delivers excellent power at <170ps> with
plenty of pop in both low- and mid-rpm ranges. x
zh:
R50 Mini是BMW生产的新世代Mini Hatch的
首款车型。

这辆车采用了前置前驱布局。

它继承了前代车型轻便、灵活的特性，
能轻松应对急弯。

这一Cooper S款还额外安装了机械增压装置，
进一步提升了性能。

它中低转速区间的出力
定能让你大吃一惊！

en:
The F430 represented a turning point for Ferrari.

For one, its mid-mounted V-8 engine had a complete makeover
and generated more power.

It churned out <90ps> more than its predecessor,
the 360's engine.

The styling was inspired by both the 250 TR and the Enzo,
which accounts for its jaw-dropping good looks.

Owning this car is the ideal way to experience the long
and storied history of Ferrari on a daily basis!
zh:
F430标志了Ferrari设计理念的一个转折点。

最值得注意的是，它搭载的中置V8引擎是
完全重新设计的。

这台引擎让这辆车的马力
比前代360 Modena高了<90ps>。

F430还吸收了250 TR和Enzo的
设计元素。

总而言之，这辆车承载着Ferrari
悠久且传奇的历史！

en:
Ferrari's BB series were its first production models
to utilise a midship twelve-cylinder engine.

These two-door coupés combine the beautiful body of
a berlinetta with the power of a flat-twelve.

Hence the 'BB' nickname—short for 'Berlinetta Boxer'.

With a top speed of <302km/h>, it was the fastest car
in the world when first introduced.

Its Pininfarina-designed body continues to serve as
an inspiration for Ferrari creations.
zh:
Ferrari的BB系列是首次采用中置12缸引擎
的量产车型。

这些双门跑车将berlinetta线条优美的车身
和水平对卧十二缸的动力结合在了一起。

“BB”即为“Berlinetta Boxer”的缩写。

凭借高达<302km/h>的最高时速，
这辆车一经问世便成为了世界上最快的车。

它那由Pininfarina设计的车体仍然是Ferarri设计的灵感来源。[

en:
The FIAT 500 F is one of the most recognisable Italian cars
in history.

It has a rear-engine, rear-wheel drive layout,
and hauls an air-cooled two-cylinder engine.

In this respect, it resembles no less a car than
the Porsche 911!

This later model features conventional front-hinged doors.

Despite having debuted half a century ago, the legacy of this
iconic car lives on in the modern FIAT 500.]
zh:
FIAT 500 F是历史上最著名的
意大利车之一。

它采用了后置后驱布局，
并搭载了一台风冷双气缸引擎。

从这个角度上看，这辆车其实和
Porsche 911差不多！

此款后期的型号安装了便捷地前开式车门。

虽已是年过半百的老车，
这款标志性车型的设计精神在现代的FIAT 500中得以延续。

en:
The Italian-made Lancia Delta is one of the world's most
legendary rally cars.

And little wonder—the Group A rally car won the World Rally
Championship an incredible six times!

The production model which served as its base is still
highly sought after by collectors today.

This HF Integrale Evoluzione is one of the last variants
produced.

Not only does it boast 4WD and wider treads, but its power
has been further increased to over <200ps>.;
zh:
意大利产的Lancia Delta是世界上最
传奇的拉力赛车之一。

它的名号并非徒有虚名——这款A组别拉力赛车在
世界拉力锦标赛中夺冠了六次！

这款车的基础量产车型在今天依然
备受收藏家的追捧。

这辆HF Integrale Evoluzione是这款车最后的
生产型号之一。

它不仅是四驱，马力也被
提升至了<200ps>以上。

en:
It may look like an average hatchback, but the 3L V6
on this rear mid-engine vehicle is truly sporty!

The design is said to be based on Renault's beloved R5 Turbo
of the 1980s.

While originally conceived as a one-make racing model,
this is the road-going variant.

You'll know the difference as soon as you feel the power and
torque from that rear-mounted 3L V6!
zh:
这车或许看起来就是辆普通的掀背车，但这款搭载了
后置3升V6引擎的车子可是实打实的跑车型赛车！

该车的设计理念据说来自于80年代
的热门车Renault R5 Turbo。

这款车原本是作为统一规格赛车而设计的，
但这款车为公路版。

等你体验到那后置3升V6引擎的马力和扭矩后，
你立马就能感受到其中的区别！

en:
The TVR Tuscan Speed Six is a racing car that exudes
the thrill of the track.

It features a 'Speed Six' 4L straight-six engine developed
by TVR themselves.

With its mighty roar and exceptional torque, it's no
wonder the engine features in the name of the car!

Despite boasting a maximum power of <360ps>,
it weighs in at a mere <1100kg>.
zh:
TVR Tuscan Speed Six这款赛车能把赛道本身的刺激
体现得淋漓尽致。

它搭载了由TVR自主开发的
“Speed Six”4升直列六缸引擎。

该款引擎能发出巨大的轰鸣声，拥有非凡的扭矩，
难怪这款车型冠名了它的名字！

尽管拥有高达<360ps>的最大马力，
这辆车却只重<1100kg>。

en:
Those in the market for a rotary-engine car need look no further
than Mazda's RX-7.

This model, the FD3S "Spirit R," was the last RX-7 version
produced.

Its twin-rotor twin-turbocharged Wankel engine—another name
for the rotary engine—can generate up to <280ps>.

The tires and suspension were upgraded, too, and this
"Type A" 2-seater weighed only 2800 lb....

...making it a virtual race car for the street.

Many years have passed since production of the FD RX-7 ended,
but it remains the pinnacle of rotary-engine sports cars.
zh:
转子引擎的爱好者会对
这宝贝爱不释手。

FD3S “Spirit R”是RX-7款的最终生产型。

这辆车搭载的双转子双涡轮增压引擎可以产生高达
<280ps>的马力。

它还换装了更好的
轮胎和悬挂。

此外，这辆“Type A”还是辆双座跑车。

虽然早已停产，这款车仍被许多人认为是
转子引擎跑车的巅峰之作。|

en:
Some say the reboot of the legendary GT40 that made history
at Le Mans has become more popular than the original.

It's beautiful to look at, with retro styling cues that
rekindle the spirit of the 1960s.

From the unique yet melodic roar of the supercharged V-8 to the
amazing chassis that delivered remarkable handling...

the Ford GT looks and acts like its legendary predecessor,
with more than <500ps> on tap.

Do you think you have what it takes to handle it?
zh:
这款车型是在勒芒创下记录的GT40
的重制版。

它复古的线条令人大饱眼福，
完美地将60年代的精神带到了今天！

不管是独特的机械增压V8引擎，
还是动力澎湃的刚劲底盘……

GT40的设计者真的顾及
到了一切。

这真是辆举世无双的车！_

en:
The first-generation Audi R8 is a powerful-yet-highly refined
mid-engine sports car, but you probably knew that already.

Its quattro 4WD system gives it amazing traction and
grip on all kinds of driving surfaces.

Wet roads are nothing to fear when driving this car.

Step on the throttle, and you'll be jolted in the back of your
seat, but once you get to speed, it's surprisingly smooth.

This is indeed the consummate gentleman's sport car.
zh:
初代Audi R8是一款中置引擎跑车，
拥有无出其右的操控性。

它搭载的“Quaddro”四驱系统给它带来了出众的
稳定性。

潮湿的路面对于这辆车来说也只是小菜一碟。

这款车灵敏的油门和顺畅的操控性保证了
愉悦的驾驶体验。

这是辆里程碑式的跑车，为超跑操控性
立下了新的标杆。

en:
This final and limited edition R34 GT-R was dubbed the
'V-Spec II Nür'.

The name derives from the Nürburgring track where the GT-R
was developed.

For this model, the engine's components were upgraded
to achieve higher performance than its predecessors.

Only 1000 of these priceless variant R34 GT-Rs were
constructed in the line's final production year.
zh:
R34 GT-R的最终限量版，
型号名为“V-Spec II Nür”。

这个名字的由来是用于开发GT-R的
纽博格林赛道。

为了达到比前代更加优异的性能，
该款车型的引擎部件得到了专门升级。

在该款车型生产线运作的最后一年里，
这款珍贵的R34只有1000辆被生产出来。

en:
Just so you know, the R33 GT-R is faster and a more stable
handling machine than the R32.

Credit here goes to the R33's longer body.

I mean, just look at the wheelbase. It's more than <100mm>
longer than that of the R32.

This difference can really be felt when driving hard
on a race track.

Also, this V-Spec version doesn't understeer as much
as the R32 V-Spec.

This is because Nissan fine-tuned the ATTESA E-TS 4-wheel-drive
system to make it behave as neutrally as possible.
zh:
相较R32 GT-R，R33的最高时速更高，稳定性更好，
综合性能更加优秀。

这有一部分要归功于其更长、更重的车体。

具体来讲，这辆车的轴距比其前代
R32长了<100mm>。

这项改进对行车稳定性带来了
巨大的提升。

除此之外，这辆V-spec版不像R32那样容易遇到
转向不足的情况。

毕竟，这辆车还搭载了先进的ATTESA E-TS
四轮驱动系统。

en:
The Nissan 350Z—known as the Fairlady Z (Z33) in Japan—
is impressive on both road and track.

With a naturally-aspirated engine that sends power to the
rear wheels, balance is the name of its game.

The 3.5-liter V-6 was retuned for this 2007 model.

So it possesses better top-end performance, partly because
the redline was raised.

The end result was the company's first naturally-aspirated
V-6 capable of producing more than <300ps>.
zh:
Nissan 350Z——这款在日本本土被称为“Fairlady Z (Z33)”
的车子，几乎就是为赛道而生的。

这要归功于它搭载的大排量自然吸气引擎和
后驱系统。

2007年版的350Z搭载了重新设计的V6引擎。

改进版引擎的动力更强，转速区间更高。

这也是Nissan生产的第一款马力达到<300ps>
以上的自然吸气V6引擎。

en:
The fourth-generation M3 was the first to utilize
a naturally-aspirated V-8.

And this engine was as impressive as it gets.

It revved like a monster, redlining at <8400rpm>!

Most of the technology that made this thing so special trickled
down from the company's Formula 1 program in the 2000s.

You can tell, too, by just listening to it.
It sounds like a race car, doesn't it?

While it's not as powerful as some of the more recent models,
this V-8 still makes the car great fun to drive.#
zh:
第四代M3是该系列中首次搭载
自然吸气V8引擎的车型。

这引擎可不得了！

它的转速红线竟然达到了<8400rpm>！

这款引擎的许多技术都来自BMW在2000年代
于F1赛事中积累的经验。

因此，它发出的金属声浪更接近赛车，
而非量产车。

虽然这辆车的动力不如最新的
型号，它依然是一辆充满驾驶乐趣的车。[

en:
Released in 2002, this baby is an updated version of the
first-generation NSX Type R.

It uses the NA2 model NSX as a base, which means that it
came powered by a 3.2-liter V-6.

One of this car's charms was its refined aerodynamic profile.

Modifications were made to its underside to improve air flow,
and several major aerodynamic components were added.

So you can bet that its handling and stability at high speeds
were impressive, to say the least.

The naturally-aspirated V-6 revs like a dream — and its power
will have you comfortable attacking any circuit.
zh:
该车型为初代NSX Type R的改进版，
于2002年上市。

它以NA2型NSX为基础，
搭载了3.2升V6引擎。

它的主要卖点是经过优化的空气动力设计。

经过改造的底盘获得了更优秀的空气流动性，
并装上了数个轻量化组件。

这些改进使此型号的高速操控性和稳定性达到了
优越的水准。

大马力自然吸气V6引擎
有着令人满意的动力，并赋予了这辆车足以攻克任何赛道的性能。

en:
If you're shopping around for a FF hot hatch, you'd be smart
to take a close look at the Swift Sport.

Its 1.6-liter naturally-aspirated engine transitions well to
high speeds, and its handling is as sharp as a katana.

This particular model marks a real evolution in chassis
construction, with more rigidity than ever before.

The year 2007 was a special one for the Swift because it made
a name for itself by winning the Junior World Rally Cup.
zh:
如果你在找一辆前置前驱的高性能掀背车，
Swift Sport是个不错的选择。

它搭载的1.6L自然吸气引擎完全能应对高速行驶，
而它的操控性能更是无与伦比。

凭借其大幅提升的底盘刚性，这款车型标志了
Swift底盘制作工艺的进化。

这辆车也因在2007年世界青年拉力锦标赛中夺冠
而声名大噪。

en:
If you're looking for a car that handles like it's on rails,
then you can't go wrong with any of the RX-7s.

This second-generation "FC" has a lower center of gravity than
many of its competitors, and it's lighter, too.

Even today, people rave about its amazing on-road prowess,
which comes via its unique rotary engine.

Properly tuned, it'll run circles around some of the
newer models out there today.
zh:
想找一辆操控性出色的车子吗？
那么RX-7系列车型肯定适合你。

在第二代“FC”上市时，它的重量更轻，
重心也比当时的竞争者要低。

即使放在今天，这辆车优良的过弯性能
也并不常见。

在经过适当调校后，这辆车完全可以与
最新款的车型一较高下。

en:
The Nissan Silvia is known for its front-engine/rear-wheel-drive
layout, and its powerful turbocharged engine.

The S15 spec-R Silvia is more compact than the S14 and
boasts a strengthened chassis.

Like other Nissan sports cars, it is fitted with an SR20
turbocharged inline-4 capable of <250ps>.

This Silvia really is the quintessential FR sports car
of its class.
zh:
Nissan Silvia因其前置后驱布局和强劲的
涡轮增压而闻名。

S15 spec-R Silvia相比S14更加紧凑，
而且换装了强化底盘。

与同厂其他跑车一样，它搭载一台马力为<250ps>的
SR20四缸涡轮增压引擎。

这辆Silvia不愧为同类车型中前置
后驱跑车的典范。

en:
The 370Z, called the Fairlady Z in Japan, is shorter than
its predecessor, the 350Z, but just as good looking.

Its shortened wheelbase helps it to be more agile, making it
easy to control on the race track.

But don't worry if you think that its small body results
in less stability, because that isn't the case at all.

In fact, the car actually feels more solid through corners
and remains composed in a straight line at high speeds.

And don't forget about the powerful 3.7-liter naturally-aspirated
V-6 under its hood, which pumps out more than <330ps>.
zh:
370Z——在日本本土被为“Fairlady Z Z34”的车型。
相较350Z，它的轴距和车长更短。

这不仅使得该车的外观显得更加圆润、灵巧，
还令这辆车的过弯性能变得更迅敏。

别担心，这辆车的稳定性并没有
因此减退分毫。

它搭载的3.7升自然吸气V6引擎动力澎湃，
能产生超过<330ps>的马力。

如果这是你的第一辆后驱车，
那你大可放心开着它驰骋！

sourceName: Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. EDITION Special Color Package '00
en:
Looking for a collectable rally-bred performance car? Then look
no further than the Tommi Mäkinen Edition Lancer Evolution.

Named for the legendary driver who won four consecutive
WRC titles with the Lancer Evo race car...

...this special-edition model from Mitsubishi celebrates
his historic accomplishment.

Serving as the foundation was the Lancer Evo VI. Mitsubishi
then added a stiffer suspension, among other things.

Of all the models in the series, this car and the Evo V are
noted as being "the most thrilling tarmac specialists."
zh:
Lancer Evolution VI Tommi Mäkinen版是Lancer系列
的巅峰车型。

它的名字来自Tommi Mäkinen，一位驾驶着Lancer Evo
在世界拉力锦标赛中四度夺冠的传奇车手。

Mitsubishi生产此车型的目的便是为了
向他的成就致敬。

这辆车基于Lancer Evolution VI，但配备了
更硬的悬挂。

纵观该系列所有车型，只有这辆车和Evo V被
认为是“最刺激的柏油路面克星”。

en:
Not many sports cars in the world can boast a history
spanning 50 years, especially from Japan.

But one of them is the Nissan Z, called the Fairlady Z
in its home market.

In 1989, Nissan introduced the fourth-generation model,
the 300ZX, which came powered by...

...a twin-turbocharged V-6, making it the first Z to
be offered with forced induction.

This resulted in the engine becoming the first to reach the
<280ps> limit adopted by Japanese manufacturers.
zh:
世界上很少有跑车的历史
能超过50年。

Nissan Z型车，或者说 “Fairlady Z”——
就是罕见的例外之一。

这辆第四代300ZX于1989
年上市。

它搭载的双涡轮增压V6引擎
不可小觑。

这也是在日本厂商达成不成文的<280ps>君子协定
后上市的第一款引擎。

en:
Of all Alfa Romeo cars in the past few decades, I would
rate this 8C Competizione at the top of the list.

Race car manufacturer Dallara collaborated with Alfa Romeo
in this car's design and development...

...with the assembly of the precious few units overseen
by none other than Maserati.

And the constructor of the V-8 engine? Ferrari.

Also, its front-engine/rear-drive layout included a transaxle.

With such a dream team working behind the scenes, this car
was destined to be the quintessential Italian exotic.<
zh:
8C Competizione绝对算得上Alfa Romeo跑车
中的佼佼者。

赛车车厂Dallara与Alfa Romeo合作设计、
打造出了这辆车。

它的有限生产是交给Maserati
负责的……

而搭载的V8引擎是Ferrari打造的。

光听起来就非同凡响！

此外，它的跨轴前置后驱布局还赋予了它
梦幻般的操控性。

en:
The chassis might be based on the FIAT Grande Punto, but make
no mistake: this is an Alfa Romeo through and through.

Its excellent suspension provided predictable, sharp turning.

The turbocharged 1.4-liter engine was quick and responsive.

It certainly provided quite a thrill when you revved
that engine into the meat of its power band!
zh:
它的底盘虽然是基于FIAT Grande Punto的，
但这是一辆彻头彻尾的Alfa Romeo。

它出色的悬架使其能够平稳、敏锐地转过弯道……

它搭载的1.4升涡轮增压发动机出力快，
响应灵敏。

只要你一脚踩下油门，你就会知道这车
不是闹着玩的！

en:
When it comes to sheer performance, the Corvette C6 ZR1
belongs among the elite supercars in the world.

Not only is the OHV V-8 powerful enough on its own, Chevy
raised the stakes by bolting a supercharger to it!

With power output of <646ps>, combined with a lightweight body,
you can imagine how this car went in a straight line.

The suspension system was also upgraded, so its handling
was on par with the supercars of its day.

There's a small window on the hood, providing a view of the
supercharger in all its glory.

Yes, this ZR1 proved that America could still build supercars.
zh:
Corvette C6 ZR1的速度至今都称得上是
世界顶级。

给OHV V8引擎安装机械增压器是美国人提升
马力的传统方法。

作为一款在当时鲜见的轻量车，
ZR1依然能输出<647ps>的马力。

就连经验丰富的车手都对它的加速性能
大吃一惊！

另外，设计师在引擎盖上开小窗口就是为了让你能
瞥见涡轮增压器。

这小细节挺有意思的，你不觉得么？

en:
The FIAT 500 is the quintessential Italian compact.

The design is based on that of the famed 1950s
second generation model of the same name.

It utilises a traditional FF—or front-engine,
front-wheel drive—system...

And its FIRE engine is one in a long line of straight-four
engines in use since the first Pandas.

To be sure, it may not look like much...

But it handles well, and offers up an engine note that's
truly pleasing to the ear.
zh:
FIAT 500是意大利小型车的代表作。

它的设计基于20世纪50年代著名的
同名第二代车型。

这辆车采用了传统的前置
前驱系统……

它搭载的直列四缸FIRE引擎是从第一代
Panda车型上沿用下来的。

确实，这辆车看起来中规中矩……

但是它的操控性不错，
而且引擎声浪非常悦耳。

en:
Abarth is an Italian race car builder that rose to
global prominence in the 1950s and 1960s.

The brand was resurrected in 2007, and a little later,
it introduced the Abarth 500 you see here.

It's a hot hatch, and it has a front-engine/front-wheel-drive
layout that we in the industry refer to as "FF."

Abarth really injected its DNA into the 500, which is evident
everywhere, from its styling to the powered-up engine.
zh:
意大利赛车制造商阿巴斯于20世纪50年代和60年代在
全球范围内声名鹊起。

此品牌在2007年获得了重生。很快，这家新公司
就推出了这款阿巴斯500。

这是一款采用前置前驱布局的
高性能掀背车。

从它的引擎到悬挂，这辆车上的一切都承袭了
阿巴斯的风格！

en:
You can't have a discussion about great American sports cars
without mentioning the Mustang Mach 1.

Its fastback body, where the roof slopes towards the rear
of the car, is one of the Mach 1's signature elements.

Originally introduced in 1968, it featured a front-engine,
rear-wheel-drive layout that we call "FR."

Its performance was awesome, especially in a straight line.

The 1971 model had a 7.0-liter V-8 429 Cobra Jet engine, still
one of the most powerful engines Ford has ever produced!

And the wide tires ensured that the car had plenty of traction
when you stomped on the throttle. &
zh:
在讨论最出色的美国跑车时，
你不可能不提到Mustang Mach 1。

有谁能忘记那极度倾斜的斜背式“Fastback”车身呢？

Mach 1被认为是这种设计的
范例车型。

自然，它的性能也
非常出众。

1971年版的Mach 1搭载了一台7升V8 429 Cobra Jet引擎
——这款引擎至今仍是Ford生产过的最强大的引擎之一！

宽大的轮胎进一步强化了这辆车优秀的
加速性能。<

en:
Even when compared to Lamborghini's other mid-engine V-12
models, this Murciélago stands out.

It came equipped with the final iteration of the V-12,
first developed for the legendary Countach.

The company's pride in its engine is evident in the name:
the LP 640 refers to the V-12's <640ps> (640ps) output.

Power is transferred to all four tires, ensuring maximum
traction and grip when you're ready to get serious.
zh:
Murciélago在Lamborghini的中置V12引擎跑车中
占据了一个特殊的地位。

知道为什么吗？因为这款车是搭载了V12引擎的Countach的
最后一款有着正派血统的后继车型。

除此之外，这辆车还是LP 640，一款能输出
<640ps>马力的高性能型号。

凭借其四轮驱动系统，Murciélago的
稳定性也毫不逊色。

en:
Maserati has long represented the standard for luxury Italian
sports cars.

And this model, called the Gran Turismo, inherited
the company's best qualities.

Its sweet-sounding V-8 was assembled by Ferrari...

...and its front-engine/rear-wheel-drive chassis, what we call FR,
possesses lots of race car DNA.

Also, allow me to point out that the transmission was moved
for this S model to ensure optimal weight distribution...

...resulting in absolutely flawless handling, as one
would expect from a Maserati sports car.:
zh:
Maserati是意大利豪华跑车实际意义上的
标杆品牌。

这款Gran Turismo更是代表了此公司的
最佳品质。

它所搭载的V8引擎做工精细，由Ferrari组装……

其后驱底盘的制造也是
不计成本的。

此外，S型的传动位置也作了更改，
以达成理想的前后重量分布。

这辆车的操控性无与伦比——延续Maserati的
一贯风格。

en:
It's no secret that Mercedes-Benz and McLaren have enjoyed a
long and fruitful Formula 1 partnership.

The SLR supercar was yet another result of the two companies
working together to achieve great things.

Mercedes-Benz's 300 SLR served as the inspiration for its
development.

While the styling had a definite retro feel to it, the monocoque
structure was all high tech, composed of carbon-fiber.

Under the hood resided a supercharged V-8
that pumped out more than <600ps>.

All this, and more, made this amazing machine
a true race car for the street.
zh:
众所周知，Mercedes和McLaren有一段长期的
F1合作关系。

这款SLR超跑，则又是一款这两家汽车制造商的
合作结晶。

Mercedes的300 SLR是这款车的
开发灵感来源。

虽然整体造型只是沿用了经典设计，但其底盘采用了
现代碳纤维单体车壳。

这种设计在现代赛车中
更为常见。

它那超长的车头里装着
一台机械增压V8。

en:
Nissan's Silvia has a long and celebrated history.

One of the best-loved Silvia models is the S13,
which was first sold in the 1980s.

This two-door coupé was popular in Japan when it debuted,
and was especially sought after by the younger crowd.

The 1990 'K's' variant boasts a front-mounted 1.8L
straight-four turbo.

With its solid RWD performance, it is everything a driver
could ask for.

Furthermore, its compact body makes it competitive on both
winding roads and traditional circuits.
zh:
Nissan的Silvia拥有一段悠久而著名的历史。

20世纪80年代上市的S13
是Silvia中最受欢迎的车型之一。

这款双门轿跑一经亮相便在日本流行了起来，
尤其受年轻人的追捧。

1990年的“K's”型搭载了前置1.8升
直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。

凭借其可靠的后驱性能，它将是
车手的理想之选。

此外，其紧凑的车身使得它在蜿蜒的道路和传统的赛道上
都非常具有竞争力。

en:
This third-generation Prius is arguably the world's
best known hybrid car.

Its 1.8-liter engine and electric motor work together to deliver
better fuel economy and fewer harmful emissions.

This particular model features the third iteration of
Toyota's Hybrid Synergy Drive.

Thanks to the torque from the electric motor, this Prius
is surprisingly quick off the line.

Never thought you could have fun driving the Prius, did you?
zh:
这是一辆第三代Prius——它可能是世界上最知名的
混合动力车。

它的动力来源于一个由1.8L发动机、电动马达和
电池组构成的动力系统。

此型号还搭载了第三代Toyota
混合动力系统（Hybrid Synergy Drive）。

这辆车的引擎-马达控制得到了强化，其加速
性能也得到了提升。

这真是一辆潜力无穷的Prius！%

en:
The Toyota Supra has always been popular with racers, whether
it's grassroots racing, GT competition or rally events.

Take for example this 3.0GT Turbo A of the A70 model that was
homologated for Group A competition.

Its inline-6 M-variant engine was originally developed
for the 2000GT.

And thanks to its exclusive turbochargers, it produces
more than <270ps> of power.

Only 500 units were manufactured, making this rare and unique
car one of the most collectable Supras ever.
zh:
A70 Supra在房车赛和拉力赛
中都亮相过。

这辆3.0 GT Turbo A甚至获得了参加A组别
竞赛的许可！

它搭载了一台原本为2000GT开发的
直列六缸M系引擎。

Turbo A的独有涡轮使其能输出超过
<270ps>的马力。

这款车型最终只有500辆出厂上市。
可以说，每一辆都是Supra历史中的无价之宝。`

en:
Behold, the final evolution of the Countach—the so-called
'25th Anniversary Edition'!

This model was released in 1988, to celebrate 25 years
of Lamborghini excellence.

Its restyling was overseen by none other than Horacio
Pagani.

Yes, the same Horacio Pagani who founded
Pagani Automobili S.p.A.

The culmination of decades of Countach development, this
model delivers an incredibly refined driving experience.
zh:
请看，这就是Countach的最终形态——被称为
“25周年版”的车型！

这辆车上市于1988年，以庆祝Lamborghini这25年中
达成的辉煌成就。

它的再设计是在大名鼎鼎的Horacio Pagani
的监督下进行的。

没错，他就是那个创立了
Pagani Automobili S.p.A.的人。

这辆车是集合了Countach数十年的发展经验的巅峰之作，
能为你带来近乎完美的驾驶体验。

en:
This BMW sports car is, in many ways, an expression of the
manufacturer's passion for automobiles.

The chassis was redesigned from scratch, with attention
paid to every aspect of the interior and exterior.

This Z8 came only with a manual transmission...

...meaning it was intended for true driving enthusiasts
like you and me.

And when unleashed on a race track, it brought new meaning
to the phrase, "The Ultimate Driving Machine."
zh:
这款BMW跑车彰显了该汽车制造商对世界各地的汽车爱好者的
许下的承诺和投入。

它的底盘是从零开始重新设计的，
车内车外的每一个细节都经过了推敲和考量。

值得注意的是，这款车型只配备了
手动变速箱。

这辆车纤细的方向盘赋予了它
出众的手感。

不过它最大的优点还是其在高速下能给你
带来的那一番狂野的体验！*

en:
You probably know this car as the Beetle, but its official
name is the Volkswagen Type 1.

It has a RR layout, meaning its air-cooled flat-4 engine
sits behind the rear axle and powers the rear tires.

The Beetle's unique strengths have made it a frequent
participant in drag racing and other motorsports...

...because when properly tuned, this round compact coupe
can be surprisingly quick.
zh:
人们亲切地称它为“the Beetle"。这款标志性汽车
在世界范围内都备受喜爱。

它以后置后驱的布局搭载了一台风冷平置四缸发动机，
使得其后轮能够产生大量牵引力。

这种特性让它成为了直线加速赛以及
其他汽车竞赛中的常客。

由于这款车不缺替换零件，
你可以常常在赛道上遇到飞驰的改装款Beetle！]

en:
Volkswagen has a number of famous models aside from
the Beetle, such as the "Camper."

Officially known as the Type 2, it's based on the Type 1,
which we all know better as the Beetle.

Like the Type 1, it has a rear-engine/rear-drive layout,
which we refer to as RR.

Because the designers kept the air-cooled flat-4 engine low,
there's a surprising amount of interior space.

Like the Beetle, plenty of tuning parts are available, allowing
owners to customize the car to their heart's content.
zh:
这又是一款闻名世界的Volkswagen车——人们
亲切地称它为“露营者”。

它的官方代号为Type 2，是
基于Type 1——“甲壳虫”而开发的车型。

这辆车采用了后置后驱布局，搭载了一台风冷平置
四缸发动机。

较小的引擎尺寸为搭载货物让出了空间。

由于它的调校件非常好找，这辆车
开起来非常有意思。

en:
The Nissan 180SX was based on the S13 Silvia.

Unlike the notchback Silvia, this car features an
exquisite fastback design.

Thanks to its rear-wheel-drive layout, it handles like a true
sports car, making it a favorite among the drift crowd.

The engine is a turbocharged 1.8-liter inline-4 that produces
<175ps>, so it had plenty of punch off the line.
zh:
Nissan 180SX是S13 Silvia的衍生车型。

不同于凹背的Silvia，这款双门跑车
采用了掀背风格。

作为一款后驱车，它的操控性优良，
调校得当后的牵引力也十足。

它还是一台可靠的漂移车，许多喜欢漂移的车手都对它情有独钟。

en:
The R5 Turbo was among the hottest rally cars in the 1980s.

While the base R5 came as a front-engine car, Renault
converted the R5 Turbo into a mid-engine machine.

This improved the car's off-road balance, resulting in numerous
rallying championships all over the world.

It's fair to say that the heavy rear could be
a bit jittery at times...

...but its unique driving character makes it more appealing
to many tarmac rally drivers!
zh:
R5 Turbo是80年代拉力赛事中的明星。

近年来，参赛队伍把量产车改成
中置引擎布局也不是什么新鲜事……

但在80年代，这一做法还相当新颖。

虽然这车的后端确实比较重，而且
偶尔不太稳……

但是柏油路拉力赛才是它
展现实力的地方！

en:
This EK model was the first 'Type R' Civic.

Despite its light size and weight, it boasts a high-revving
naturally-aspirated engine that can produce <185ps>.

Its body was extensively reworked with an eye towards
enhanced rigidity and weight reduction.

The base chassis was of a newer generation than that of
the first Integra Type R model.

Though small in stature, its speed is undeniable.

This particular variant is a late-model release. The bumper
and light detailing differ slightly from earlier designs.
zh:
这款EK是最早的CiviC “Type R”。

虽然它尺寸小，重量轻，但仍搭载了一台能产生<185ps>马力的高转速自然
吸气引擎。

它的底盘也经过了大幅改造，减轻了重量，
增强了刚性。

这辆车的基础底盘比第一款Integra Type R
先进了一代。

虽然体量小，但它的速度是毋容置疑的。

这款车是较晚推出的款型，保险杠和车灯的细节
与先前推出的款型稍有不同。%

en:
The Chevrolet Corvette really came into its own with the C4
model, especially with the ZR-1 performance package.

Its 32-valve V-8 pumped out an impressive <380ps>...

...making it as powerful as many V-12-powered supercars of
its day, including the incredible Ferrari Testarossa!

Interestingly, the car was designed by Lotus, which was part of
General Motors at the time, and here's another fun fact:

The C4 ZR-1 was the first Corvette to be equipped with a 6-speed
manual transmission.
zh:
现今最强劲的Corvette都发源于这款
第四代Corvette，C4 ZR-1。

它搭载了一台32阀V8 DOHC引擎，马力高达<380ps>。

这台引擎的马力能与当时名声显赫的
Ferrari Testarossa搭载的V12一比高低！

有趣的是，这台引擎是由当时仍是General Motors子公司的
Lotus所设计的。

C4 ZR-1也是第一款配备了
六速手动变速箱的Corvette。

en:
The Nissan S30 is one of the finest and most popular
Japanese sports cars ever produced.

This higher-performance 240Z variant, the 240ZG, features a
2.4L straight-six engine.

Its extended front was one of the more notable additions,
and it is lovingly referred to as the 'G-nose'.

This feature increased the car's total length by about
<190mm> compared to the 240Z.

The nose isn't just for looks—its aerodynamic properties
boost the 240ZG's top speed by about <5km/h>.
zh:
Nissan S30是有史以来最优秀、
最受欢迎的日产跑车之一。

这款高性能的240Z衍生型——240ZG，搭载了一台
2.4升直列六缸引擎。

这辆车的加长车头是最明显的变化之一，
许多人亲切地称之为“G-nose”。

相比240Z，这一改动使车辆的
